Temporal age and state-space displacement enter a nonlinear hereditary force admitting an exact, trajectory-dependent velocity representation. A common velocity-history phase space contains both resting and uniformly translating solutions.

arxiv:2610.24163.title: Explicit Criteria for Finite-Time Identification in Sparse Primal--Dual Dynamics
arxiv:2610.24163.summary: We study when selected coordinates become and remain zero in a finite-dimensional sparse-regression primal--dual flow and its exact full resolvent iteration. Invariant balls centered at \((0,z)\), with \(z\) strictly dual feasible, give computable deadlines without rank assumptions or optimizer knowledge. The certificates may be available at initialization.

arxiv:2610.24180.title: T-embeddings as stationary measures on T-graphs
arxiv:2610.24180.summary: In this paper, we investigate the relation between t-embeddings and T-graphs associated with the same weighted planar bipartite graph. We prove that, given such a T-graph, the corresponding t-embeddings are classified by positive stationary measures on this T-graph and describe a reconstruction procedure of the t-embedding given such a measure. As an application, we develop an approach for constructing t-embeddings of arbitrary sufficiently non-degenerate planar bipartite graphs.
arxiv:2610.24180.authors: Mikhail Basok, Benoit Laslier, Marianna Russkikh

arxiv:2610.24190.title: Finiteness of Anosov and pseudo-Anosov flows on hyperbolic 3-manifolds
arxiv:2610.24190.summary: We show that for any closed hyperbolic 3-manifold $M$, there are only finitely many Anosov or pseudo-Anosov flows on $M$ up to orbit equivalence.

arxiv:2610.24197.title: Sums of two dependent uniform random variables: a characterization by joint tail bounds
arxiv:2610.24197.summary: Which laws can the sum of two uniform random variables have when nothing is known about how they depend on each other? For three or more uniform summands, convex order gives the answer; for two it does not, and the question has been open. We show that the attainable laws are exactly those that satisfy a family of explicit joint bounds on sums of tail probabilities, one bound for each finite set of thresholds.

arxiv:2610.24222.title: On the kissing number of hyperbolic surfaces with a small systole
arxiv:2610.24222.summary: Parlier proved that there exists a constant $U>0$ such that for any hyperbolic surface $S$ of genus $g$ with systole $\ell$ the following holds: \[ Kiss(S)\leq U \frac {e^\ell}\ell g \] where $Kiss(S)$ is the maximum number of homotopically distinct systoles in $S$ (Kissing number). We show that there exists a constant $V>0$ and a sequence $S_n$ of hyperbolic homogeneous surfaces of genus $g_n\to \infty$ with a bounded systole such that \[ Kiss(S_n)\geq Vg_n \] for all $n\geq 1$. This shows that Parlier's theorem is sharp for a fixed systole length.

arxiv:2610.24247.title: Analytic quantum invariants
arxiv:2610.24247.summary: Using a deformed Borel-Laplace resummation, we propose a framework for repackaging quantum invariants as analytic invariants. We illustrate our approach through a detailed analysis of the coloured Jones polynomials of several simple knots, deriving explicit expressions for the resulting analytic invariants in terms of $(q,X)$-series. These invariants are closely related to, but generally distinct from, those obtained via the conventional Borel resummation of the Melvin-Morton-Rozansky expansion.
arxiv:2610.24247.authors: Rinat Kashaev, Vladimir Mangazeev, Marcos Marino

arxiv:2610.24251.title: Codimension of Brill-Noether Loci on Abelian Surfaces and the First Segre Invariant
arxiv:2610.24251.summary: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces.

arxiv:2610.24252.title: An Atiyah-Segal homomorphism for approximate representations of infinite groups, and almost multiplicative ucp maps
arxiv:2610.24252.summary: The Atiyah-Segal homomorphism relates the representation ring of a finite group to the $K$-theory ring of its classifying space. We develop a version of this for infinite groups, but based on a ring of approximate representations rather than representations. We then use known results on the Baum-Connes conjecture to show that our homomorphism is an isomorphism for many groups: this includes all torsion-free amenable groups, and all torsion-free fundamental groups of compact manifolds of dimension at most three.

arxiv:2610.24281.title: The Heesch number in $\mathbb{E}^3$ is unbounded
arxiv:2610.24281.summary: The Heesch number of a figure is the largest number of times that the figure can be surrounded by layers of its congruent copies. Heesch's problem asks whether finite Heesch numbers are bounded. We show that in the three-dimensional Euclidean space, and thus also in higher-dimensional Euclidean spaces, they are not: for every positive integer $h$, we construct a shape whose Heesch number is finite and at least $h$.

arxiv:2610.24324.title: Reconfiguration graphs of mutual-visibility sets
arxiv:2610.24324.summary: A set $S\subseteq V(G)$ is a mutual-visibility set if every pair of vertices in $S$ is joined by a geodesic whose internal vertices do not belong to $S$. We define a reconfiguration graph whose vertices are the mutual-visibility sets of $G$. Two configurations are adjacent if one is obtained from the other by adding or removing one vertex or by sliding one token along an edge of $G$.
arxiv:2610.24324.authors: Juli\'an A. Fres\'an-Figueroa, Il\'an A. Goldfeder, Aldo Lozano-Pi\~na

arxiv:2610.24331.title: Markoff spectra of Hecke groups
arxiv:2610.24331.summary: We study the initial discrete parts of the Markoff spectra of Hecke groups of index $q\ge 5$. Using a digit expansion associated with geodesics and a Perron-type formula, we classify all bi-infinite digit sequences whose Markoff values lie at or below the first accumulation point. We obtain explicit formulas for the discrete spectral values and identify the sequences realizing them, including those attaining the first accumulation point.

arxiv:2610.24351.title: Global stability of Michaelis-Menten networks
arxiv:2610.24351.summary: In a very nice paper, Blanchini, Breda, Giordano and Liessi studied networks of species coupled through Michaelis-Menten interactions. Under standard assumptions of strong connectedness and non-degeneracy, they show that there is a unique equilibrium, which is (locally) asymptotically stable. This note shows that global stability, which was stated there as an open problem, holds as well.

arxiv:2610.24371.title: Pfaffian Positivity for Convex Kernels and Optimal Matching Bounds
arxiv:2610.24371.summary: We show that for all positive, nonincreasing, convex functions $f : (0, \infty) \to (0,\infty)$ and for any collection of $n$ points $x_i \in \mathbb{R}$ with $x_1 < x_2 < \ldots < x_n$ and $n$ even, the Pfaffian of the skew matrix defined by $f(x_j - x_i)$ above the diagonal is positive. More generally, we establish coefficientwise nonnegativity for Pfaffians arising from interval decompositions, which also yields quantitative lower bounds for singly and doubly bordered Pfaffians. Choosing $f(r) = r^{-2}$ proves the three nonvanishing assertions in the conjecture of Albouy and Moeckel.

arxiv:2610.24374.title: Split Normal Bundles and Rigidity of Holomorphic Immersions from Compact Ball Quotients
arxiv:2610.24374.summary: Let $f$ be a holomorphic immersion from a compact complex hyperbolic space form into a higher-dimensional complex hyperbolic space form. We prove that if the normal bundle decomposes as a direct sum of holomorphic line bundles, then the immersion is totally geodesic. This result has no restriction on the codimension and extends, under the splitting hypothesis, the classical rigidity theorem of Cao--Mok.

arxiv:2610.24406.title: Coactions of weak multiplier Hopf algebras
arxiv:2610.24406.summary: In this article, we investigate the notion of a coaction for a weak multiplier Hopf algebra. We show that there is a duality for actions and coactions of weak algebraic quantum groups. Then we obtain the well known Blattner-Montgomery duality theorem for weak algebraic quantum groups in the framework of dual pairs.

arxiv:2610.24408.title: A Recursive Construction of Perfect $K^n\times K^n$ Arrays over $K$ Roots of Unity
arxiv:2610.24408.summary: We give a uniform, explicit and elementary recursive construction of two-dimensional arrays with perfect (ideal) periodic autocorrelation over a \emph{fixed} alphabet of $K$ roots of unity and \emph{unbounded} size: for every integer $K\ge2$ and every $n\ge1$ a perfect $K^n\times K^n$ array whose entries are $K$-th roots of unity, given by a nested sum of floor terms. The construction works with \emph{twisted} (quasi-perfect) arrays indexed by a type $v\in\Z_K^2$, of which ordinary perfect arrays are the type $v=0$ members. For $K=2$ the types are Jedwab's generalised perfect binary arrays and the recursion specialises to the doubling constructions of Jedwab--Mitchell and Wild; for prime…

arxiv:2610.24421.title: Adding Heavy-Ball Momentum to Distributed Constrained Optimization for Energy Resource Management Subject to Time-Delays and Quantization
arxiv:2610.24421.summary: This paper studies a hybrid discrete-time signed gradient-consensus method with heavy-ball momentum, paired communication delays, and fixed logarithmic quantization. The method preserves the aggregate supply-demand equality at every iteration. For a static connected undirected graph and bounded delays, a Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis establishes practical stability by isolating the discontinuous quantization error as an additive disturbance and closing a computable invariant-sublevel argument.

arxiv:2610.24427.title: Local Ore Conditions for Rainbow Pancyclicity and Vertex-Pancyclicity in Graph Systems
arxiv:2610.24427.summary: We investigate rainbow pancyclicity and vertex-pancyclicity of graph systems satisfying a local Ore-type degree condition. All graphs in the system share the same vertex set. We prove that if each graph is 2-connected and satisfies our local Ore condition, then the graph system is either rainbow pancyclic and vertex-pancyclic for cycles of length from 4 to n, or all graphs are identical balanced complete bipartite graphs on an even vertex set.

arxiv:2610.24429.title: Asymptotics for the number of saddle connections on a slit torus
arxiv:2610.24429.summary: We consider a flat torus with a marked line segment $\beta$ and prove linear asymptotics for closed curves on the torus disjoint from the interior of the line segment. We also consider segments that begin and terminate at the end points of $\beta$ whose interiors are disjoint from $\beta$ and prove $L\log L$ asymptotics. In all cases, after quotienting by the growth rate, we compute the constant explicitly, which differs depending on whether or not $\beta$ lies in a periodic direction on the torus.

arxiv:2610.24438.title: Bounded powers of edge ideals: Nearly Gorenstein polytopes
arxiv:2610.24438.summary: A lattice polytope $\mathcal{P} \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ of dimension $n$ is called nearly Gorenstein if $\mathcal{P}$ is normal and if its Ehrhart ring is a nearly Gorenstein ring. We study nearly Gorenstein polytopes arising from discrete polymatroids of bounded powers of edge ideals. Especially, it is shown that every nearly Gorenstein polytope coming from either a complete graph or a complete bipartite graph is level.
arxiv:2610.24438.authors: Takayuki Hibi, Seyed Amin Seyed Fakhari

arxiv:2610.24442.title: A proof of the strong Erd\H{o}s--Frankl--F\"uredi cover-free conjecture
arxiv:2610.24442.summary: A family of nonempty sets is $r$-cover-free if no member is contained in the union of at most $r$ other members. Let $T(r)$ denote the least $n$ for which there is an $r$-cover-free family on $n$ points with more than $n$ members. In this paper, we prove that $T(r)\ge(r+1)^2$ for every integer $r\ge1$, confirming the strong form of the Erd\H{o}s--Frankl--F\"uredi cover-free conjecture.

arxiv:2610.24443.title: On the $\omega$-circular $*$-distribution for complex unimodular $\omega$
arxiv:2610.24443.summary: We consider a notion of $\omega$-circular $*$-distribution $\mu_{\omega}$, defined in terms of a parameter $\omega \in \mathbb{C}$ with $| \omega |=1$. This $*$-distribution appears as limit law in an algebraic central limit theorem (CLT) for $\omega$-commuting unitaries, and interpolates between the Fermionic setting (at $\omega = -1$) and the Bosonic one (at $\omega = 1$). On a combinatorial level, $\mu_{\omega}$ is described in terms of pair-partitions of sets $\{1, ... ,2n\}$, where one has a total order among the $n$ pairs of the partition and where every pair is assigned a direction, to the effect that one can define the sign of a crossing between two pairs.
arxiv:2610.24443.authors: Claus Koestler, Liam McQuay, Alexandru Nica

arxiv:2610.24445.title: A new class of pyramidal central configurations for spatial Newtonian 6-body problems
arxiv:2610.24445.summary: While a non-concyclic rhombus can support a central configuration in the planar Newtonian four-body problem, such a configuration cannot serve as the base of a pyramidal central configuration in the spatial five-body problem. In this paper, we establish the existence of a new class of pyramidal central configurations in the spatial Newtonian six-body problem, characterized by a non-concyclic quadrilateral base. This geometric structure distinguishes the new configurations from the known pyramidal central configurations of the spatial five-body problem.
arxiv:2610.24445.authors: Liang Ding, Jin Wang, Jinrong Wang, Zhifu Xie

arxiv:2610.24473.title: Cospan contexts and higher categories
arxiv:2610.24473.summary: Motivated by the desire to turn the cobordism hypothesis (a statement about the universal property of some $n$-category of bordisms) into a $1$-categorical statement, we prove that all $n$-categories can be modeled by \emph{$n$-cospan contexts}: these are $1$-categories equipped with a collection of iterated cospans that satisfy a composition property in terms of pushouts. In particular, we construct an adjunction from $\mathsf{Cat}_n$ to the category of $n$-cospan contexts which simultaneously generalizes the $n$-fold span construction of Haugseng and the twisted arrow category construction (when $n = 1$).

arxiv:2610.24484.title: Erd\H{o}s-Gy\'arf\'as Balanced Five-Colorings
arxiv:2610.24484.summary: A coloring of the edges of a complete graph with $r$ colors is balanced if the edges among any $r+1$ vertices use all $r$ colors. Erd\H{o}s and Gy\'arf\'as (1999) conjectured that for all $r\ge3$ the complete graph $K_{r^2+1}$ has no balanced $r$-coloring. They proved the conjecture for $r=3$ and $r=4$.

arxiv:2610.24517.title: Local energy and vertex deletion for $A_\alpha$-matrices
arxiv:2610.24517.summary: We study the change in the trace norm and the centred energy of the $A_\alpha$-matrix of a graph under vertex deletion. A pinching argument proves that the trace norm is nondecreasing under passage from an induced subgraph to the original graph, and gives a lower bound in terms of the edges induced by the deleted vertices. Exact perturbation spectra yield sharp upper bounds for deleting a vertex or an independent set of vertices with a common neighbourhood.

arxiv:2610.24523.title: Multicolor Ramsey numbers of unbalanced double stars
arxiv:2610.24523.summary: For integers $n\ge m\ge1$, let $S(n,m)$ be the double star obtained by joining the centers of $K_{1,n}$ and $K_{1,m}$. Ruotolo and Song proved the upper bound $r(S(n,m);k)\le kn+m+2$ under the condition $(n+1)\lceil\frac{n+1}{k-1}\rceil >m((k-1)n+m)$, as well as the matching lower bound for odd $k$. Zhao, Mao and Zhou proved the matching lower bound for even $k$ and even $n$.

arxiv:2610.24606.title: Length-convexity and domination for Hitchin representations
arxiv:2610.24606.summary: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g\geq 2$. For any $n\geq 3$, let $\text{Hit}_n(S)$ be the Hitchin component and let $\text{Hit}_n(S)^\prime$ be the subset of representations that take values in $\mathrm{PSp}_{2m}(\mathbb{R})$ if $n=2m$ and $\mathrm{PSO}(m,m+1)$ if $n=2m+1$. In this note we prove that for any Hitchin representation $\rho \in \text{Hit}_n(S)$ there is $j \in \text{Hit}_n(S)^\prime$ such that $\rho$ dominates $j$ in the Hilbert length spectrum; this confirms a conjecture of Lee-Zhang and, independently, Tholozan who had proved this for $n=3$.

arxiv:2610.24620.title: Lyapunov-Krasovsky Functionals and the Existence of Unbounded Solutions of Functional-Differential Equations of Retarded Type
arxiv:2610.24620.summary: In this paper, the concepts of unboundedness and partial unboundedness of solutions of functional-differential equations of retarded type are introduced. On the basis of the method of Lyapunov-Krasovsky functionals, sufficient conditions for the existence of partially unbounded solutions are obtained. As corollaries, sufficient conditions for the existence of unbounded solutions are obtained.
arxiv:2610.24620.authors: Lapin K. S., Lapin S. V

arxiv:2610.24631.title: Random Tournaments Are Asymptotically Almost Surely Link-irregular
arxiv:2610.24631.summary: Bastien and Khormali (2025) conjectured that a nontrivial link-irregular tournament with $n$ vertices exists if and only if $n \ge 6$. Their work establishes the conjecture for $n \le 100$. We present a probabilistic argument for the existence of link-irregular tournaments with $n$ vertices when $n \ge 9$ to resolve the conjecture.

arxiv:2610.24636.title: The Yau Geometric Conjecture for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
arxiv:2610.24636.summary: This paper presents a proof of the long-standing Yau Geometric Conjecture.
arxiv:2610.24636.authors: Siyuan Fu, Stephen S. -T. Yau, Huaiqing Zuo

arxiv:2610.24647.title: Unstable entropy for Anosov diffeomorphisms on tori isotopic to Anosov linear maps
arxiv:2610.24647.summary: Let $f$ be an Anosov diffeomorphism on the $d$-torus which is strongly partially hyperbolic with expanding center. If $d=3$ or if $f$ is isotopic to its linear part, where the isotopy is contained in the set of partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms, we construct systems of strong-unstable and center-stable Margulis measures which are holonomy invariant. As a consequence, we obtain a characterization of measures of maximal unstable entropy in terms of their conditional measures along strong-unstable leaves.

arxiv:2610.24657.title: Analytical Methods for Solving Non-Autonomous Higher-Order Nonlinear Difference Equations
arxiv:2610.24657.summary: A system of four-dimensional fifth-order rational difference equations with variable coefficients is considered. The method employed is the well-known Lie symmetry analysis initially developed for differential equations. Linearised symmetry conditions are applied, reduction operators are introduced, functional equations are solved, and symmetry generators are derived.
arxiv:2610.24657.authors: Tshifhiwa Murovhi, Mensah Folly-Gbetoula, Kwassi Anani

arxiv:2610.24666.title: Derived equivalences and isogenies of supersingular abelian varieties
arxiv:2610.24666.summary: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic.
arxiv:2610.24666.authors: An Jiang, Zhiyuan Li, Ziwei Lu

arxiv:2610.24695.title: On Non-Uniform Baranyai Factorizations
arxiv:2610.24695.summary: For a fixed nonempty finite set $L$ of positive integers and $k=\max L\ge2$, let $\binom{[n]}{L}=\bigcup_{\ell\in L}\binom{[n]}{\ell}$ denote the non-uniform hypergraph whose edge set consists of all $\ell$-subsets of $[n]$ for $\ell\in L$. A $1$-factor of a hypergraph $H$ is a collection of pairwise disjoint edges whose union is $V(H)$. We say $H$ is $1$-factorable if $E(H)$ can be partitioned into $1$-factors.

arxiv:2610.24700.title: Density of length ratios on Teichm\"uller space
arxiv:2610.24700.summary: We study length ratios of simple closed geodesics on finite-type hyperbolic surfaces of positive genus. We allow cusps and fix the geodesic boundary lengths. Let $d$ be the dimension of the corresponding Teichm\"uller space $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbf{L}}(S)$.

arxiv:2610.24716.title: Planar graphs whose second largest eigenvalue does not exceed 1
arxiv:2610.24716.summary: The problem posed by Hoffman, namely, to characterize graphs whose second largest adjacency eigenvalue is at most \(1\), was first studied by D.~M.~Cvetkovi\'{c} in 1982 [\textit{Publ. Inst. Math.
arxiv:2610.24716.authors: Zihao Geng, Zhiwen Wang, Wen-Jun Li, Xue-Ying Li, Qian-Qian Chen, Ji-Ming Guo

arxiv:2610.24720.title: The first Cech derived functor
arxiv:2610.24720.summary: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a semi-abelian category, $\mathcal{D}$ a Birkhoff subcategory of $\mathcal{C}$, and $I$ the associated reflector. For $C\in \mathcal{C}$, we establish an isomorphism between $\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{N}(I(\check{C}(f,C))))$ (where $\mathrm{N}$ is the Moore normalization functor and $\check{C}(f,C)$ is a Cech resolution associated to $C$) and $\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{N}(I(\mathbb{G}(C))))$ (where $\mathbb{G}(C)$ is the canonical $\mathbb{G}$-simplicial resolution of $C$ for $\mathbb{G}$ the comonad derived from an adjunction $F\colon \mathcal{X}\to \mathcal{C}\dashv U\colon \mathcal{C}\to \mathcal{X}$ satisfying classical conditions introduced by Quillen). The former…

arxiv:2610.24743.title: Physical measures for partially hyperbolic systems with $u$-definite subbundles
arxiv:2610.24743.summary: In this paper, we study \(C^{1+\alpha}\) diffeomorphisms of a compact Riemannian manifold \(\mathbf{M}\) with an attracting set \(\Lambda\) admitting a partially hyperbolic splitting \[ T_\Lambda \mathbf{M} = E^u\oplus C_1\oplus\cdots\oplus C_k\oplus E^s. \] We assume that, for every ergodic Gibbs \(u\)-state supported on \(\Lambda\), the Lyapunov exponents along each \(C_i\) are either all positive or all negative. We prove that \(\Lambda\) supports finitely many ergodic hyperbolic SRB measures whose basins cover Lebesgue almost every point of its topological basin.

arxiv:2610.24758.title: Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces
arxiv:2610.24758.summary: A single-track Gray code of length $n$ is a cyclic Gray code of $n$-bit words in which every column is a cyclic shift of the first. For prime $n$ the longest possible period is $2^n-2$. Whether it is attained for every prime has been open since Hiltgen, Paterson and Brandestini introduced these codes in 1996, and optimal codes were known for primes $n\le 19$.

arxiv:2610.24760.title: Three Machines Suffice for Local Hardening of Electromechanical Oscillations
arxiv:2610.24760.summary: The single-degree-of-freedom swing equation with sinusoidal coupling is locally softening: its oscillation frequency decreases with oscillation level near a stable equilibrium. Nonlinear modal interaction, however, can reverse this trend in multimachine systems. This letter gives a necessary-and-sufficient condition for strict leading-order local hardening, measured with respect to canonical action, in two symmetric three-machine operating-point families with equal or opposite power injections at the equal-inertia machines.

arxiv:2610.24774.title: On dimension of posets excluding a standard example
arxiv:2610.24774.summary: We prove that for every integer $d \geq 3$, there exists $\alpha <1$ such that the maximum dimension of an $n$-element poset containing no standard example of order $d$ as an induced subposet is $\mathcal{O}_d(n^\alpha)$. For $d=3$, we obtain an upper bound $\mathcal{O}(n^{2/3}\log n)$, while we also construct a family of $S_3$-free posets with dimension $\Omega(n^{1/3}/\log n)$. The proofs were found by OpenAI's ChatGPT-6 Astra.
arxiv:2610.24774.authors: J\k{e}drzej Hodor, Piotr Micek, William T. Trotter

arxiv:2610.24803.title: Avoiding Distances
arxiv:2610.24803.summary: Given a finite planar point set $X=\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}$, let $a_1<a_2< \cdots < a_s$ denote the $s \leq {n \choose 2}$ different (Euclidean) distances between points in $X$. The aim is to retain as many of the points as possible such that certain imposed inter-pair distances are avoided. For example, we show that: (A) Given a set $X$ of $n$ points in the plane, an independent set of size $0.2293 n$ in the unit distance graph determined by $X$ can be found in $O(n^2)$ time.

arxiv:2610.24825.title: K\"ahler-Ricci Flow is Symplectic Deflation plus an Exact Symplectic Deformation
arxiv:2610.24825.summary: We demonstrate that K\"ahler-Ricci flow on a Fano surface decomposes as a symplectic deflation along a plurianticanonical divisor plus an exact symplectic deformation in the divisor complement. We apply this decomposition to the study of certain projective bundles. We establish the optimal decay rate in the setting of Song, Sz\'ekelyhidi, and Weinkove for a family of toric metrics which match the cohomological profile of K\"ahler-Ricci flow.

arxiv:2610.24842.title: The big cactus group, invariant tensors, and rectangular tableaux
arxiv:2610.24842.summary: The cactus group acts on tensor products of crystals and, through Bender--Knuth involutions, on semistandard Young tableaux. We show that the big cactus group $J'_n=\pi_1^{\mathfrak S_n}(\overline M_{0,n}(\mathbb R))$, $n\ge3$, is obtained from the cactus group by imposing $n-1$ Dynkin-reversal relations, which say that conjugation by the full reversal acts on the Bender--Knuth generators by the Dynkin diagram automorphism; the quotient map is induced by forgetting the distinguished marked point. We give a second presentation, in which these relations are replaced by the requirement that every reduced word for the longest element of $\mathfrak S_n$ adapted to an orientation of $A_{n-1}$…
arxiv:2610.24842.authors: Gabriel Frieden, Pavlo Pylyavskyy, Leonid Rybnikov

arxiv:2610.24848.title: Interior caustics and rigidity near noncircular ellipses
arxiv:2610.24848.summary: We prove local rigidity near every fixed noncircular ellipse from integrable rational caustics in an arbitrary nonempty open rotation interval $I\subset(0,1/2)$. For each fixed $r>11/2$ and bound on the $H^r$ norm of the elliptic graph displacement, every sufficiently $C^1$-small positively curved perturbation admitting such caustics at all rational rotations in $I$ is an ellipse. A fixed $C^6$ bound may replace the Sobolev bound, with $C^1$ smallness retained.

arxiv:2610.24852.title: $\frac{1}{2}$ derivations and biderivations of 3-dimensional nilpotent Lie-Yamaguti algebras
arxiv:2610.24852.summary: In this paper, we investigate $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations and their corresponding local and 2-local analogues on three-dimensional nilpotent Lie--Yamaguti algebras over a field $\mathbb{F}$ of characteristic zero. Utilizing the established classification of these algebras, we explicitly determine their structures of $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations and biderivations. Furthermore, we characterize the matrix representations of their local $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations.

arxiv:2610.24864.title: On the classification of threefold flops
arxiv:2610.24864.summary: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements.

arxiv:2610.24868.title: A characterization of generalized derivations and biderivations on some simple algebras
arxiv:2610.24868.summary: In this paper, we characterize the generalized derivations and biderivations of the simple seven-dimensional anticommutative algebra \(D\) and the seven-dimensional central simple commutative algebra \(C\). Furthermore, we prove that any local generalized derivation of these algebras is inherently a generalized derivation.

arxiv:2610.24887.title: Erd\H{o}s-Hajnal for excluding paths
arxiv:2610.24887.summary: We prove the Erd\H{o}s-Hajnal conjecture for excluding an arbitrary path. A major step in our proof is a novel Gy\'arf\'as path argument based on the ideas of bookkeeping blockades and splitting paths, which may be of independent interest.

arxiv:2610.24889.title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
arxiv:2610.24889.summary: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30).

arxiv:2610.24922.title: Stein fillable contact structures with half Giroux torsion
arxiv:2610.24922.summary: We show that there exist Stein fillable contact 3-manifolds which contain a separating half Giroux torsion layer. Our examples are on Seifert fibred spaces over the sphere.

arxiv:2610.24924.title: Hodge-Carleman estimates and global attractors for heterogeneous elastic waves with localized damping on Riemannian manifolds
arxiv:2610.24924.summary: We study the long-time dynamics of the semilinear Lam\'e system of isotropic elasticity on a compact Riemannian manifold with boundary, for a heterogeneous medium whose density and Lam\'e moduli vary in space, under a frictional dissipation which acts only on an open set $\omega$. The elastic operator is the divergence of the Hooke stress tensor, and the starting point is a structural identity which shows that the dilatation and the vorticity of the displacement satisfy wave equations with the pressure and the shear speeds, respectively, coupled to the displacement only through first-order terms. A single weight function, free of critical points and strictly convex with respect to the two…

arxiv:2610.24936.title: Weighted homogeneous surface singularities admitting rational homology disk smoothings
arxiv:2610.24936.summary: We study rational homology disk smoothings through canonical-cover representations and specialization of reflexive canonical powers, and recover the known dual graph and analytic classification. The geometric-genus representation of the canonical covering group, together with its complex conjugate, is a direct summand of the reduced regular representation. Specialization forces the canonical Riemann--Roch corrections to vanish; explicit formulas give equations for the Seifert invariants.

arxiv:2610.24946.title: Stable Ergodicity for Expanding on Average Partially Hyperbolic Diffeomorphisms with Two-Dimensional Center
arxiv:2610.24946.summary: We study a property called expansion on average (EA) defined for any partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism satisfying an unstable center bunching condition. Under a mild set of assumptions, we show that the EA property implies $C^2$-stable ergodicity with respect to volume. Our theorem applies to any conservative, $u$-center bunched, robustly dynamically coherent, partially hyperbolic $C^2$-diffeomorphism with two-dimensional center and one-dimensional unstable bundle, whose action on $E^c$ is close to conservative.

arxiv:2610.24979.title: Bounded orbits on homogeneous spaces and bounded geodesics on locally symmetric spaces
arxiv:2610.24979.summary: We present a unified approach to proving the following two results: (i) Let $G$ be a Lie group, $\Gamma$ a lattice in $G$, $X=G/\Gamma$, and let $F$ be a one-parameter $\mathrm{Ad}$-diagonalizable subgroup of $G$. Then the set $$ \{x\in X:Fx\text{ is bounded in }X\} $$ is hyperplane absolute winning on $X$. This fully solves a conjecture [Conjecture 7.1]{AGK} of An-Guan-Kleinbock in 2015.

arxiv:2610.24980.title: Eynard-Orantin Topological Recursion, Moduli-Space Virasoro Constraints, and Semisimple CohFTs
arxiv:2610.24980.summary: We use Virasoro constraints to prove Eynard's intersection-number formula for Eynard-Orantin topological recursion with several simple ramification points. The key construction couples the higher Weil-Petersson partition functions associated with the individual ramification points through a quadratic differential operator determined by the Bergman kernel. We identify this operator with the quadratic part of Givental's quantized $R$-matrix, thereby obtaining a Virasoro-theoretic proof of the DOSS identification of topological recursion with Givental's formula for semisimple cohomological field theories.

arxiv:2610.24982.title: Rank and Border Rank Additivity of Complex Tensors with a Hankel Summand
arxiv:2610.24982.summary: We prove that the CP rank of a complex Hankel tensor of order $m\ge3$ is additive with that of every complex tensor of the same order. Together with the known equality of CP and symmetric ranks for complex Hankel tensors, this yields symmetric rank additivity whenever the other summand has equal CP and symmetric ranks. We also prove that ordinary and symmetric border ranks coincide and are additive on direct sums of complex Hankel tensors of any common order at least three.

arxiv:2610.24985.title: Spectral Curves for Semisimple Conformal Frobenius Manifolds
arxiv:2610.24985.summary: We construct connected spectral curves for semisimple conformal Frobenius manifolds with flat unit, using the periods of the second structure equation. Eynard-Orantin topological recursion on these curves reproduces the stable ancestor correlators of Givental-Teleman reconstruction. The spectral curves are defined on simply connected domains in the complex plane.

arxiv:2610.24986.title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
arxiv:2610.24986.summary: Let $k/\mathbb Q$ be finitely generated, let $g\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, and let $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ be the moduli stack of smooth proper genus-$g$ curves with $n$ distinct ordered markings. Put $K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$. We prove Grothendieck's section conjecture for the generic $n$-pointed genus-$g$ curve over $K$.

arxiv:2610.25003.title: Classification of twisted Yangians as coideal subalgebras of Yangians
arxiv:2610.25003.summary: Let $\mathfrak g$ be a complex simple Lie algebra with an involution $\omega$. We classify the homogeneous right coideal subalgebras of the Yangian of $\mathfrak g$ whose classical limit is the enveloping algebra of the twisted current algebra, embedded in the standard way, without assuming any formula for the coaction. For nontrivial $\omega$, they form a family parametrized by a spectral parameter and an element of the center of the fixed-point subalgebra; for $\omega=\mathrm{id}$, only a spectral parameter occurs.

arxiv:2610.25022.title: The locally quaternion group is a countable $B$-group
arxiv:2610.25022.summary: A group $G$ is a $B$-group if every primitive permutation group containing a regular subgroup isomorphic to $G$ is doubly transitive. We prove that the locally quaternion group $\mathrm{Dic}(C_{2^\infty},c)$, the extension of the Pr\"ufer $2$-group by an element squaring to its involution and inverting it, is a $B$-group. This gives an example of a countably infinite $B$-group.

arxiv:2610.25028.title: Lambda number of the reduced power graph of finite groups
arxiv:2610.25028.summary: The reduced power graph $\Gamma_{RP}(G)$ of a group $G$ is a simple graph with vertex set $G$, where two distinct vertices $u$ and $v$ are adjacent if and only if $\langle u \rangle \subset \langle v \rangle$ or $\langle v \rangle \subset \langle u \rangle$. An $L(2,1)$-labeling of a graph $\Gamma$ is a mapping from the vertex set of $\Gamma$ to the set of non-negative integers such that the labels of adjacent vertices differ by at least $2$ and the labels of vertices at distance two are distinct. The lambda number of $\Gamma$, denoted by $\lambda(\Gamma)$, is defined as the minimum possible span of labels among all $L(2,1)$-labelings of $\Gamma$.
arxiv:2610.25028.authors: Siddharth Malviy, Keerttiranjan Sahoo, Vipul Kakkar

arxiv:2610.25030.title: A characterization of finite modular 2-groups via magnitude homology
arxiv:2610.25030.summary: Finite quasihamiltonian groups - that is, finite groups in which every pair of subgroups commutes - admit several characterizations. In this work, after introducing the notion of sectional contractibility graph, we provide a new characterization in terms of (a suitable subgroup of) magnitude homology. Our approach especially focuses on the subgroup lattices of finite groups and on the related notion of modularity.

arxiv:2610.25036.title: Schur-Positve Symmetric Functions from Products: Log-Majorization, Total-Positivity, and PSD Matrices
arxiv:2610.25036.summary: For a polynomial $F(t) = 1 + a_1 t + a_2 t^2 +\dots + a_d t^d$ with coefficients in a $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra $\mathcal{R}$, we consider Schur-positivity of the symmetric function $\Omega_F(\mathbf{x}) = \prod_{i \geq 1} F(x_i)$. Using work of Lindstr\"om and Gessel--Viennot, we give sufficient conditions for Schur-positivity in terms of directed networks. In the case when $F(t)$ is the multivariate independence polynomial of the incomparability graph $inc(P)$ of a natural unit interval order, we apply these ideas to give a new proof of Schur-positivity of the chromatic symmetric function $X_{inc(P)}(\mathbf{x})$.

arxiv:2610.25037.title: Exponential loss of memory for random Lasota--Yorke convex maps with local average expansion
arxiv:2610.25037.summary: We study i.i.d. random compositions of piecewise convex interval maps whose first branch is full. Uniform expansion is not required, and the maps may have contracting branches. Under a local average expansion condition at the origin, we prove both quenched and annealed exponential loss of memory for initial densities of bounded variation.

arxiv:2610.25042.title: Moser Regularization of the CR3BP for Symmetric Orbits: Bifurcation Networks of Lunar Orbits
arxiv:2610.25042.summary: We develop a computational framework based on Moser regularization for the analysis of symmetric periodic orbits in the spatial Circular Restricted Three-Body Problem (CR3BP). The formulation enables the numerical continuation of periodic orbit families through collision with either primary, together with the computation of Floquet multipliers and stability indices entirely in regularized coordinates. We further provide a characterization and numerical detection scheme for symmetric periodic collision orbits.

arxiv:2610.25047.title: Approximating Independent Sets Using Additive Combinatorics
arxiv:2610.25047.summary: We give a deterministic quasi-polynomial time algorithm for approximating the largest independent set in a graph. We show that if an $N$-vertex graph contains an independent set of size $2^{-t} N$, then we can find an independent set of size $2^t$ in quasi-polynomial time, for all $t$ up to a constant factor of $(\log N)^{1/3}$. This gives an approximation factor of $N / \exp((\log N)^{1/3})$, which has the same shape as known hardness results for quasi-polynomial time algorithms, up to a different exponent of the logarithm.

arxiv:2610.25049.title: Proving the optimality of the product construction for the intersection--union problem
arxiv:2610.25049.summary: Let $m(n,p,q)$ be the largest size of a family of subsets of $[n]$ whose members pairwise intersect in at least $p$ vertices and omit at least $q$ common vertices. We prove that a product on disjoint sets attains this maximum whenever $p,q\ge2$ and $n\ge2^{15}(p+q-2)^3$. Together with the second author's result for $p=1$ or $q=1$, this establishes Frankl's Intersection--Union Product Conjecture in a wide range.
arxiv:2610.25049.authors: Fan Chang, Peter Frankl, Jian Wang

arxiv:2610.25065.title: The genus of a curve on Calabi-Yau threefolds
arxiv:2610.25065.summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective Calabi-Yau variety of dimension $3$, with Picard number one. Let $n$ be the self-intersection of the ample generator of the N\'eron-Severi group of $X$. Let $\mathsf{GV}_{g,d}$ be the Gopakumar-Vafa invariant of $X$ of genus $g$ and degree $d$.
arxiv:2610.25065.authors: Vincenzo Di Gennaro, Antonio Rapagnetta, Pietro Sabatino

arxiv:2610.25095.title: Refined proper descent for left completed sheaves on locally compact Hausdorff spaces
arxiv:2610.25095.summary: We refine the proper descent of Postnikov completed sheaves on locally compact Hausdorff spaces to the dualizable world.

arxiv:2610.25101.title: The center conjecture for cyclotomic Hecke algebras and cohomology of quiver varieties
arxiv:2610.25101.summary: For a quiver without edge loops, we construct an isomorphism from the cohomology of a Nakajima quiver variety with coefficients in an arbitrary field to the Jucys--Murphy center of the corresponding cyclotomic KLR algebra over that field. In affine type $A^{(1)}_{e-1}$, combining this with a dimension count shows that this Jucys--Murphy center coincides with the full center in characteristic $0$, when the characteristic does not divide $e$, and when the characteristic equals $e$. This follows from a geometric theorem showing that the sum of these cohomology rings is cocyclic as a module over an integral form of a loop algebra.
arxiv:2610.25101.authors: Jun Hu, Andrew Mathas, Lei Shi, Ben Webster

arxiv:2610.25143.title: Prekosmic Grothendieck/Galois Categories
arxiv:2610.25143.summary: We develop a theory on duality between groups and the categories of their representations, by providing an abstract characterization of such categories. The theory has two parallel formulations, each presenting a duality analogous to one of the two that were originally proposed by Grothendieck: the one between profinite groups and the abstract categories of their continuous representations on finite sets, and the other between affine group schemes over a field and the abstract categories of their finite-dimensional linear representations. In the present theory, groups and their representations are internal to a symmetric monoidal base category, with no finiteness condition imposed.

arxiv:2610.25164.title: Increased-Order Generalized Synchronization in Memristive Neurons: Analytical and Data-Driven Approaches
arxiv:2610.25164.summary: We investigate increased-order generalized synchronization between four- and five-dimensional memristive Hindmarsh--Rose neurons, focusing on the selection and stabilization of the synchronization map. An analytical construction combines a prescribed nonlinear map with adaptive control, retaining the memristive switching contribution explicitly in the error dynamics. Lyapunov analysis establishes asymptotic synchronization under uniform strict dissipativity and yields a switching-independent decrease estimate outside an explicit error neighborhood.

arxiv:2610.25171.title: The minimum number of vertices of a triangulation of $\mathbb{RP}^5$
arxiv:2610.25171.summary: We give a computer-assisted proof that every finite simplicial triangulation of real projective five-space has at least twenty-four vertices. Together with the construction of Guyer, Steinerberger, and Yang, this determines the minimum. A cup-product argument produces an induced subcomplex on sixteen or seventeen vertices.

arxiv:2610.25177.title: Non-existence of Negative Weight Derivations of the Moduli Algebras of Isolated Weighted Homogeneous Hypersurface Singularities
arxiv:2610.25177.summary: Mather and Yau proved that the analytic isomorphism class of an isolated complex hypersurface singularity is determined by its dimension and its moduli algebra. Yau's conjecture asserts that the moduli algebra of an isolated weighted homogeneous hypersurface singularity over $\mathbb{C}$ has no nonzero derivation of negative degree. We prove this conjecture.

arxiv:2610.25181.title: When Are Monomial Symmetric Polynomials Hard?
arxiv:2610.25181.summary: For a partition $\boldsymbol{\lambda} = (\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_r)$ and $n\ge r$, the monomial symmetric polynomial is defined as $$m_{\boldsymbol{\lambda}}(x_1,\ldots,x_n) := \sum x_{i_1}^{\lambda_1} x_{i_2}^{\lambda_2} \cdots x_{i_r}^{\lambda_r},$$ where the sum ranges over all distinct monomials obtained by assigning the parts of $\boldsymbol{\lambda}$ to pairwise distinct variables. We establish an almost-complete dichotomy for the complexity of the monomial symmetric polynomials $m_{\boldsymbol{\lambda}}$: If a family of partitions contains polynomially many distinct parts, then the corresponding monomial symmetric polynomials (on sufficiently many variables) are VNP-complete. If the…
arxiv:2610.25181.authors: Markus Bl\"aser, Radu Curticapean, Sagnik Dutta, Gorav Jindal

arxiv:2610.25198.title: Finitely enhanced nontopological triangulated categories
arxiv:2610.25198.summary: Over every nonzero commutative ring $R$, we construct a nontopological triangulated category over $R$, whose finitely generated thick subcategories are alegbraic, while the scalar action of $R$ is faithful.

arxiv:2610.25204.title: Crossing numbers of complete bipartite graphs
arxiv:2610.25204.summary: Zarankiewicz's long standing conjecture states that the crossing number $cr(K_{m,n})$ of the complete bipartite graph is \[ Z(m,n):=\bigg\lfloor{\frac{m}{2}}\bigg\rfloor \bigg\lfloor{\frac{m-1}{2}}\bigg\rfloor \bigg\lfloor{\frac{n}{2}}\bigg\rfloor \bigg\lfloor{\frac{n-1}{2}}\bigg\rfloor. \] Using flag algebras, we show that $cr(K_{n,n}) \geq 0.96936 \cdot Z(n,n) + o(n^4)$. We also show that the rectilinear crossing number $\overline{cr}(K_{n,n})$ of $K_{n,n}$ is at least $0.987\cdot Z(n,n) + o(n^4)$.
arxiv:2610.25204.authors: J\'ozsef Balogh, Nicholas Layman, Bernard Lidick\'y, Florian Pfender, Gelasio Salazar, Sam Spiro, Jan Volec

arxiv:2610.25217.title: A counterexample to the geometric triangulation conjecture of Costantino, Frigerio, Martelli and Petronio
arxiv:2610.25217.summary: Costantino, Frigerio, Martelli and Petronio conjectured that an ideal triangulation in which every edge has valence at least six can be realized by hyperbolic partially truncated tetrahedra on the compact manifold it defines. We show that this is false. Starting from the figure-eight knot complement, we construct a triangulation with $2688$ tetrahedra and edge valences six and eighteen whose manifold is hyperbolic with totally geodesic boundary, but which admits no such realization.

arxiv:2610.25227.title: An inclusion coupling of prefix laws and the Chan-Pak rank inequality for all finite posets
arxiv:2610.25227.summary: Let $P$ be a finite poset, let $x\in P$, and let $N_k$ count its linear extensions in which $x$ occupies position $k$. We prove Chan and Pak's conjecture that, for all integers $a,h\ge1$, \[ (a+h-1)N_{a+h-1}N_a\ \ge\ (a-1)N_{a-1}N_{a+h}+hN_aN_{a+h}. \] The key result is an inclusion coupling of the laws of the set of elements preceding $x$, conditional on consecutive positions of $x$.

arxiv:2610.25242.title: Pre-Nichols algebras and generation of pointed Hopf algebras in positive characteristic
arxiv:2610.25242.summary: We study when a finite-dimensional pre-Nichols algebra $R$ of $V$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, with $p\nmid\dim R$, is necessarily isomorphic to the Nichols algebra $\B(V)$. A trace identity gives a rigidity criterion involving the twist on minimal defining relations. Using integral forms and Hochschild cohomology, we establish uniform rigidity for Yetter--Drinfeld modules of bounded dimension over fixed finite abelian groups, and obtain related results for certain modules over nonabelian groups.

arxiv:2610.25251.title: Finite Symplectic Automorphism Groups of K3 Surfaces in Characteristic Seven
arxiv:2610.25251.summary: We classify all finite groups of order divisible by $7$ that admit a faithful symplectic action on a K3 surface over an algebraically closed field of characteristic seven, together with the possible heights and Artin invariants. Combined with the known classification of tame actions, this gives the complete list of finite groups admitting such an action in characteristic seven.

arxiv:2610.25253.title: The second closed geodesic on Finsler manifolds with $\mathbb{Z}_2$ fundamental group
arxiv:2610.25253.summary: Let $(M, F)$ be a compact bumpy Finsler manifold with $\pi_1(M)=\mathbb{Z}_2$, we prove that there exist at least two distinct non-contractible closed geodesics on $(M, F)$.
arxiv:2610.25253.authors: Huagui Duan, Hui Liu, Wei Wang

arxiv:2610.25271.title: Inverse Zero-Sum Problems: The Property C and Property D Conjectures
arxiv:2610.25271.summary: Let $C_n^r$ denote the direct sum of $r$ cyclic groups of order $n$, where $n\ge2$ and $r\ge1$. Properties C and D predict a uniform multiplicity structure for extremal zero-sum problems over $C_n^r$: every sequence of maximum length avoiding nonempty zero-sum subsequences of length at most $n$, or of length exactly $n$, respectively, should have the form $T^{n-1}$. We give negative answers to the general Property C problem posed by Gao, Hou, Schmid and Thangadurai \cite[Open Problems 1.2]{GHST07} in 2007, and disprove the Property D conjecture proposed by Gao and Geroldinger \cite[Conjecture 7.2]{GG06} in 2006.

arxiv:2610.25293.title: A Common neighborhood signed graph of a signed graph
arxiv:2610.25293.summary: Let G be a simple connected graph with the vertex set V (G) and the edge set E(G) such that |V (G)| = n and |E(G)| = q. The common neighborhood graph con(G) of G has the same set of vertices as that of G and uv is an edge in con(G) if u and v have at least one common neighbor in G. By a signed graph S, we mean a graph G whose edges has been assigned sign plus or minus.

arxiv:2610.25312.title: Derived equivalence classification of twisted and generalized multifold extensions of affine type
arxiv:2610.25312.summary: Let $B$ be a piecewise hereditary algebra of affine type over an algebraically closed field. In this paper we give a derived and stable equivalence classification of twisted multifold extensions of $B$. The types $\widetilde D$ and $\widetilde E$ are already covered by the classification for tree type.

arxiv:2610.25321.title: Projective Decomposition and Intersection Cohomology of Rigid Spaces
arxiv:2610.25321.summary: We prove a rigid analytic analogue of the Beilinson--Bernstein--Deligne decomposition theorem for projective morphisms over $p$-adic fields, with $\mathbf{Q}_\ell$-coefficients for every prime $\ell$, including $\ell=p$. As an application, we show that the $p$-adic intersection cohomology of every proper rigid analytic space is de Rham. We also establish an independent criterion for de Rham intersection cohomology with local coefficients in terms of the dimension of the boundary, yielding further results for curves, surfaces, and finite covers.

arxiv:2610.25322.title: Critical limits of generating functions for face-constrained labelled planar maps
arxiv:2610.25322.summary: We study connected planar maps with a fixed number of numbered faces, whose vertices carry integer labels such that the minimum label along the boundary of each face is one. Each face has its own positive weight, and an edge shared by two faces receives the geometric mean of their weights. For any fixed number $k\ge3$ of faces, we prove that the suitably rescaled generating function converges locally uniformly as the face weights approach the critical value $1/12$, possibly at different positive rates.

arxiv:2610.25324.title: The Bellaterra graphs are Ramanujan
arxiv:2610.25324.summary: The Bellaterra automaton gives three involutions of every set of binary words of a fixed length. We identify their Schreier graph at level $n$ with a cubic arithmetic graph over $\Q(\sqrt{17})$, and prove that every nonconstant adjacency eigenvalue satisfies the Ramanujan bound. In particular, this proves Malyshev-Pak's Conjecture that the Bellaterra graphs form a family of two-sided expanders.

arxiv:2610.25355.title: A coupling normal form for reversible center-center Hamiltonians with application to the restricted three-body problem
arxiv:2610.25355.summary: Near a reversible center--center equilibrium, the Birkhoff normal form does not describe the families bifurcating from the continued tori, while resonant normal forms capture these bifurcations through a reduced system. For such equilibria with a reflection symmetry, we develop a coupling normal form in which the bifurcating families also appear as tori of action normal forms. Along a selected coupling direction, the first slow harmonic is absorbed into an action-dependent counterterm.

arxiv:2610.25363.title: Isotropy of symplectic involutions and motivic equivalence for groups of type $\sf{C}$
arxiv:2610.25363.summary: We extend to arbitrary characteristic a theorem due to Karpenko and Tignol on the isotropy of symplectic involutions after generic index reduction; as a consequence, we also prove the existence of critical varieties for semi-simple algebraic groups of type $\sf C$ over arbitrary base fields. The latter result relies on a characteristic-free argument, which involves the computation of the mod $2$ Tate trace of the variety of isotropic ideals of reduced dimension $2$ for a symplectic involution.
arxiv:2610.25363.authors: Demba Barry, Charles De Clercq, Anne Qu\'eguiner-Mathieu

arxiv:2610.25378.title: Generalized quaternion groups of order $4p$ are $4$-BCI-groups
arxiv:2610.25378.summary: For a finite group $G$ and a subset $S\subseteq G$, the bi-Cayley graph $\operatorname{BCay}(G,S)$ has vertex set $G\times\{0,1\}$ and edges $\{(x,0),(sx,1)\}$ for $x\in G$ and $s\in S$. The group $G$ is called an $m$-BCI-group if, for all subsets $S,T\subseteq G$ with $|S|\leq m$, the isomorphism $\operatorname{BCay}(G,S)\cong\operatorname{BCay}(G,T)$ implies that $T=gS^\alpha$ for some $g\in G$ and $\alpha\in\operatorname{Aut} G$. We prove that, for every prime $p$, the generalized quaternion group $Q_{4p}$ is a $4$-BCI-group.

arxiv:2610.25380.title: The Corners of Ramanujan: Partial- and False-Theta Companions to Third-Order Mock Theta Functions
arxiv:2610.25380.summary: Most of the traditional third-order mock theta functions occur naturally as specialized values of partition-rank generating functions. The same finite rank kernels also occur in the ordinary and odd unimodal-rank series studied previously in the literature. We organize a parallel collection of corner series by retaining these kernels and replacing their quadratic core weights by linear peak weights.
arxiv:2610.25380.authors: George E. Andrews, Mohamed El Bachraoui

arxiv:2610.25381.title: Inequalities for Higher-Order Logarithmic Differences of Boros--Moll Coefficients
arxiv:2610.25381.summary: Let $d_i(m)$ denote the coefficient of $x^i$ in the Boros--Moll polynomial $P_m(x)$. We prove that the sequence $\{d_{i-1}(m)d_{i+1}(m)/d_i(m)^2\}_{i=1}^{m-1}$ is strictly log-concave for every $m\ge4$, settling a conjecture of Chen and Gu. For every $m\ge 3$, we show that the consecutive ratios $d_i(m)/d_{i-1}(m)$ form a strictly log-convex sequence for $1\le i\le\lfloor m/2\rfloor+1$ and a strictly log-concave sequence for $\lfloor m/2\rfloor\le i\le m$, as conjectured by Zhao.
arxiv:2610.25381.authors: Cindy C. Y. Gu, Yafeng Liu, Matthew H. Y. Xie

arxiv:2610.25386.title: On the maximally edge-connected square graphs with degree sequence conditions
arxiv:2610.25386.summary: Let $G=(V(G),E(G))$ be a finite connected simple graph. The edge-connectivity $\lambda(G)$ of $G$ is the minimum number of edges that must be removed to make $G$ disconnected. We call $G$ maximally edge-connected when $\lambda(G)=\delta(G)$, where $\delta(G)$ is the minimum degree of $G$.

arxiv:2610.25393.title: $G$-birational rigidity of the $G$-Fano variety $\mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1$
arxiv:2610.25393.summary: We determine the $G$-birational rigidity of the $G$-Fano variety $\mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1$ for all finite subgroups $G$ of $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1)$.

arxiv:2610.25417.title: Torsion Cycles in Projective Threefolds:From Serre's Construction to Artin-Mumford
arxiv:2610.25417.summary: The torsion subgroup of third integral cohomology is a birational invariant of smooth projective complex threefolds; its nonvanishing obstructs stable rationality. We recall a proof using Hironaka's elimination of indeterminacies and the integral blowup formula. The Godeaux--Serre construction and Poincar\'e duality imply that every finite abelian group is the third integral cohomology group of a smooth projective complex threefold.

arxiv:2610.25428.title: Categorical Torelli theorem for smooth Fano varieties
arxiv:2610.25428.summary: Let $X$ be a smooth Fano variety and $H$ an ample line bundle with $-K_X=rH$ and $r\le\dim X-2$. We prove that the appropriately defined Kuznetsov component of $X$ with respect to $H$, together with its rotation functor, determines $(X,H)$ when $H$ is very ample, and more generally when $H$ is globally generated and the image of the morphism defined by $|H|$ has a hypersurface as projective dual. As a consequence we prove Perry's conjecture, which predicts that a smooth Fano variety $X$ is determined up to isomorphism by the orthogonal complement $\mathcal{O}_X^{\perp}$ of its structure sheaf in $\mathrm{D}^b(X)$, for all smooth Fano varieties of dimension at least three with very ample…

arxiv:2610.25430.title: Negative-Definite Plumbings and New Unknotting Numbers
arxiv:2610.25430.summary: We use Neumann's normal form to decide whether the double branched cover of a knot bounds a negative-definite plumbing tree in either orientation, starting from the recognised Seifert or graph-manifold structure of the cover. For many non-alternating knots with at most thirteen crossings whose unknotting numbers were unknown, this identifies the cases in which the Heegaard Floer homology of the cover can be computed from such a plumbing, and shows for most of the others that it cannot. We determine 112 new unknotting numbers.

arxiv:2610.25439.title: The Anyon Atlas
arxiv:2610.25439.summary: We classify possible topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions with up to 22 anyons in the bosonic case and up to 26 in the fermionic case, through the modular data of modular and supermodular tensor categories. We construct such data via congruence representations of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ using a numerical optimization algorithm that scales to high rank. We chart the relations between the resulting theories, including anyon condensations and Chern-Simons realizations.
arxiv:2610.25439.authors: Jonah Berean-Dutcher, Clay Cordova, Julio Parra-Martinez, Richard Tuddenham

arxiv:2610.25450.title: Semi-supervised learning on singular data sets
arxiv:2610.25450.summary: We propose to model singular data clouds by subanalytic sets, and develop an approach to semi-supervised learning in this setting. It relies on a Morrey-type embedding for Sobolev spaces relative to globally subanalytic measures with possibly singular support. As an illustration, we present a greedy method based on a Monte Carlo approximation of the Sobolev norm of the candidate solutions.

arxiv:2610.25451.title: An A-B-C Coordinate Encoding for Exact Boundary-Cycle Extraction on Hexagonal Lattices
arxiv:2610.25451.summary: We study an integer-coordinate encoding of boundary incidences for finite subsets of the regular hexagonal tiling. Each selected cell contributes six ordered records with endpoints in two role-distinguished classes, point and tail. Identical records from neighboring cells cancel, and the surviving records form a disjoint union of cycles, including the exterior boundaries of disconnected components and the boundaries of holes.

arxiv:2610.25465.title: Improvement of the Crossing Lemma for the odd-crossing number
arxiv:2610.25465.summary: A graph is called $1$-planar if it can be drawn in the plane so that every edge is crossed by at most one other edge. It is known that the maximum number of edges of $1$-planar graphs is $4n-8$. We prove the following generalization.

arxiv:2610.25483.title: On elements of degree $g$ in the separating semigroup of a real curve of genus $g$
arxiv:2610.25483.summary: Let $C$ be a separating real algebraic curve of genus $g$ whose real locus consists of $r$ components and let $S=\mathrm{Sep}(C)$ be its separating semigroup. An element $\delta\in S$ is called extendable if $\delta+\mathbb N_0^r\subset S$, where $\mathbb N_0=\{n\in\mathbb Z\mid n\ge 0\}$. We prove that an element of $S$ is extendable if it is realizable by a separating mobile divisor of degree $g$ and projective rank 1.
arxiv:2610.25483.authors: G. B. Mikhalkin, S. Yu. Orevkov

arxiv:2610.25485.title: An explicit Dennis trace and its compatibility with Koszul duality
arxiv:2610.25485.summary: In this paper, we construct explicit Dennis trace maps from algebraic $K$-theory to Hochschild homology for dg module and curved dg comodule categories, and prove their compatibility with derived Koszul duality. For this, we construct a natural chain map $\tau$ from the chains on the newly defined thickened nerve to the total complex of the dg cyclic nerve, with explicit formulas incorporating morphisms and coherent higher homotopies, which generalizes McCarthy's approach. This $\tau$ construction works both for modules over dg algebras and for cdg comodules over counital conilpotent curved dg coalgebras.

arxiv:2610.25491.title: Interpretations of the $\textbf{cd}$-index
arxiv:2610.25491.summary: We extend the recent work of Caster--Guyer--Samper (2026+) to establish a combinatorial interpretation of the $\textbf{cd}$-index for all $S$-partitionable posets, which includes all polytopes and $S$-shellable spheres. This interpretation is inductive on rank, but does not require passing to the order complex of the poset. We also provide topological interpretations of each $\textbf{cd}$-monomial.

arxiv:2610.25500.title: Torelli theorem for the moduli spaces of twisted vector bundles on smooth projective curves
arxiv:2610.25500.summary: We prove Torelli theorems for moduli space of twisted vector bundles on smooth projective curves over an arbitrary field of characteristic $\neq 2$. A twisted Hitchin construction recovers the curve in higher rank and degree, with partial recovery of the twisting class. For rank two with trivial determinant, we recover the curve and the Brauer class from the moduli stack through an ordered Kummer cover and its polarized Jacobian torsor.
arxiv:2610.25500.authors: Soham Ghosh, Ting Gong, Max Lieblich

arxiv:2610.25509.title: Equidistribution, multipliers, and moving targets in polynomial families
arxiv:2610.25509.summary: We study equidistribution of parameters for each of which a polynomial has a cycle with a prescribed moving multiplier in the full critically marked or unicritical polynomial families of a given degree $d>1$. For the full critically marked monic polynomial family $f=(f_\lambda)$, $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}^{d-1}$, of degree $d$, letting $p_{f,n}^*(\lambda,w)$ be the multiplier polynomial for cycles of formal exact period $n$ having multiplier $w$, we show that for any target sequence $w_n=d^na_n$ satisfying $n^{-1}\log|a_n|\to\ell\in[-\infty,+\infty)$, the averaged current of integration $\nu(n)^{-1}[p_{f,n}^*(\cdot,w_n)=0]$ along the zero divisor of $p_{f,n}^*(\cdot,w_n)$ tends to the…

arxiv:2610.25521.title: Lefschetz Properties of complete intersesctions and maximal variation of hyperplane sections
arxiv:2610.25521.summary: For an artinian complete intersection of forms of degree $d$, we prove that the multiplication by a general linear form is injective up to degree $\frac{3d-1}2$, independently of the number of variables. This is accomplished using algebraic and geometric properties of the union of two complete intersection curves and their general hyperplane sections. As a consequence, we solve, for any $d\ge 4$, the problem about the maximal variation of the hyperplane sections of a smooth hypersurface of degree $d$ posed by A.
arxiv:2610.25521.authors: Mats Boij, Juan C. Migliore, Rosa M. Mir\'o-Roig, Uwe Nagel

arxiv:2610.25532.title: The blow-up of the cubic fourfold along eight planes is Fano
arxiv:2610.25532.summary: We prove that the blow-up Z_m of a smooth cubic fourfold along m <= 8 planes, pairwise meeting at distinct points and satisfying explicit generality conditions, is a smooth Fano fourfold of Picard rank rho(Z_m) = m+1 <= 9; in particular, we obtain three new families of smooth Fano fourfolds with rho > 6 that are not a product of surfaces. Complementary to this result, we show that a smooth cubic fourfold as above exists. Moreover, we study the birational geometry of Z_m and show that it corresponds exactly to that of a smooth del Pezzo surfaces S_m, obtained as the blow-up of P^2 along m <= 8 points in general position.

arxiv:2610.25547.title: Combinatorics of Seaweed Meanders
arxiv:2610.25547.summary: We show that the index of a uniformly random seaweed meander satisfies a central limit theorem and is asymptotically equidistributed with respect to any modulus. We also extend work by Archer, Geary, and Laudone on the enumeration of seaweed meanders whose compositions have restricted parts. Finally, we give a connection to billiards in triangular shapes, which is related to a result of Eu, Fu, and Hsu.

arxiv:2610.25559.title: Expanding on Average Diffeomorphisms
arxiv:2610.25559.summary: We study the statistical properties of partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms with a two-dimensional center exhibiting mixed behavior, without assuming a dominated splitting inside the center. We introduce the notion of an expanding on average for partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism and, under a center jacobian assumption, we prove the existence of finitely many ergodic hyperbolic SRB measures, and show the strong positive recurrence property, which implies that each SRB measure, up to a period, satisfies exponential decay of correlations, among other strong statistical laws. We apply our results to several examples.
arxiv:2610.25559.authors: Pablo D. Carrasco, Davi Obata, Radu Saghin, Jiagang Yang

arxiv:2610.25562.title: On simplicial maps with non-zero Hopf invariant
arxiv:2610.25562.summary: In general, it is interesting to investigate the complexity of simplicial maps under various topological constraints. In this paper, we consider maps between (triangulated oriented rational homology) manifolds with non-zero Hopf invariant and establish bounds on the simplicial complexity of the fiber of a regular point. The lower bound, which is cubic in the dimension, is proved via a refinement of a theorem of S.

arxiv:2610.25564.title: Superschemes and supermanifolds with free $\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$-action
arxiv:2610.25564.summary: We prove that given an analytic supermanifold $X$ over a complete field on which the additive supergroup $\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$ of super-dimension $0|n$ acts freely (in an appropriate sense), the quotient $X/\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$ exists as an analytic supermanifold, and the canonical morphism $X \to X/\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$ is an $\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$-principal bundle. A stronger version of this result is proven for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds, whereby $X \to X/\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$ is a trivial $\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$-principal bundle. Previously, Polishchuk [18] established an algebro-geometric analogue, which proves that a superscheme $X$ with free $\mathbb{A}^{0|n}$-action gives rise to a locally trivial…

arxiv:2610.25587.title: Two Generalizations of the G_0 Dichotomy
arxiv:2610.25587.summary: We give classical proofs of the generalizations of the $\mathbb{G}_0$ dichotomy to $\kappa$-Souslin digraphs and uniformly analytic sequences of digraphs indexed by $\kappa^{\mathbb{N}}$.

arxiv:2610.25590.title: Equivariant deformation theory and deformations of homogeneous varieties
arxiv:2610.25590.summary: We show that, in characteristic $p$, almost all projective homogeneous varieties under a reductive group and with non-reduced stabilizer do not lift to characteristic $p^2$. To this end, first we develop a general framework for equivariant deformation theory, leading to practical criteria ensuring that the deformations of a scheme come with deformations of a group scheme action. Second, we establish a formula to compute the cohomology of equivariant vector bundles over projective homogeneous varieties with non-reduced stabilizer, enabling us to determine the $G$-module structure of the first cohomology groups of their tangent bundles.

arxiv:2610.25593.title: Biquandle Image Quivers
arxiv:2610.25593.summary: We introduce a new family of weighted quiver-valued invariants of oriented classical and virtual knots and link, surface-knots and surface-links, and immersed surface-knots and surface-links associated to finite biquandles. We derive several polynomial invariants from these quivers via decategorification. We provide examples to illustrate the computation of the invariant as well as toy examples showing tables of invariant values for small biquandles.
arxiv:2610.25593.authors: Geunyoung Kim, Sam Nelson, Puttipong Pongtanapaisan

arxiv:2610.25594.title: Upper bounds on the number of images produced by point-mass lenses at different distances
arxiv:2610.25594.summary: If a light source is sequentially lensed by $n$ intervening point-mass lenses at distinct distances, the number of isolated images for a generic source position cannot be greater than $2\cdot 3^{n-1}$. If lensing shear is present in each lens plane, the image counts could be as large as $4^n$, however. For a general multi-plane point-mass lens system, we also devise the recurrence for the BKK bound on the image counts, which is strictly less than Perry's bound due to the resultant degree for $n\ge 2$.

arxiv:2610.25597.title: Shifted quantum affine symmetric pairs: finite presentations and graded coideal structures
arxiv:2610.25597.summary: Shifted quantum affine symmetric pair algebras were recently introduced as a trigonometric analogue of shifted twisted Yangians, whose truncations are expected to quantize fixed point loci in generalized affine Grassmannian slices. They are defined via a loop presentation with infinitely many generators and relations. In this paper, we consider anti-dominantly shifted quantum affine symmetric pair algebras of simply-laced split type.

arxiv:2610.25602.title: On solutions to tropical Monge-Amp\`ere equations
arxiv:2610.25602.summary: This paper develops convex analysis on tropical varieties and investigates the properties of the tropical Monge-Amp\`ere equations. We start by introducing notions of plurisubharmonic functions and K\"ahler forms on arbitrary tropical varieties. We show that many classical results of pluripotential theory extend to this setting, including an analogue of Demailly's regularization theorem.
arxiv:2610.25602.authors: Omid Amini, Matthieu Piquerez, Lyuhui Wu

arxiv:2610.25606.title: Negative Values of Wahl's Second Chern Number for Normal Surface Singularities
arxiv:2610.25606.summary: We disprove Wahl's 1993 vanishing conjecture, open for more than thirty years, which asserts that $c_2^w(X)=0$ for every nonquotient normal surface singularity. Let $C$ be a smooth projective curve with a nontrivial involution having $r>0$ fixed points, and put $d=2g(C)-2$. If $d>r$, the union of the diagonal and the graph of the involution in $C\times C$ has negative definite intersection matrix and can be analytically contracted to a normal surface singularity $(X,o)$.

arxiv:2610.25615.title: Non-existence of negative weight derivations on Jacobian algebras
arxiv:2610.25615.summary: Let $S=\mathbb K[x_1,\cdots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring in $n$ variables with positive integer weights over a field $\mathbb K$ of characteristic zero. Let $f\in S$ be a weighted homogeneous polynomial such that the Jacobian algebra $$A=\left.S \middle/ \left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_1},\cdots,\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_n}\right)\right.$$ is a finite-dimensional $\mathbb K$-vector space. We prove that $A$ has no nonzero negative weight derivation, which confirms a conjecture of the third author.
arxiv:2610.25615.authors: Bingyi Chen, Zhiwen Liu, Stephen S. -T. Yau, Huaiqing Zuo

arxiv:2610.25618.title: Which Immersions into Euclidean Space are Boundary Immersions?
arxiv:2610.25618.summary: Here we study the problem of whether a given codimension one immersion $f$ of a closed and connected manifold into Euclidean space can be extended to an equidimensional immersion $F$ of some compact manifold $M$ whose restriction to the boundary parameterizes the image $S$ of $f$. Such an extension $F$ exists if and only if (i) simple conditions on orientations and wrapping numbers are satisfied and (ii) a distinguished finite subset of the first cohomology of $S$ with coefficients in a certain sheaf of finite groups contains the preferred point.

arxiv:2610.25624.title: Quantum symmetric spaces at roots of 1
arxiv:2610.25624.summary: We study the integral form of quantized coordinate algebras of symmetric spaces and its specializations at roots of unity. Our main tool is an integral localization, whose classical specialization recovers the open Borel orbit in the symmetric space. At a suitable odd root of unity, we prove that the quantum symmetric space is a finite projective module over its Frobenius center, which is canonically isomorphic to the classical coordinate algebra of the symmetric space.

arxiv:2610.25654.title: The classification of taut surface singularities via representations from logarithmic vector fields
arxiv:2610.25654.summary: We study logarithmic vector fields on exceptional cycles through finite-dimensional representations and recover Laufer's classification of taut normal complex surface singularities. For graphs with two nodes, restriction maps define representations of a fixed quiver, with dimensions bounded independently of the number of components and their self-intersections. We identify restriction cohomology with an extension group and use interval decomposition to reduce its vanishing to interpolation on a rational chain.

arxiv:2610.25672.title: On The Manin Constant
arxiv:2610.25672.summary: We prove the Manin constant conjecture for every optimal elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ and Stevens' Conjectures I and II. Our method adapts Hongbo Yin's congruence argument for cubic roots of modular functions to lifts of modular parametrizations through isogenies, using the unbounded denominators theorem of Calegari, Dimitrov and Tang.
arxiv:2610.25672.authors: Zhuoni Chi, Shurui Liu, Ping Nie

arxiv:2610.25706.title: Rational Points on Drinfeld Modular Curves of Prime Level
arxiv:2610.25706.summary: Let $q \ge 3$ be a prime power and let $\mathfrak{p} \subset \mathbf{F}_q[T]$ be a nonzero prime ideal of degree $d$. We prove that $Y_0(\mathfrak{p})(\mathbf{F}_q(T))=\emptyset$ if $d \ge 4$ is even or $d>q$, and that $Y_1(\mathfrak{p})(\mathbf{F}_q(T)) = \emptyset $ for every $d \ge 3$.

arxiv:2610.25715.title: Big Ramsey degrees and structures in relational languages
arxiv:2610.25715.summary: We establish a precompact transfer theorem for big Ramsey structures and a uniform envelope theorem for valuation hypergraphs. These yield big Ramsey structures for generic injective relational structures in languages with finitely many symbols of each positive arity, answering the existence part of Problem 6.3.2 of Balko et al. (arXiv:2110.08409), and refute Conjecture 4.7 of Braunfeld et al.

arxiv:2610.25732.title: Characteristic cycles and non-acyclicity classes for constructible \'etale sheaves
arxiv:2610.25732.summary: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism between smooth schemes over a perfect field $k$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a constructible sheaf on $X$ and $Z$ a closed subscheme of $X$ such that $f$ is $SS(\mathcal F)$-transversal outside $Z$. We construct a class supported on the non-transversal locus $Z$ by using the characteristic cycle $CC(\mathcal F)$ defined by T.
arxiv:2610.25732.authors: Kaicheng Bao, Jiangnan Xiong, Enlin Yang

arxiv:2610.25750.title: On the Hausdorff dimension of oscillatory motions in three-body problems
arxiv:2610.25750.summary: We show that for the Sitnikov example and for the restricted planar circular 3-body problem the set of oscillatory motions often has maximal Hausdorff dimension. Also, we construct Newhouse domains for both problems.

arxiv:2610.25772.title: A Fourier expansion principle for coherent cohomology of powers of Tate curves
arxiv:2610.25772.summary: In the case of the totally degenerate split degenerations given by fibered powers of Tate curves over $\mathbf{Z}[[q^{1/w}]]$, this article proves a Fourier expansion principle that applies to higher coherent (equivariant) cohomology classes of rigidified line bundles on the $\mathbf{Z}((q^{1/w}))$-fiber. We do not require any ampleness hypotheses. This generalizes a previous Fourier expansion principle due to Faltings--Chai that applies only to sections of ample line bundles; that version was used as a key step in their proof of their classification of polarized degenerations and thus in the construction of toroidal compactifications of moduli spaces of polarized abelian varieties.

arxiv:2610.25778.title: Free abelian group actions on projective fibered varieties
arxiv:2610.25778.summary: Let $X$ be an $n$-dimensional normal projective variety of Kodaira dimension $\kappa$ and $G$ an abelian subgroup of automorphisms such that all elements of $G\backslash \{\mathrm{id}\}$ are of positive entropy. Dinh and Sibony showed that $G$ is actually free abelian of rank $\le n-\kappa-1$. In this paper, we show that after replacing $G$ by a finite-index subgroup, there exists a G-Equivariant Minimal Model Program for the pair $(X, G)$ when $\mathrm{rank}(G)=n-\kappa-1$ and $\kappa>0$, and the very general fiber of the final model is a klt Calabi-Yau surface or a $Q$-abelian variety provided that the termination of flips holds in this setting.

arxiv:2610.25800.title: The Maximum Commute Time of Regular Graphs
arxiv:2610.25800.summary: For a connected simple regular graph $G$, let $\tau(G)$ be the maximum commute time for simple random walk, and let $t_n$ be the maximum of $\tau(G)$ over all such graphs of order $n$. Aldous and Fill conjectured that $t_n\sim3n^2/2$. We determine $t_n$ exactly and classify all maximizers for every even $n\geq10$ and every odd $n\geq15$; both thresholds are best possible.
arxiv:2610.25800.authors: Jing Huang, Xuezhu Liao, Jiaxin Tang

arxiv:2610.25817.title: The multiplicative Merino--Welsh inequality for chordal graphs
arxiv:2610.25817.summary: For a connected graph $G$, let $\tau(G)$, $\alpha(G)$ and $\alpha^*(G)$ denote its numbers of spanning trees, acyclic orientations and totally cyclic orientations, respectively. We prove that $\alpha(G)\alpha^*(G)\geq\tau(G)^2$ for every connected bridgeless chordal graph.
