arxiv:2610.25817.authors: Shaohan Xu, Fengming Dong, Kexiang Xu

arxiv:2610.25825.title: Cohomological Milnor Fibrations of Landau--Ginzburg Models
arxiv:2610.25825.summary: We study the global topology of \emph{fundamentally tame} Landau--Ginzburg (LG) models on complete K\"ahler manifolds. We first show that the superpotential $f$ is surjective onto $\mathbb{C}$, then prove that $f$ restricts to a locally trivial fibration over the set of its regular values, which yields a global generalization of the classical Milnor fibration and provides an Ehresmann-type fibration in the non-proper setting. Assuming that $f$ has finitely many critical points, we use a Morse-theoretic argument to show that the relative homology of $\bigl(M,f^{-1}(c)\bigr)$, for a regular value $c$, is concentrated in the middle degree and has rank equal to the global Milnor number $\mu_f$.

arxiv:2610.25828.title: Piercing spanned lines and hyperplanes
arxiv:2610.25828.summary: Motzkin, Gr\"unbaum, and Erd\H{o}s and Purdy asked how many noncollinear blue points can coexist with $t$ red points in the real plane if every blue-spanned line contains a red point. We prove that there are at most $2.35t-3$ blue points, even over the complex numbers. For the complex higher-dimensional problem of Campbell, Kroeker, and Lund, we prove $b_k(t)\le1.40k^2t$.

arxiv:2610.25829.title: A classification of the Nim-sequences for the two-element subtraction game with a single pass
arxiv:2610.25829.summary: In this paper, we provide a complete description of the preperiods, periodic lengths, and the Grundy-value sequences of two-element subtraction games with a single pass option.

arxiv:2610.25831.title: The global structure of bi-rotational self-shrinkers
arxiv:2610.25831.summary: We describe the global structure of the self-shrinkers of the mean curvature flow in $\mathbb{R}^{p+q+2}$ invariant under $O(p+1)\times O(q+1)$, without assuming properness or embeddedness. The main tool is a pair of piecewise monotone quantities along the profile curves, in the spirit of Hsiang's analysis of constant mean curvature hypersurfaces. We prove that every such self-shrinker other than the two invariant cylinders intersects both of them transversely, and all of them except the Clifford minimal cone are complete.

arxiv:2610.25838.title: A New Proof of Wei's Theorem
arxiv:2610.25838.summary: In the paper \emph{Structure and realizability for rational maps}, Wei proved the following. Let \(k\) nontrivial partitions of an integer \(d\ge 3\) be given, satisfying the Riemann--Hurwitz formula for the case of maps between two spheres. If \(k>\ell+1\), where \[ \ell=\min_i|\pi_i| \] is the shortest partition length, then there exists a rational map whose branch datum is given by these partitions.
arxiv:2610.25838.authors: Zhiqaing Wei, Mengyan Xing, Xingya Zhao

arxiv:2610.25863.title: On Multi-label radio Labelings of Graphs
arxiv:2610.25863.summary: We propose and study a multi-labeling generalization of the $k$-radio labeling problem of graphs: given a graph $G$ and integers $k$ and $m$, assign to each vertex of $G$ a set of $m$ integer labels such that distinct labels assigned to a vertex differ by at least $k+1$, and the labels of any two distinct vertices $x$ and $y$ pairwise differ by at least $k+1-d(x,y)$, with $d(x,y)$ being the distance between vertices $x$ and $y$. We prove general bounds on the minimum span of such a labeling and more refined results for the case $k=1$. For paths and cycles, we derive sharp bounds on the minimum span when $k$ is small.

arxiv:2610.25868.title: Terao's freeness conjecture for arrangements of 15 and 16 lines
arxiv:2610.25868.summary: We prove that Terao's freeness conjecture holds for arrangements of 15 and of 16 lines in the complex projective plane. Together with the theorem of Barakat and K\"uhne for at most 14 hyperplanes, this shows that freeness of a central arrangement of at most 16 planes in $\mathbb{C}^3$ is determined by its intersection lattice. The proof has a theoretical and a computational part.

arxiv:2610.25878.title: Non-planar contact structures with Calabi-Yau Fillings and topological quantum computation
arxiv:2610.25878.summary: This paper is a non-planar counterpart of the author's earlier work on planar contact structures and topological quantum computation. There the page is planar and all branch points are paired by disjoint liftable arcs, compatibly with the joint eigenlines of the Ising representation and with Calabi-Yau (CY) Stein fillings, those with vanishing first Chern class. Here the page has genus g and connected binding, presented as a simple degree-three cover of the disk.

arxiv:2610.25886.title: Extremal arborescences in graph orientations
arxiv:2610.25886.summary: In this paper, we study the extremal number of arborescences over orientations of a fixed graph. We prove that every alternating orientation of a plane Eulerian multigraph minimizes the rooted arborescence count among its Eulerian orientations. We also prove that every tournament of odd order maximizing the total number of arborescences is regular, and hence Eulerian.

arxiv:2610.25891.title: On the group of automorphisms of the escaping sets of H\'{e}non maps
arxiv:2610.25891.summary: In this article, we provide an explicit description of $\operatorname{Aut}_1(I_H^+)$, the group of automorphisms of the escaping set $I_H^+$ of a H\'enon map that induce the identity on its fundamental group. More precisely, for a H\'enon map $H(x,y)=(y,p(y)-\delta x),$ where $p$ is a polynomial of degree $d\geq 2$ and $\delta\neq 0$, we show that $\operatorname{Aut}_1(I_H^+)$ is completely determined by the degree and the coefficients of $p$. Thus, the automorphism group of the escaping set, subject to the prescribed topological constraint, can be explicitly characterized in terms of the underlying H\'enon map.

arxiv:2610.25902.title: Exact extremizers for $\ell_p$-judicious bisections of triangle-free graphs
arxiv:2610.25902.summary: Balogh, Clemen and Lidick\'y asked how large the minimum $\ell_p$-norm of the internal-edge counts over balanced partitions of an $n$-vertex triangle-free graph can be. For each fixed $2<p<\infty$ and all sufficiently large even $n$, we determine this value exactly for bisections and characterize all extremal graphs. They are precisely the complete bipartite graphs $K_{a,n-a}$ for which $a\le n/2$ maximizes an explicit integer objective.

arxiv:2610.25905.title: Invitation to torso parameters of annotated graphs
arxiv:2610.25905.summary: An annotated graph is a pair $(G,S)$, where $G$ is a graph and $S$ is a subset of vertices of $G$. We present a unified approach for definitions of annotated versions of classical graph parameters such as treewidth, pathwidth, treedepth, etc. A generic way to incorporate a distinguished set of vertices into a graph parameter is via torsos.
arxiv:2610.25905.authors: Ma\"el Dumas, J\k{e}drzej Hodor, Tomasz Mazur, Piotr Micek, Cl\'ement Rambaud, Giannos Stamoulis

arxiv:2610.25951.title: The existence of symmetric cyclic Steiner quadruple systems
arxiv:2610.25951.summary: A Steiner quadruple system of order $v$, denoted by $\operatorname{SQS}(v)$, is called cyclic if it admits $\mathbb Z_v$ as a group of automorphisms acting regularly on its point set. A cyclic system is called symmetric cyclic, or S-cyclic, if the multiplier $-1$ preserves each block orbit individually. Grannell and Griggs conjectured in 1983 that such a system of order $v$ exists if and only if $v\equiv2,4,10,20\pmod{24}$ and every odd prime divisor $p$ of $v$ satisfies $p\equiv1$ or $5\pmod{12}$.

arxiv:2610.25956.title: Tur\'{a}n coefficients of signed graphs
arxiv:2610.25956.summary: We use spectral methods to determine Tur\'an coefficients of signed graphs under containment that preserves negative edges and allows positive edges to be realized by either sign. For a fixed forbidden signed graph $\sF$ with at least one edge, the coefficient $\tht(\sF)$ is the supremum of the weights $\rho\ge1$ for which every $\sF$-free signed graph $\sG$ of order $n$ satisfies $e^+(\sG)+\rho e^-(\sG)\le\binom n2+o(n^2)$. We prove a variational characterization of the weighted extremal density and show that $\tht(\sF)=1+1/L(\sF)$, where $L(\sF)$ is the supremum of the adjacency spectral radii of $\sF$-admissible graphs.

arxiv:2610.25958.title: Size Ramsey numbers of star forests with two components on one side
arxiv:2610.25958.summary: We determine the size Ramsey number of a two-component star forest versus an arbitrary star forest. Let $q,a,b,n_1,\ldots,n_q$ be positive integers with $a\ge b$ and $n_1\ge\cdots\ge n_q$. We prove that \[ \begin{split} \rhat\left(K_{1,a}\sq K_{1,b}, \bigsqcup_{i=1}^{q}K_{1,n_i}\right) ={}&(a+n_1-1) +\sum_{i=1}^{q-1}\max\{a+n_{i+1}-1,b+n_i-1\}\\ &+(b+n_q-1).

arxiv:2610.25971.title: When vector abundance constrains vector-borne transmission: inside epidemic dynamics within a prescribed population
arxiv:2610.25971.summary: The global burden of vector-borne diseases continues to rise, presenting escalating challenges to public health and agricultural systems. Their expanding geographic range and associated impacts underscore the need for tools to project disease dynamics and evaluate interventions. Mechanistic compartmental host--vector models provide such a framework by explicitly representing transmission processes.
arxiv:2610.25971.authors: Lise Isnel (BioSP), Julien Papa{\"i}x (BioSP), Olivier Bonnefon (BioSP), Samuel Soubeyrand (BioSP), Lionel Roques (BioSP)

arxiv:2610.25983.title: Complex Analytic Structure of Hybrid Classes of Generalized Polynomial-like Mappings
arxiv:2610.25983.summary: In this paper, we study hybrid classes of generalized polynomial-like mappings. We show that locally they are complex analytic submanifolds with finite codimension equal to the total order of critical points in the filled Julia set (counting multiplicity).
arxiv:2610.25983.authors: Miaokeyan Lin, Weixiao Shen, Yimin Wang

arxiv:2610.26018.title: Bernoulli property for skew products of exponentially mixing systems over Anosov bases
arxiv:2610.26018.summary: We study $C^{1+\beta}$ skew products over topologically mixing Anosov diffeomorphisms, with fiber dynamics generated by a locally free $\mathbb{R}^k$-action. For a Gibbs measure on the base and a cocycle with a nonzero average, we establish a Bernoulli criterion for ergodic invariant product measures. The fiber hypotheses apply to actions that are exponentially mixing with respect to the SRB measure, as well as volume measures that are almost exponentially mixing with a limit SRB measure.

arxiv:2610.26028.title: Twisted logarithmic de Rham complexes and the rational hit conjecture
arxiv:2610.26028.summary: We study the top degree concentration property for the cohomology of twisted logarithmic de Rham complexes of multiarrangements of hyperplanes. Our main tool is a short exact sequence of twisted logarithmic de Rham complexes based on the deletion-restriction exact sequences for logarithmic differential forms found recently by Abe and Denham. We prove a number of general results that can be used to establish the top degree cohomology concentration property, and also establish that property for some families of multiarrangements.

arxiv:2610.26037.title: MONODROMY AND BIG QUANTUM COHOMOLOGY OF HYPERPLANE SECTIONS OF (CO)ADJOINT VARIETIES
arxiv:2610.26037.summary: We study the monodromy representation of general hyperplane sections of (co)adjoint varieties. We apply this result to reduce the generic semisemplicity of the big quantum cohomology to its ambient part, and to prove that the big quantum cohomology of general hyperplane sections of IGr(2, 6) is generically semisimple and satisfies Dubrovin's conjecture.
arxiv:2610.26037.authors: Vladimiro Benedetti (LJAD), Simone Billi (CMLS), Nicolas Perrin (CMLS)

arxiv:2610.26044.title: Lagrangian invariant tori for completely resonant nonlinear Schr{\"o}dinger equations
arxiv:2610.26044.summary: We study small solutions of the parameterless nonlinear Schr{\"o}dinger equations on the circle. In this regime, the nonlinearity is perturbative and the system is thus nearly integrable. We prove the persistence, in the presence of nonlinearity, of full-dimensional tori.

arxiv:2610.26048.title: New Maximum Hermitian $d$-Codes and New Invariants from Skew Polynomial Rings
arxiv:2610.26048.summary: Maximum rank-distance codes were introduced independently by Delsarte (1978) and Gabidulin (1985) for unrestricted matrix spaces, and their study was subsequently extended to the classical form spaces of alternating, symmetric, and Hermitian matrices. For Hermitian $d$-codes, Schmidt (2018) established the upper bound and constructed optimal additive codes for all admissible parameters except when $n$ and $d$ are both even and $4\le d\le n-2$. We settle this final open existence case, more generally, construct additive maximum Hermitian rank-metric codes for every admissible length and minimum distance.

arxiv:2610.26061.title: Single-graph rational exponents in mixed multicolour Ramsey theory
arxiv:2610.26061.summary: For every rational number $\gamma>1$, we construct a fixed bipartite graph $H_\gamma$ such that $r_k(H_\gamma;K_N)=\Theta_{\gamma,k}((N/\log N)^\gamma)$ for every fixed $k\ge 3$. Here $r_k(H;K_N)=r(H,\ldots,H,K_N)$, with $k$ copies of $H$. The lower bound uses a symmetric random algebraic graph which avoids a fixed rooted power and has sufficiently strong local density for the Alon-Rodl method.

arxiv:2610.26074.title: Gauss-Manin connection in disguise: limiting periods and quasi-Jacobi forms
arxiv:2610.26074.summary: We construct a six-dimensional algebraic moduli space of elliptic curves equipped with two ordered marked points, an enhanced relative de Rham frame, and a nonzero tensor of endpoint tangents. Its normalized period map is a biholomorphism. On the classical period locus, the regular coordinates pull back under its inverse to Weierstrass, Eisenstein, and theta functions.

arxiv:2610.26085.title: Counting Irreducible Components of the Semistable Global Nilpotent Cone
arxiv:2610.26085.summary: We discuss various methods for parametrizing and counting irreducible components of the global nilpotent cone of semistable $G$-Higgs bundles on a smooth complex curve. By restricting our study to the case of generically regular components following previous work of Faergeman and Raskin, we obtain explicit counts of semistable generically regular irreducible components for $G = \mathrm{SL}_n$, and give the first examples of such counts outside type A. These numbers are obtained by counting points in some natural polytopes associated to $G$, but our method requires a finer analysis in cases where the center of the group $G$ is disconnected.

arxiv:2610.26092.title: Millicharged particles and the degree-3 Prouhet-Tarry-Escott problem
arxiv:2610.26092.summary: We use geometry to solve a problem in arithmetic relevant for physics. Namely, for any $m$ we find all integer solutions to the equations $\sum_{i=1}^m x_i^k = \sum_{i=1}^m y_i^k$, where $k \in \{1,2,3\}$; this seems to be new for $m \geq 5$. In physics, these are the anomaly cancellation conditions for models with $m$ fermions which can be naturally light and carry small electric charges (a.k.a. millicharged or minicharged particles).

arxiv:2610.26109.title: An $8+9$ gluing computation for the Ramsey number $R(F_3,F_4)$
arxiv:2610.26109.summary: Let $F_t$ be the graph consisting of $t$ triangles with a common vertex and otherwise disjoint vertices. We prove that $R(F_3,F_4)=17$ using an $8+9$ gluing computation. Neighbourhood matching arguments give degree and clique restrictions that reduce the search on seventeen vertices to $88,294,674$ ordered seed pairs.

arxiv:2610.26119.title: Local structure of sumsets and projections of self-affine carpets
arxiv:2610.26119.summary: We show that if $X$ and $Y$ are self-similar sets in $\mathbb{R}$ with multiplicatively independent contraction ratios, then the Assouad dimension of $X+Y$ is one. As an application, we show that for a large class of self-affine carpets, the Assouad dimension of any non-principal orthogonal projection is one. The latter result is new even for the simplest case of Bedford-McMullen carpets.

arxiv:2610.26122.title: The Erd\H{o}s--Ginzburg--Ziv theorem for finite groups
arxiv:2610.26122.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, and let $p$ be the smallest prime divisor of $|G|$. The Gao constant $\mathsf{E}(G)$ is the least integer $\ell$ such that every sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ contains a subsequence of length $|G|$ whose terms can be ordered to have product equal to the identity. In 1961, Erd\H{o}s, Ginzburg and Ziv proved that every sequence of $2n-1$ integers has an $n$-term subsequence whose sum is divisible by $n$; equivalently, $\mathsf{E}(C_n)\leq 2n-1$, where $C_n$ denotes the cyclic group of order $n$.

arxiv:2610.26125.title: Unimodular defect and antipodal lattice points of smooth reflexive polytopes
arxiv:2610.26125.summary: Let $P$ be a smooth reflexive polytope and let $Q=P^{*}$ be the dual of smooth Fano polytope. Ewald's conjecture (1988) predicts that the lattice points of $P\cap (-P)$ contain a lattice basis. In general it is not even known whether $P\cap (-P)$ contains a nonzero lattice point; we call this weakest form of the conjecture the antipodal condition.

arxiv:2610.26132.title: On the Peak Estimation of Scalar Polynomial Systems via Integrability
arxiv:2610.26132.summary: We develop a convergent occupation measure framework for peak estimation of scalar polynomial dynamical systems with no a priori state bound. The key observation is that scalar trajectories satisfy a uniform weighted integrability bound whose exponent precisely compensates for the singularity introduced by polynomial compactification. This yields a finite measure formulation with polynomial data.

arxiv:2610.26133.title: Ampleness of non-symmetric line bundles on degenerations of abelian varieties
arxiv:2610.26133.summary: Answering a 1985 question of Moret-Bailly, we prove by way of counterexample that if a line bundle $\mathscr{L}$ on a degeneration of abelian varieties $G \to \mathrm{Spec}(R)$ is not symmetric, then $\mathscr{L}$ being ample on $G$ is not necessarily equivalent to $\mathscr{L}$ being ample on the generic fiber of $G$. Our technique of proof is to use the Fourier expansion principle for sections of line bundles on degenerations, due to Faltings--Chai and Lan.

arxiv:2610.26152.title: $L^p$-Khinchin sequences and transference principles
arxiv:2610.26152.summary: A sequence \((\lambda_n)_{n\ge1}\) of distinct positive integers is called an \(L^p\)-Khinchin sequence, where $1\le p\le\infty$, if $ n^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^n f(\lambda_k x) \longrightarrow \int_{\mathbb T}f\,d\mathfrak m $ a.e. $x\in\mathbb T$ for every \(f\in L^p(\mathbb T)\). When $1\le p<\infty$, we characterize the \(L^p\)-Khinchin sequences by a weak $(p,p)$ maximal inequality for the associated averaging operators.
arxiv:2610.26152.authors: Aihua Fan, Shilei Fan, Tongjin Li

arxiv:2610.26167.title: Ramsey expansions of $S$-metric spaces
arxiv:2610.26167.summary: Let $S\subseteq \mathbb R^+$ be a subset of positive reals. We say that a metric space is an $S$-metric space if the range of the metric is a subset of $S\cup \{0\}$. In 2007, Delhomm\'{e}, Laflamme, Pouzet, and Sauer characterized those sets $S$ for which the class of all finite $S$-metric spaces has the amalgamation property.
arxiv:2610.26167.authors: Jan Hubi\v{c}ka, Mat\v{e}j Kone\v{c}n\'{y}, Jaroslav Ne\v{s}et\v{r}il, Norbert Sauer

arxiv:2610.26186.title: On the hyperplane conjecture
arxiv:2610.26186.summary: We prove the hyperplane conjecture, proposed by Hosono, Lian, and Yau in arXiv:alg-geom/9511001 and its generalization to orbifolds. Consequently, this establishes the expected equivalence between the \(A\) model (genus-zero Gromov--Witten invariants with ambient insertions) of \(X\) and the \(B\) model (period integrals corresponding to vanishing cohomology) of \(X^{\vee}\) for Batyrev's mirror pair of Calabi--Yau hypersurfaces. As an application of our method, we also identify the residue of the Gauss--Manin connection and the cup product morphism on the \(A\)-side.

arxiv:2610.26191.title: Pellarin Values from Cauchy Coordinates on Arbitrary Curves
arxiv:2610.26191.summary: Let $A$ be the ring of functions regular outside a closed point of degree $\mathrm{N}$ on a smooth projective curve over $\mathbb{F}_q$. We express the normalized weight-one ideal Pellarin value of a rank-one Drinfeld $A$-module as an ordinary Hilbert-class trace of rational Cauchy differentials. A pairing on projective period lattices identifies the differential associated with each ideal class and computes its coefficients by finite torsion traces.
arxiv:2610.26191.authors: Chuangqiang Hu, Stephen S. -T. Yau, Lishan Yu

arxiv:2610.26196.title: Simple-shifted monoidal derived equivalences for tensor categories
arxiv:2610.26196.summary: In this paper, we investigate monoidal derived equivalences between tensor categories with infinitely many isomorphism classes of simple objects. We introduce the notion of a simple-shifted monoidal derived equivalence and prove that a simple-shifted monoidal derived equivalence gives rise to a tensor equivalence. In addition, we investigate which tensor categories have the property that every monoidal derived equivalence between them is necessarily simple-shifted, and we establish some sufficient conditions for this property.

arxiv:2610.26224.title: Input-to-Output Stability and Consensus Control of Opinion Dynamics on Graph State-Space
arxiv:2610.26224.summary: This paper proposes a modeling of opinion dynamics in social systems with evolving structures on the Graph State-Space. It builds upon the Hegselmann-Krause (HK) model with variable influence weights, integrated into a hybrid dynamical systems framework where structural changes (agent addition/removal) are induced by inputs. We establish an Inputto-Output Stability (IOS) result under a strong connectivity assumption, using a nonsmooth Lyapunov function based on the opinion diameter; we show that the consensus expansion is then bounded by the maximal deviation of incoming agents relative to the existing convex hull.
arxiv:2610.26224.authors: Arthur Doliveira (DIAPRO), Christophe Roman (DIAPRO), Guillaume Graton (DIAPRO), Mustapha Ouladsine

arxiv:2610.26230.title: Entropy and periodic points in pseudo-Anosov isotopy classes
arxiv:2610.26230.summary: Let $f$ be a pseudo-Anosov homeomorphism of a closed orientable surface of genus at least two. We prove that, for every $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism $g$ isotopic to $f$, the exponential growth rate of the number of nonempty Nielsen classes of its iterates equals $h_{\mathrm{top}}(g)$ if and only if $h_{\mathrm{top}}(g)=h_{\mathrm{top}}(f)$. Thus Nielsen growth captures the full entropy precisely for representatives minimizing entropy in their isotopy class.
arxiv:2610.26230.authors: Pablo D. Carrasco, Federico Rodriguez-Hertz, Jana Rodriguez-Hertz, Ra\'ul Ures

arxiv:2610.26243.title: Families that intersect in an arithmetic progression
arxiv:2610.26243.summary: For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\mu_n$ be the uniform measure on $2^{[n]}$. A family $\mathcal F \subseteq2^{[n]}$ is called $k$-AP-intersecting if $F_1\cap F_2$ contains a nonconstant $k$-term arithmetic progression for every $F_1, F_2\in\mathcal F$. Writing $m_k$ for the supremum of $\mu_n(\mathcal F)$ over all $n$ and all such families $\mathcal F$, we prove \[ 2^{-k}\le m_k\le32\cdot 2^{-k}\qquad(k\ge3).
arxiv:2610.26243.authors: Andrey Kupavskii, Fedor Noskov, Georgy Sokolov, Nikolai Terekhov

arxiv:2610.26259.title: Structural aspects of $1$-limited domination in cubic graphs
arxiv:2610.26259.summary: A set $D\subseteq V(G)$ is a $1$-limited dominating set of a graph $G$ if every vertex outside $D$ has a neighbor in $D$ and every vertex of $D$ has at most one neighbor outside $D$. The minimum cardinality among all $1$-limited dominating sets of $G$ is denoted by $\gamma_1^{\mathrm L}(G)$. For every cubic graph $G$ of order $n$, there exists a nonnegative integer $t$ such that $\gamma_1^{\mathrm L}(G)=\frac n2+t$.
arxiv:2610.26259.authors: Goran Radi\'c, Gordana Radi\'{c}, Aleksandra Tepeh

arxiv:2610.26288.title: Adelic Asphericity and One-Relator Pro-\(p\) Groups
arxiv:2610.26288.summary: We give a direct Fox-calculus proof of the known rational asphericity theorem for every finite presentation complex with one nontrivial relator, including proper powers. The proof uses completed Fox derivatives and the absence of zero divisors in the completed algebra of a prounipotent group. Exact scalar extension to the finite adeles then yields adelic asphericity and a product decomposition of the higher homotopy groups of integral Bousfield--Kan completion.

arxiv:2610.26294.title: Flip classes and elementary expansions of vertical-strip LLT polynomials
arxiv:2610.26294.summary: After the substitution $q\mapsto q+1$, vertical-strip LLT polynomials are weighted sums of strict $P$-partition generating functions indexed by orientations of decorated unit-interval graphs, with weight $q^{\mathrm{asc}(\theta)}$. A flip moves an ascending edge across a triangle while keeping its long edge. We show that the sum over every flip class is elementary-positive: it equals the sum of the elementary symmetric functions given by the highest reachable vertices of its orientations.

arxiv:2610.26300.title: The rank of the random $k$-XORSAT matrix beyond satisfiability
arxiv:2610.26300.summary: The random $k$-XORSAT matrix is an $m\times n$ random matrix $\mathbf A$ over $\mathbb F_2$ that represents a random instance of the $k$-XORSAT problem. Each row of $\mathbf A$ contains precisely $k\geq3$ non-zero entries in random positions. The rows are drawn independently.

arxiv:2610.26302.title: Additive invariants of Finite-dimensional DG-algebras
arxiv:2610.26302.summary: Orlov has shown that additive invariants such as K-theory and Hochschild homology of smooth finite-dimensional DG-algebras behave similarly to those of finite-dimensional algebras. The similarities only go so far: there are examples of finite-dimensional DG-algebras with vanishing and uncountable Grothendieck groups. We show that for DG-quivers with relations, the Grothendieck groups are free of the expected rank and that, in the smooth case, all additive invariants are determined by the base field.

arxiv:2610.26303.title: The e-positivity of $\mathrm{rowDiv}_k(e_\mu)$
arxiv:2610.26303.summary: We prove that the partition division operator $\mathrm{rowDiv}_k$ preserves e-positivity, resolving a conjecture of Alexandersson and Dai. For $\mu\vdash kn$ and $\nu\vdash n$, we express the coefficient of $e_\nu$ in $\mathrm{rowDiv}_k(e_\mu)$ as a normalized sum of positive rational weights over closed walks on a finite directed graph of $k$-restricted partitions. The proof combines the Pieri rule and a root of unity factorization for Macdonald polynomials.

arxiv:2610.26341.title: A vertex operator algebra for the S-fold realisation of a non-unitary Haagerup--Izumi modular fusion category
arxiv:2610.26341.summary: We show that there exists a strongly rational vertex operator algebra $V_{11}$, proposed by Flohr, whose representation theory $\mathrm{Rep}\,V_{11}\simeq\mathrm{Sem}\otimes\mathcal Z(\sigma_2\mathcal F)$ as braided categories. Here $\mathrm{Sem}$ is the semion category (with the spherical structure in which its generator has dimension $-1$), $\mathcal F$ is Ostrik's twisted Haagerup category and $\sigma_2$ is the Galois automorphism $\zeta_{117}\mapsto\zeta_{117}^2$.

arxiv:2610.26345.title: On the notion of $\mathbb{A}^1$-coverings
arxiv:2610.26345.summary: We introduce the notion of $\mathbb{A}^1$-$n$-coverings and begin the development of their theory over an arbitrary base scheme $S$, in analogy to that of higher coverings in an $\infty$-topos. We show that for $n=0$, our notion recovers Morel's $\mathbb{A}^1$-coverings between simplicial sheaves. Under suitable assumptions, we then provide a Galois-theoretic classification of $\mathbb{A}^1$-$n$-coverings.

arxiv:2610.26354.title: Fate of Arnold tongues and canards in Mobius systems with noise
arxiv:2610.26354.summary: We consider a class of noisy dynamical systems on the two-dimensional torus whose phase evolution is governed by Mobius transformations. In the deterministic limit, these systems favor phase-locking that is described by the band-gap structure of an associated Schrodinger equation with a periodic potential. We use the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin method to characterize this structure in the slow-fast limit.

arxiv:2610.26361.title: Simulation-free approximate Bayesian computation for stochastic reaction networks
arxiv:2610.26361.summary: Uncovering stochastic reaction networks from data is central to single-cell biology. Simulation-based inference has evolved into a flexible paradigm for this purpose, circumventing the computational intractability of the likelihood. Notably, approximate Bayesian computation performs this inference by carrying out extensive Gillespie simulations, usually at a high computational cost.
arxiv:2610.26361.authors: Zekai Li, Mauricio Barahona, Philipp Thomas

arxiv:2610.26364.title: A Sarkisov Involution from a Rational Cubic Curve on a Quartic Double Solid
arxiv:2610.26364.summary: Building on an earlier classification of smooth weak Fano threefolds of Picard number two with small anticanonical morphism, we prove that Case~28 of the table of E1-E1 links from that classification is geometrically realizable. We construct the link by blowing up a smooth rational cubic curve on a degree-two del Pezzo threefold $V_2$, realized as a quartic double solid. A lattice calculation on an anticanonical K3 surface shows that the anticanonical morphism of the blow-up is small, and the covering involution of the anticanonical double cover realizes the flop.

arxiv:2610.26366.title: Homotopy distributions for Vietoris-Rips complexes of random circle samples
arxiv:2610.26366.summary: We determine the distribution of the homotopy type of the Vietoris-Rips complex of a fixed number of independent uniform points on a circle. An exact identity expresses each binomial moment of a periodic-orbit count as one probability for circular gaps, multiplied by a constant avoidance factor. We evaluate these probabilities by finite lattice-point counts and interpolation, obtaining explicit formulas for every sample size and every real scale.
arxiv:2610.26366.authors: Jaemin Park (Department of Mathematics,Research Institute of Natural Sciences, Sookmyung Women's University)

arxiv:2610.26382.title: Semiclassical measures for quantized elliptic and parabolic symplectic linear maps of the multidimensional torus
arxiv:2610.26382.summary: We study the semiclassical measures associated to the quantum map on the torus obtained by quantizing integer symplectic linear maps, focusing on periodic matrices and certain parabolic matrices. More precisely, we consider the time-one map of the completely integrable flows generated by Hamiltonians of the form H(x, $\xi$) = Q($\xi$)/2 where Q is an integral quadratic form. We prove that the set of semiclassical measures associated to a periodic matrix A coincides with the set of invariant probability measures of A.

arxiv:2610.26388.title: Pointwise convergence of bilinear ergodic averages for commuting transformations
arxiv:2610.26388.summary: Let $(X,\mathcal B,\mu)$ be a probability space and let $S,Q:X\to X$ be commuting probability-preserving transformations. Let $1\leq p,q\leq\infty$ satisfy $1/p+1/q\leq1$. We prove that, for every fixed $F\in L^p(\mu)$ and $G\in L^q(\mu)$, the averages $$ \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N F(S^nx)G(Q^nx) $$ converge almost everywhere as $N\to\infty$.
arxiv:2610.26388.authors: Zhuowen Guo, Rongzhong Xiao, Shuhao Zhang

arxiv:2610.26389.title: Decomposing the Action of Macdonald Operators for Classical Types
arxiv:2610.26389.summary: We study Macdonald operators associated to classical root systems of types $B_N$, $C_N$, and $D_N$. We provide explicit formulas for decomposing the cumulative action of these operators as the sum of the actions of lower-rank operators and auxiliary operators. We also discuss the same idea in the elliptic case, also known as Ruijsenaars operators, and show that under the trigonometric limit, the identity reduces to type-$A_N$ decomposition.

arxiv:2610.26400.title: Topological mapping class groups of non-simply connected 4-manifolds
arxiv:2610.26400.summary: We construct topological isotopy invariants of homeomorphisms of non-simply connected 4-manifolds using the topological Dax invariant of disks and the Freedman-Quinn invariant of spheres. Our invariants are effective for various non-smoothable 4-manifolds without assuming that the fundamental groups are good. They detect infinite-rank free abelian direct factors of the pseudoisotopy-trivial and homotopy-trivial mapping class groups, and give lower bounds on the Pr\"ufer rank of the Torelli groups modulo homotopy-trivial mapping classes, including examples of infinite Pr\"ufer rank.

arxiv:2610.26403.title: Power-of-two cycles in projective cubic graphs of large edge-width
arxiv:2610.26403.summary: Heckman and Krakovski proved that every 3-connected cubic planar graph contains a cycle of length 2^m for some 2 $\le$ m $\le$ 7. We extend this to 3-connected cubic graphs embedded in the real projective plane with face-width at least three and edge-width at least 48; the cycle may moreover be taken contractible. The argument passes to the spherical double cover, where the planar theorem provides the cycle inside a subgraph of diameter at most 47, and the condition on the edge-width guarantees that this subgraph projects injectively.

arxiv:2610.26441.title: Uniformly hyperbolic strictly convex billiards
arxiv:2610.26441.summary: Can a strictly convex billiard be ergodic? For the billiard in a suitable intersection of two circles, we establish \emph{uniform} expansion of vectors in an invariant cone family under the return to a well-chosen section. This is the first and most onerous step towards a forthcoming proof of ergodicity (the Chen--Mohr--Zhang--Zhang conjecture) and statistical properties.

arxiv:2610.26518.title: Kawamata-Viehweg and Lipman's vanishings for sequences of blow-ups at regular closed points
arxiv:2610.26518.summary: The birational Kawamata-Viehweg vanishing theorem (KVV for short) is known to hold in considerable generality in equal characteristic zero, but fails in general in positive characteristic. We study a vanishing conjecture of Lipman for sequences of blow-ups at closed points of the spectrum of a regular local ring. We prove the conjecture when the ring has dimension at most three.

arxiv:2610.26522.title: Geometric parameter sequences for $Q$-polynomial distance-regular graphs
arxiv:2610.26522.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a distance-regular graph with diameter $D \geq 3$, and let $\theta$ be a nonzero eigenvalue of $\Gamma$ distinct from its valency. Motivated by the geometric parameter sequences of geometric distance-regular graphs, we introduce analogous sequences defined recursively from the intersection numbers of $\Gamma$ and $\theta$, without assuming a geometric structure. We show that the recursion is well defined if and only if all terms of the standard sequence corresponding to $\theta$ are nonzero and consecutive terms are distinct.
arxiv:2610.26522.authors: Jae-Ho Lee, Jongyook Park, Ian Seong

arxiv:2610.26523.title: Counting Lattice Points in Translations: Uniqueness and Existence Results
arxiv:2610.26523.summary: Generalizing a recent theorem by Higashitani et al. (Comb. Theory 2025), it is shown that a convex body $K$ is uniquely described up to integer translation by the function $\mathrm{t}_K(v) = |(K-v)\cap\mathbb{Z}^n|$, $v\in\mathbb{R}^n$.

arxiv:2610.26536.title: Exact cost of the Euclidean Maximum Traveling Salesman Problem in one dimension
arxiv:2610.26536.summary: We study the random Euclidean Maximum Traveling Salesman Problem: finding a Hamiltonian cycle of maximal total cost through any set of $N$ cities on a line, where each edge cost is a function of its Euclidean length. We characterize the maximizing cycles for convex increasing, concave increasing, and convex decreasing cost functions. For points sampled independently and uniformly from the unit interval, we derive explicit expressions for the average maximal cost for arbitrary $N$ and asymptotic expansions with power-law edge costs.

arxiv:2610.26579.title: Asymptotic Enumeration of $F$-decompositions in Typical Hypergraphs and of Universal Cycles
arxiv:2610.26579.summary: In this paper, we determine the asymptotic number of $F$-decompositions in typical hypergraphs. More precisely, let $F$ be a non-trivial $f$-vertex $k$-graph. We show that, for all sufficiently large $n$, every $n$-vertex $F$-divisible $(n^{-\zeta},h,p)$-typical $k$-graph $G$ has $n^{\frac{f-k+o_n(1)}{|F|}|G|}$ $F$-decompositions.
arxiv:2610.26579.authors: Danni Li, Bin Wang, Junxue Zhang

arxiv:2610.26580.title: Mellin transformed exponential volumes and probabilistic moduli spaces
arxiv:2610.26580.summary: A decorated surface is a surface with boundary and a finite set of marked boundary points called cusps. We continue to study the exponential volumes E(S,K,L) of moduli spaces of ideal hyperbolic structures on a decorated surface S, with the given values of lengths of boundary geodesic circles L and boundary geodesic intervals K, introduced in our previous work: 1. We prove that the Mellin--Laplace transform of E(S,K,L) admits Barnes integral presentations, and satisfies recursions, generalising Mirzakhani's recursions. 2.

arxiv:2610.26588.title: Effective intrinsic ergodicity and the transport-entropy inequality: a relation and applications
arxiv:2610.26588.summary: Effective intrinsic ergodicity (EIE) quantifies how the pressure defect of an invariant measure controls its distance from an equilibrium state. In this paper, we make explicit the connection between the Einsiedler-Kadyrov-Polo (EKP) inequality, which is central to EIE, and the transport-entropy inequality (TEI). We also extend the finite-state transport-entropy inequality of \cite{CMU19} to topologically mixing countable Markov shifts with the Big Images and Preimages (BIP) property, yielding an EIE estimate in Ornstein's $\bar d$-metric that strengthens \cite{Ruh21}.

arxiv:2610.26596.title: Rational Dyck Excursion Counts as Sums of Generalized Fuss-Catalan Products
arxiv:2610.26596.summary: For walks with jumps +p and -q, where p,q are coprime positive integers, we express the weak and strict rational Dyck excursion counts as finite weighted sums of generalized Fuss-Catalan products. Both sums run over the same partitions of q for every path size. Reversing the order of the steps and changing their signs transforms a returning walk with jumps +p and -q into one with jumps +q and -p, with the same heights in reverse order.
arxiv:2610.26596.authors: Brecht Verbeken, Arne Vanhoyweghen, Vincent Ginis

arxiv:2610.26608.title: On a problem of Ma and Chen concerning minimal additive complements
arxiv:2610.26608.summary: Let $m\geq1$ be an integer and let $W=(m\mathbb N_0+X)\cup U\cup V\subseteq\mathbb Z$ be bounded below, where $X\ne\varnothing$, $[U]_m\subseteq[X]_m$, $[X]_m\cap[V]_m=\varnothing$, and $V$ contains no infinite arithmetic progression with common difference $m$. Here $[S]_m$ denotes the set of residue classes modulo $m$ represented by $S$. Suppose that $W$ satisfies the $\mathcal C$-condition modulo $m$.

arxiv:2610.26615.title: Bootstrap percolation on the hypercube
arxiv:2610.26615.summary: In this paper we obtain the critical probability $p_c(Q_{n},r)$ for bootstrap percolation with the infection threshold $r=f(n)n^a$ on the $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_{n}$, where $0<a<1$ and $f(n)=n^{o(1)}$. More precisely, we obtain the exact first-order and second-order terms of $p_c(Q_{n},r)$ by extending the main theorem of Balogh, Bollob{\'a}s, and Morris (2009).

arxiv:2610.26622.title: On the denominators of signed harmonic sums
arxiv:2610.26622.summary: Let $\eps=(\eps_i)_{i\ge1}$ be a sequence with $\eps_i\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $v_n(\eps)$ be the positive denominator of $\sum_{i=1}^n\eps_i/i$ in lowest terms. We prove that $|\{1\le n\le x:v_n(\eps)\ne v_{n+1}(\eps)\}|=o(x)$ uniformly in $\eps$. In particular, the set of positive integers $n$ with $v_n(\eps)=v_{n+1}(\eps)$ has asymptotic density one for every sequence of signs.

arxiv:2610.26635.title: Rigidity of algebraic sets with small distortion
arxiv:2610.26635.summary: We prove that for positive integers $k$, $n$, and $d>1$, there is a maximal $c(k,n,d)>1$ such that if $X \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ is a connected $k$-dimensional complex algebraic set with degree at most $d$ and $dist(X) < c(k,n,d)$, then $X$ must be a complex affine linear subspace, where $dist(X)$ denotes the distortion of $X$ and is given by the supremum of the ratios $d_{inner}(p, q)/d_{outer}(p, q)$ for all $p,q\in X$ with $p\not= q$. We also prove that $c(1,n,d)=\sqrt{2}$ for any positive integers $k$ and $n$. This result provides a sharp rigidity phenomenon for curves in the $c$-LNE category, showing that near-isometric behavior of the inner and outer metrics forces the curve to be as…

arxiv:2610.26649.title: A study of the $m$th relative Feng-Rao distances with a special emphasis on $C_{ab}$ curves
arxiv:2610.26649.summary: In the seminal paper [13], Farr\'an and Munuera introduced a method to establish generic information on the $m$th Feng-Rao distance via a function on arbitrary numerical semigroups that serves as a lower bound on the generalized Hamming weights of dual one-point algebraic geometry codes whenever the semigroup is Weierstrass. In the present paper, we study what we shall call the primary and dual, respectively, $m$th relative Feng-Rao distances, which serve as lower bounds on relative generalized Hamming weights of nested primary and dual, respectively, one-point codes under similar condition. A unified method for establishing generic formulas for $m$th relative Feng-Rao distances of general…
arxiv:2610.26649.authors: Eduardo Camps-Moreno, Olav Geil, Hiram H. L\'opez, Gretchen L. Matthews, Rodrigo San-Jos\'e

arxiv:2610.26686.title: Proof of the Erd\H{o}s-Szemer\'edi sunflower conjecture
arxiv:2610.26686.summary: In the 1970s, Erd\H{o}s and Szemer\'edi conjectured that for any $n \ge k-1\ge 2$, any collection of subsets of $[n]$ not containing a $k$-sunflower has size at most $c_k^n$ for some $c_k<2$. In the $k=3$ case, this follows from the work of Croot, Lev, and Pach and Ellenberg and Gijswijt on the cap-set problem, through a reduction due to Alon, Shpilka, and Umans. We prove the conjecture for every $k \ge 3$.
arxiv:2610.26686.authors: Matija Buci\'c, Fankang He, Hyunwoo Lee

arxiv:2610.26697.title: Eisenstein series for orthogonal groups and Kneser neighbours
arxiv:2610.26697.summary: We study Eisenstein series for orthogonal groups of even unimodular lattices of signature $(n,2)$ which arise as lifts of elliptic modular forms for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ on 1-dimensional cusps. When the weight is small they have to be defined by analytic continuation. In general, they will be smooth but non-holomorphic after regularization.
arxiv:2610.26697.authors: Manuel K. -H. M\"uller, Nils R. Scheithauer

arxiv:2610.26699.title: Global Dynamics and Periodic-Annulus Bifurcations in a Reversible Quintic Li\'enard System
arxiv:2610.26699.summary: We study the global dynamics and bifurcations of the reversible quintic Li\'enard system $\dot{x}=y$, $\dot{y}=a_0x+a_1x^3+a_2x^5+y(b_0x+b_1x^3)$, with $a_2\ne0$. In the original five-parameter space we treat both signs of $a_2$ and determine all global phase-portrait types on the Poincar\'e disc with one, three, or five finite equilibria. The analysis covers generic and generalized pitchfork, saddle-node, Bogdanov--Takens, and Hopf bifurcations; nilpotent and Hamiltonian degeneracies; bifurcations at infinity; and homoclinic, heteroclinic, limit-cycle-breaking, and periodic-annulus-breaking transitions.
arxiv:2610.26699.authors: Chen Cao, Nasrin Sadri, Yilei Tang, Zhaoxia Wang

arxiv:2610.26700.title: Geodesics in the continuous Hecke monoid
arxiv:2610.26700.summary: A permuton is a probability measure on the unit square with uniform marginals, the limit shape of a sequence of permutations. The sticky product of permutons is a continuous analogue of the Demazure product in the $0$-Hecke monoid; on copulas, the distribution functions of permutons, it is given by the tropical $(\min,+)$ product $\odot$. We show that every absolutely continuous rotation-invariant probability measure $\rho$ on the plane, which we call the profile, generates a one-parameter family of copulas $C^\rho=\{C^\rho_\beta\}_{\beta\in[0,\pi]}$.

arxiv:2610.26726.title: The Structure of the Ghost and Swapping Algebras
arxiv:2610.26726.summary: The swapping algebras and the ghost algebras were introduced in the papers of Labourie and Bridgeman--Labourie to encode the Poisson structure on spaces of length functions and generalized cross-ratio functions associated to $\Theta$-Anosov representations. They used these algebras to show that correlation functions are stable under the Poisson bracket associated to Atiyah-Bott-Goldman's symplectic form and that length functions are convex along the Hamiltonian flow of other length functions. In this paper, we study the algebraic relationship between these two algebras.

arxiv:2610.26735.title: Large-Level Limit of Doubled Chern-Simons Theory Part I: Regular Sector, Boundaries and Interfaces
arxiv:2610.26735.summary: We study three-dimensional $BF$ theory as the large-level limit of the doubled Chern--Simons theory $G_k\times G_{-k}$ for simply connected, compact, simple $G$, a limit that connects the symmetry topological field theories of finite and continuous symmetries. Lines whose two highest weights grow linearly with $k$ at fixed difference become $BF$ lines, with magnetic flux set by their average and electric charge equal to their difference. Representing level-$k$ torus states as normalized flux--charge wave packets, we prove that every fixed modular transformation of any fixed normalizable state with regular flux converges in the strong-$*$ topology to its $BF$ counterpart.
arxiv:2610.26735.authors: Shengyi Guan, Qiang Jia, Jiahua Tian, Yi-Nan Wang

arxiv:2610.26737.title: The sum-product conjecture holds for fixed-field lattice product constructions
arxiv:2610.26737.summary: We study fixed-field analogues of the lattice product construction recently used by Bloom, Sawin, Schildkraut, and Zhelezov to disprove the sum-product conjecture over the real numbers. These sets are of the form $A_n = P_nG_n \subset F$, where $F$ is a fixed number field, $P_n$ can be rescaled to a set of algebraic integers whose conjugates are polynomially bounded in $|P_n \setminus \{0\}|$, and $G_n$ occupies a positive proportion of a bounded box of scale $Y_n$ in a fixed positive-rank multiplicative lattice. We prove that these fixed-field constructions satisfy the sum-product conjecture, $\max\{|A_n+A_n|, |A_nA_n|\} \ge |A_n|^{2-o(1)}$ as $|A_n| \to \infty$, with no restriction on the…

arxiv:2610.26763.title: Small subgraphs of large minimum degree
arxiv:2610.26763.summary: In 1991, Erd\H{o}s, Faudree, Rousseau and Schelp asked to estimate the smallest $u=u(n,d,s)$ such that every $n$-vertex graph with average degree at least $d$ has a subgraph on at most $u$ vertices with minimum degree at least $s$. We resolve this problem up to polylogarithmic factors for all even values of $s$. More precisely, we prove that every $n$-vertex graph with minimum degree $d\geq s$ has a subgraph on $O_s\left(\max\left\{\frac{n}{d^{s/(s-2)}}(\log n)^{180},\log n\right\}\right)$ vertices with minimum degree at least $s$, whenever $s\ge 4$ is even.
arxiv:2610.26763.authors: Zach Hunter, Barnab\'as Janzer, Oliver Janzer, Benny Sudakov

arxiv:2610.26764.title: Socle formulas for rigid irreducible components of Lusztig's nilpotent varieties in type $A$
arxiv:2610.26764.summary: Let $F$ be a non-archimedean local field. For any irreducible component $C$ of a nilpotent variety of type $A$ let $\pi(C)$ be the irreducible representation of a general linear group over $F$ attached to it. We show that if the multisegment of $C$ is multiplicity free, $C$ is rigid if and only if $\pi(C)$ is $\square$-irreducible.

arxiv:2610.26768.title: Meromorphic modular differential equations for the elliptic genus of Calabi--Yau varieties
arxiv:2610.26768.summary: We study differential equations -- not necessarily monic -- for Jacobi modular forms. As an application, we derive a second-order differential equation for the elliptic genus of a $K3$ surface involving the logarithmic derivative of the modular invariant $j(\tau)$, and we explicitly find a third-order equation with a leading coefficient of weight 12 for the elliptic genus of any four-dimensional Calabi--Yau variety. Furthermore, we propose a simple recursive algorithm for investigating second-order differential equations with leading coefficient $E_4(\tau)$ or $E_6(\tau)$.

arxiv:2610.26771.title: $\mathbb{C}$-Motivic Eilenberg-Mac Lane Spectra as $\mathrm{MGL}$-Motivic Thom Spectra and Normed $\mathbb{G}_m$-Hochschild Homology
arxiv:2610.26771.summary: We exhibit the $p$-complete $\mathbb{C}$-motivic Eilenberg-Mac Lane spectra $\mathrm{M}\mathbb{F}_p$ and $(\mathrm{M}\mathbb{Z})_p^{\wedge}$ as $\mathbb{E_3}$-$\mathrm{MGL}_p^{\wedge}$-motivic Thom spectra over the motivic $\mathbb{G}_m$-loop spaces $\Omega_{\mathbb{G}_m}\mathrm{BGL}$ and $\Omega_{\mathbb{G}_m}\mathrm{BSL}$, respectively. Furthermore, for $p=2$, we compute the $\mathrm{MGL}_2^{\wedge}$-relative $\mathbb{G}_m$-Hochschild Homology $\mathbb{G}_m \odot^{\mathrm{MGL}_2^{\wedge}} {-}$, recently introduced by Bachmann-Burklund-Dundas-{\O}stv{\ae}r, of $\mathrm{M}\mathbb{F}_2$ and $(\mathrm{M}\mathbb{Z})_2^{\wedge}$ to be $\mathrm{M}\mathbb{F}_2[\mathrm{BGL}]$ and…

arxiv:2610.26774.title: Weights of KZ motives and quantum groups
arxiv:2610.26774.summary: The Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov (KZ) connection is defined on the constant bundle determined by $n$ finite-dimensional irreducible representations of a simple Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ and a nonzero complex parameter $\kappa$, over the configuration space of $n$ distinct points on the affine line. Work of Schechtman--Varchenko and Looijenga shows that, when $\kappa$ is rational, the resulting local systems admit natural motivic realizations, called KZ motives. The Kazhdan--Lusztig equivalence identifies the local systems underlying these motivic variations with certain representations of the pure braid group arising from the corresponding Lusztig quantum group at a root of unity.

arxiv:2610.26778.title: The moduli space of quasimorphisms on subshifts and its pressure geometry
arxiv:2610.26778.summary: We introduce a metric geometry on the space of positive, linearly growing quasimorphisms on a mixing subshift of finite type. Two such quasimorphisms are identified when their homogenizations agree up to multiplicative scaling. The resulting moduli space carries a natural symmetrised Thurston-type metric, defined from the extremal ratios of their periodic orbit lengths.
arxiv:2610.26778.authors: Stephen Cantrell, Pablo Carrasco, Emilio Corso, Federico Rodriguez Hertz

arxiv:2610.26798.title: Uniform convergence of canonical discrete uniformization on equilateral approximations
arxiv:2610.26798.summary: We prove uniform convergence of the canonical discrete uniformization maps for every sequence of equilateral polygonal disks whose mesh tends to zero and whose marked Jordan boundaries converge uniformly. The limit is the normalized Riemann map, with convergence on the entire closed reference triangle. This proves Conjecture 7.3 of Luo, Sun and Wu for the original construction with Delaunay flips.

arxiv:2610.26803.title: A simplified proof of the FPRAS for counting perfect matchings
arxiv:2610.26803.summary: We give a simplified, self-contained proof of OpenAI's FPRAS for counting perfect matchings in general graphs. As in the original proof, we use a restricted Poincar\'e inequality for two matchings to sample weighted perfect matchings and estimate their total weight. We simplify the proof of this inequality by isolating parts of alternating cycles directly on the original vertex set and controlling the resulting error terms.

arxiv:2610.26804.title: Directional Expansiveness for the chair tiling
arxiv:2610.26804.summary: We study directional expansiveness of the chair tiling. We show that for every direction $V$ and every $r>0$, there exist distinct chair tilings that agree on $\mathbb{Z}^2\cap V^r$. Hence the chair tiling has no expansive direction.

arxiv:2610.26812.title: Data Center Oscillation Isolation and Grid Support: Fundamental Limits and Source-Selective Control
arxiv:2610.26812.summary: The grid integration of large data centers poses a growing power-system stability challenge. Rapidly varying computing demand can induce oscillations, while the facilities must provide a prescribed response to grid disturbances. Existing controls address load fluctuations and grid support but do not establish their jointly achievable performance.

arxiv:2610.26870.title: Probabilistic Stability Transfer for One-Dimensional Euler Characteristic Transforms
arxiv:2610.26870.summary: The Euler characteristic transform (ECT) is a computable topological signature for shapes embedded in Euclidean space. Existing ECT stability results control changes in the transform through deterministic geometric perturbation bounds, but many data-generating mechanisms produce perturbations that are random and unbounded in the worst case. In such settings a uniform deterministic bound may be unavailable or too pessimistic.

arxiv:2610.26875.title: Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians
arxiv:2610.26875.summary: We study equality between metric dimension and the maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices. These quantities are not ordered in general. Using the standard decomposition associated with twin classes, we separate forced multiplicities from quotient-spectrum contributions.
arxiv:2610.26875.authors: Monther Rashed Alfuraidan, Suliman Khan, Lorenzo Sauras Altuzarra

arxiv:2610.26878.title: A positivity conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton
arxiv:2610.26878.summary: We prove the conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton (2003) that $\frac{1-q}{(q^n;q)_m}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{m}_{q}$ has nonnegative power-series coefficients for $0<m<n$, except when $n$ is even and $m\in\{2,n-2\}$. We obtain a polynomial version by bounding a M\"obius correction by first differences of Gaussian coefficients. The proof uses partitions and quadratic and cubic semi-invariants of binary forms.

arxiv:2610.26885.title: Borel's computation of the ranks of $K$-theory revisited
arxiv:2610.26885.summary: We reprove Borel's computation of the rank of the $K$-groups of rings of algebraic integers $\mathcal{O}_F$ for certain number fields, e.g., $F = \mathbb{Q}(\mu_{l^k})$ for $l$ an odd regular prime number. The idea is to recover a simple formula for $l$-adic {\'e}tale cohomology groups of $\mathcal{O}_F$ in terms of Iwasawa theoretic objects without using Borel's result as an input.

arxiv:2610.26886.title: Inscribed 4-polytopes of maximal volume with seven and eight vertices
arxiv:2610.26886.summary: We prove, with sum-of-squares certificates checked in exact arithmetic, that every cyclic $4$-polytope with seven vertices inscribed in $\mathbb{S}^{3}$ has volume at most $2/5$. Hence no $4$-polytope of maximal volume with seven vertices inscribed in $\mathbb{S}^{3}$ is cyclic, answering a question of Horv\'ath and L\'angi for $d = 4$, and with their theorem the maximal volume is $\sqrt{3}/4$. With eight vertices, the same method bounds the volume of every simplicial type other than the cross-polytope by $13/20$, so the regular cross-polytope, of volume $2/3$, is up to orthogonal transformations the unique maximiser.

arxiv:2610.26895.title: Disc-presheaves and normal invariants
arxiv:2610.26895.summary: In this note, we elaborate on a result of Krannich--Kupers--Mehzer on Disc-presheaves. We show that equivalences of $2$-truncated Disc-presheaves of manifolds yields homotopy equivalences with trivial normal invariant. As an application, we show that two closed, simply connected manifolds are homeomorphic if and only if their $2$-truncated Disc-presheaves are equivalent.

arxiv:2610.26907.title: Reverse Module Categories of Vertex Operator Algebras
arxiv:2610.26907.summary: We study the realization of the reverse braided category of the module category of a rational vertex operator algebra V. Using holomorphic extensions and commutant constructions, we prove that this realization property is preserved under suitable cosets, tensor products, extensions, and finite-group orbifolds. As applications, we establish the property for unitary Virasoro minimal models, affine vertex operator algebras of types ABCDE at positive integral levels, the corresponding principal W-algebras of type ADE, and related parafermion vertex operator algebras.
arxiv:2610.26907.authors: Chongying Dong, Binghui Li, Li Ren, Yilong Wang

arxiv:2610.26912.title: Vertex Removal and Vertex-Edge Domination
arxiv:2610.26912.summary: A vertex $v$ of a graph $G$ $ve$-dominates every edge incident with a vertex in its closed neighborhood $N_{G}[v]$. A set of vertices is a vertex-edge dominating set ($ve$-dominating set) if every edge of $G$ is $ve$-dominated by some vertex in the set. The minimum cardinality of such a set is the vertex-edge domination number $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, also known as the isolation number.
arxiv:2610.26912.authors: Minhui Li, Shumin Zhang, Fengming Dong

arxiv:2610.26940.title: Littlewood's mutually touching cylinders: the maximum is seven
arxiv:2610.26940.summary: We give a computer-assisted proof that eight congruent infinite circular cylinders in $\mathbb{R}^3$ cannot touch pairwise. Since seven such cylinders exist, the maximum number of congruent mutually touching infinite cylinders is seven. This answers a question of Littlewood from 1968.
arxiv:2610.26940.authors: Ivan Mati\'c, Rado\v{s} Radoi\v{c}i\'c, Andreas Spomer

arxiv:2610.26970.title: Gaussian Lower Bounds for Distinct Subset Sums in Higher Dimensions
arxiv:2610.26970.summary: For sequences of $n$ nonnegative integer vectors in $\mathbb Z^k$ with distinct subset sums, we prove, for fixed $k$, the uniform lower bound $M\ge (C_k-o(1))2^{n/k}/\sqrt n$ for the largest coordinate, where \[ C_k=\sqrt{\frac{2k}{\pi}}\, \frac{(k+1)^{(k-1)/(2k)}}{\sqrt{\lfloor (k+1)^2/4\rfloor}}. \] The proof compares a Gaussian-kernel expectation with a sum over a translated lattice, uniformly over the vector sequence. We optimise the resulting quadratic-form constant using a vertex second-moment certificate.

arxiv:2610.26977.title: Polynomial Spectral Gap Estimates for Finitely Differentiable Quasi-Periodic Schr\"odinger Operators
arxiv:2610.26977.summary: We prove polynomial upper bounds on spectral gaps of quasi-periodic Schr\"odinger operators with small $C^{k}$ potentials and Diophantine frequencies. For sufficiently large $k$, the decay exponent is $k-34\tau$, where $\tau$ is the Diophantine exponent. We construct examples with lower bounds along infinitely many gap labels, showing that the leading coefficient $1$ of $k$ is asymptotically optimal.
arxiv:2610.26977.authors: Ao Cai, Yang Gao, Jiawei He

arxiv:2610.27016.title: On the Motivic K-Theories of Classifying Spaces of Cyclic 2-Groups
arxiv:2610.27016.summary: We compute the $2$-completed integral motivic homology, effective algebraic $K$-theory, and very effective Hermitian $K$-theory of the geometric classifying spaces $B\mu_{2^n}$, $n\geq 2$, over algebraically closed and real closed fields. We first carry out the corresponding classical calculations and, then obtain the motivic results using motivic spectral sequences and comparison techniques. The results reveal the classical $2$-torsion together with motivic $\tau$-periodicity and $\rho$-torsion.

arxiv:2610.27025.title: A Geometric Principle for Path Selection in Directed Acyclic Graphs
arxiv:2610.27025.summary: There are many types of path between nodes of a Directed acyclic graph (DAG), including the shortest and longest paths. Here, we ask whether the choice of path used in any analysis reflects the geometry of the latent space in which the DAG is embedded. To do this we define L_p-cube spacetimes, a family of continuous ordered spaces in which a single parameter p determines whether the ordered distance satisfies the ordered triangle identity when p>1, or the reverse ordered triangle identity when 0<p<1 or p<0, both of which are rarely studied.

arxiv:2610.27031.title: Approximability of Triangulated Categories under Separable Extensions
arxiv:2610.27031.summary: In this paper, we investigate the behavior of approximability under separable extensions of triangulated categories. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be an approximable triangulated category and let $\mathbf{T}$ be a smashing, stably separable exact monad on $\mathcal{B}$. We prove that if $\mathbf{T}$ is right $t$-exact with respect to a $t$-structure in the preferred equivalence class, then the category of $\mathbf{T}$-modules $\mathbf{T}\text{-Mod}_{\mathcal{B}}$ is again an approximable triangulated category.
arxiv:2610.27031.authors: Mengzhen Zhu, Yuefei Zheng, Xianhui Fu

arxiv:2610.27077.title: Flux Vacua, Asymptotic Periods, and Relatively Anosov Representations
arxiv:2610.27077.summary: We develop a topological method to detect classical flux vacua of M-theory on Calabi-Yau fourfolds with a single complex structure modulus using only asymptotic period data and monodromy information. To this end, we express the index of the F-term of the flux superpotential as a winding number along the boundary of the universal cover of the complex structure moduli space. The index evaluates to a sum over zeros and poles of a suitably normalized boundary F-term, where local contributions can be computed algebraically on a dense set of boundary points.

arxiv:2610.27083.title: Partitionability is NP-complete
arxiv:2610.27083.summary: We show that the problem of deciding whether a simplicial complex is partitionable is NP-complete in dimensions two and higher, answering a 1995 question of Kleinschmidt and Onn.

arxiv:2610.27095.title: Tree Lattices and the Neumann-Zagier conjecture
arxiv:2610.27095.summary: A tree with integer weights on its vertices presents an integral lattice called a tree lattice. We prove that if a tree lattice is positive definite, then one of the vertex elements is irreducible, i.e. determines a facet of its Voronoi polyhedron. As a corollary, we settle a 1985 conjecture of Neumann and Zagier: if a tree lattice is isometric to the lattice of integer points in Euclidean space, then the tree contains a vertex of weight one.
arxiv:2610.27095.authors: Joshua Evan Greene, Ahmad Issa, Duncan McCoy

arxiv:2610.27117.title: Subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs
arxiv:2610.27117.summary: Since their introduction by Karo\'nski, Scheinerman, and Singer-Cohen in 90's, random intersection graphs have attracted much attention, mostly due to their various applications. In this article, we establish a general result for the probability that a given small subgraph is present in a random intersection graph. Our theorem applies to a broad range of parameters, including regimes that have not previously been considered in the literature.

arxiv:2610.27126.title: Orthogonal group sections via light bulb systems
arxiv:2610.27126.summary: For any oriented, smooth $4$--manifold $X$ diffeomorphic to $(S^2\times S^2)^{\# n}\# D^4$, this paper shows that the natural group homomorphism $$\mathrm{Mod}(X,\partial X)\to \mathrm{O}(H_2(X;\mathbb{Z}))$$ admits a section. In fact, every light bulb system in $X$ gives rise to a section, which can be characterized uniquely in terms of implanted barbell twists and implanted crossbell involutions. Moreover, all sections arising from different light bulb systems become identical after a single $S^2\times S^2$--stabilization of $X$.

arxiv:2610.27127.title: Short Point Lists for CNFs and Stronger Constant-Depth Circuit Hardness
arxiv:2610.27127.summary: We give a short-description decomposition of bounded-width CNFs. For every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, every width-$b$ CNF on $m$ variables is an exact disjoint union of at most $2^{\varepsilon m}$ width-$b$ CNFs, each determined by $2^{O_\varepsilon(b)}\log(m+1)$ satisfying assignments. For every fixed $d\ge3$, we prove a worst-case size lower bound of $2^{\Omega_d((n\log n)^{1/(d-1)})}$ against depth-at-most-$d$ unbounded-fan-in AND/OR circuits with input negations for three polynomial-time Boolean families: inverse trace over binary fields, the Goldreich--Tal trilinear function, and OpenAI's polynomial evaluator with its original parameters.

arxiv:2610.27128.title: Normal approximation for subgraph counts in random intersection graphs: the case of cliques
arxiv:2610.27128.summary: Let $X^{(r)}_n$ denote the number of copies of a complete graph $K_r$ in the random intersection graph model on $n$ vertices. We derive upper bounds on the distance between the standardized version of $X^{(r)}_n$ and the standard normal distribution, measured in both the Kolmogorov and Wasserstein metrics. We complement these results with necessary and sufficient conditions for asymptotic normality.

arxiv:2610.27133.title: Counterexamples to a conjecture and improved bounds for bipanchromatic colorings
arxiv:2610.27133.summary: We study the bipanchromatic number $\chi_B$, introduced by Lalou et al. (Discrete Appl. Math. 391 (2026), 511-522) as the maximum number of colors in a panchromatic hypergraph coloring where every color appears at least twice.

arxiv:2610.27166.title: Central Limit Theorem for continuous $N$-particle systems in fixed- and high-temperature: single level
arxiv:2610.27166.summary: We characterize central limit theorems for polynomial linear statistics of continuous $N$-particle systems on $\mathbb R$, in both the fixed-temperature regime $\theta=\beta/2>0$ and the high-temperature regime $N\theta\to\gamma>0$. In each regime, we give necessary and sufficient conditions in terms of the coefficients of the logarithmic Bessel generating function, together with an explicit combinatorial formula for the limiting covariance. At fixed temperature, this formula recovers the classical second-order free moment--cumulant relation, up to the factor $1/\theta$; at high temperature, it yields new second-order free $\gamma$-cumulants and their covariance relations.

arxiv:2610.27175.title: Recent progress in the construction of Hadamard matrices
arxiv:2610.27175.summary: A Hadamard matrix is a square matrix with entries $\pm 1$ whose rows are mutually orthogonal. Hadamard matrices are conjectured to exist at every order divisible by $4$; for approximately the last twenty years, the smallest open case of this conjecture was order 668. In August 2026, Alp\"oge, Voinov and Reynolds-Haertle announced Hadamard matrices at the twelve orders below $2000$ at which none was known.
arxiv:2610.27175.authors: Ronan Egan, Ilias Kotsireas, Stephen London, P\'adraig \'O Cath\'ain

arxiv:2610.27181.title: Total $\{k\}$-domination in caterpillars: Structural properties and exact results
arxiv:2610.27181.summary: The total $\{k\}$-domination problem ($T\{k\}DP$) seeks a minimum-weight function such that the sum of weights in every open neighborhood is at least $k$. While this problem is known to be NP-hard for general graphs, we demonstrate that for the family of caterpillars, it simplifies to the classical total domination number ($k=1$) via the identity $\gamma^{\{k\}}_t(G) = k\gamma_t(G)$. This reduction is supported by a general upper bound established for all graphs, which we prove to be tight specifically for caterpillars.
arxiv:2610.27181.authors: Mariana Escalante, Paola Tolomei, Mar\'ia In\'es Lopez Pujato

arxiv:2610.27188.title: Canard points in planar mass-action networks: a flux criterion, a duality, and a complete classification
arxiv:2610.27188.summary: We determine which mass-action reaction networks on two species, one fast and one slow, admit a canard point: a singular Hopf bifurcation at a fold of the critical manifold, followed by a canard explosion. In flux coordinates, existence reduces to three linear equations, one linear inequation and a sign condition on the product of two linear forms, and the criticality of the explosion is the sign of an explicit cubic form. For four reactions with a balance matrix of full rank, both become integer polynomial conditions on the stoichiometry.

arxiv:2610.27198.title: DeGroot Dynamics on Multiplex Networks with Directed and Acyclic Interlayer Connectivities
arxiv:2610.27198.summary: In models of opinion dynamics, researchers typically examine how an individual's opinion on one topic is influenced by the opinions of their neighbors in a network. However, people's opinions on a topic are also influenced by their opinions and their neighbors' opinions on related topics. In an election, for example, the opinions of a voter on a variety of issues inform their opinions of electoral candidates.
arxiv:2610.27198.authors: Mia Zender, Kye Shi, Abigail Hickok, Weiqi Chu, Mason A. Porter

arxiv:2610.27229.title: Connected $\omega$-limit sets of Cournot maps: periodic orbits, realization and almost every point
arxiv:2610.27229.summary: Let $F(x,y)=(f_2(y),f_1(x))$ be a Cournot map of the unit square, $\varphi=f_2\circ f_1$ and $\chi=f_1\circ f_2$. Linero Bas and Mu\~noz Guillermo proved that an $\omega$-limit set of $F$ with nonempty interior is connected if and only if \textup{(C1)} its two projections are connected and \textup{(C2)} $\omega_{F^2}(z)\cap\omega_{F^2}(F(z))\neq\emptyset$, and conjectured that this holds for every $\omega$-limit set. We prove the conjecture for every point $z=(x,y)$ such that $\omega_\varphi(x)$ or $\omega_\chi(y)$ is finite, and for Lebesgue almost every point $z$ of the square whenever $\varphi$ is metrically regular (every metric attractor is a periodic orbit, a solenoid, or a cycle of…

arxiv:2610.27267.title: The integral $K_0$-ring of the stack of smooth hyperelliptic curves
arxiv:2610.27267.summary: We compute the integral $K_0$-ring of the moduli stack $\mathscr H_g$ of smooth hyperelliptic curves of genus $g\ge2$ over a field of characteristic zero. We show that it is a free abelian group of rank $8g+2$ for even $g$ and $8g+4$ for odd $g$. We use the isotypic decomposition of the $K_0$ of a related $\mu_{g+1}$-gerbe to obtain presentations for both even and odd $g$'s from the standard quotient presentation of $\mathscr H_g$.

arxiv:2610.27276.title: A Pittel-type limit law for the largest component of random $d$-uniform hypergraphs: enumeration and excursions
arxiv:2610.27276.summary: Let $H_d(n,M)$ be a $d$-uniform hypergraph with $n$ vertices and $M$ hyperedges. In the critical window $M=\frac{n}{d(d-1)}(1+\lambda n^{-1/3})+O(1)$, its largest component $L_n$ satisfies $$n^{-2/3}L_n\xrightarrow{\mathcal L} \mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{Pit}}\bigl((d-1)^{1/3}a,\lambda(d-1)^{-2/3}\bigr).$$ (Here $\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{Pit}}(x,\mu)$ denotes the limiting law of the largest component of the critical random graph established by Pittel (2001).) The proof rests on two pillars. First, a bivariate exponential formula gives the exact finite-size law of $L_n$.

arxiv:2610.27283.title: PL standardness of the four-pentachoron census sphere Q
arxiv:2610.27283.summary: We prove that the four-pentachoron homotopy \(4\)-sphere \(Q\) singled out in the census of Burke, Burton and Spreer is PL homeomorphic to the standard \(4\)-sphere. The key construction identifies the compact exterior of an explicit locally flat \(2\)-sphere in an auxiliary 39-vertex model of \(Q\) with the exterior of Budney, Burton and Hillman, then certifies its fibration by a normal cut followed by a relative collapse. The exterior identification uses finite checked moves, an exact regular-neighbourhood construction and a PL lemma controlling the passage through an ideal triangulation.

arxiv:2610.27382.title: Weak reducibility for bridge trisections
arxiv:2610.27382.summary: A bridge splitting of a knot is weakly reducible if it has a pair of disjoint shadows, one from above and one from below, in the splitting surface. The process of weak reduction exchanges local minima and maxima in the splitting, untelescoping the splitting and giving a method for detecting essential surfaces in the knot complement. Bridge trisections generalize bridge splittings to the setting of surfaces in 4-manifolds.

arxiv:2610.27392.title: The Projective Reed-Muller Code from Quartic Curves in the Projective Plane
arxiv:2610.27392.summary: We study the Hamming weight enumerator of the projective Reed-Muller code $\mathcal C_{2,4}$ over $\mathbf F_q$, with $\operatorname{char}(\mathbf F_q)>3$. We determine the geometrically reducible and singular contributions by combining incidence counts with counts of plane linear series on a fixed normalization. The line and conic configurations and the genus zero cases give explicit polynomials.

arxiv:2610.27457.title: A first order phase transition for lower tails in sparse random graphs
arxiv:2610.27457.summary: We study the graphon variational problem that governs lower tail large deviations of the number of copies of a fixed nonbipartite graph $H$ in a sparse Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi random graph. Our main new insight is that any non-constant minimizer of the variational problem exhibits a discontinuous jump away from the constant graphon. We deduce that the replica-symmetric and symmetry-breaking regimes are separated by a single critical parameter and that the phase transition is first order.

arxiv:2610.27476.title: Triviality of $K$-homology classes of Euler characteristic operators of stratified pseudomanifolds
arxiv:2610.27476.summary: We show that the $K$-homology classes of the Euler characteristic operators associated with the minimal and maximal ideal boundary conditions of the de Rham differential on the regular part of a connected compact Thom-Mather stratified pseudomanifold, equipped with an adapted metric, are trivial beyond their indices. These indices are the Euler characteristics of the corresponding $L^2$-cohomologies. This generalizes a result of J.

arxiv:2610.27478.title: A Solution to the Kohayakawa-Pr\"omel-R\"odl Conjecture
arxiv:2610.27478.summary: The induced Ramsey number $r_{\mathrm{ind}}(G,H)$ is defined as the minimum order of a graph $F$ such that any 2-coloring of its edges with red and blue leads to either a red induced copy of $G$ or a blue induced copy of $H$. In 1998, Kohayakawa, Pr\"omel, and R\"odl conjectured that for any fixed graph $G$, there exists a constant $f=f(G)$ such that the induced Ramsey number $r_{\mathrm{ind}}(G, H)$ is bounded by $|V(H)|^f$ for every graph $H$. In this paper, we completely solve the Kohayakawa--Pr\"omel--R\"odl conjecture, which states that for any graphs $G$ and $H$ with $|V(G)|=k\ge2$ and $|V(H)|=t\ge2$, $r_{\mathrm{ind}}(G,H)\le t^{60k^2+3}$.
arxiv:2610.27478.authors: Chuang Zhong, Masaki Kashima, Yaping Mao

arxiv:2610.27481.title: Bowen--Franks groups and minus class groups of imaginary abelian fields
arxiv:2610.27481.summary: $\mathrm{Lei}$, $\mathrm{M\ddot{u}ller}$, and $\mathrm{Valli\grave{e}res}$ constructed a directed graph for which the torsion part of the corresponding Bowen--Franks group is related to the minus part of the class group of a cyclotomic number field with prime conductor. We extend this result to a general imaginary abelian field.

arxiv:2610.27498.title: On Entries of Spectral Decompositions and Applications
arxiv:2610.27498.summary: The entries of the spectral idempotents of a graph are its local and crossed local multiplicities. This paper uses these classical quantities in three applications. First, in a graph on $n$ vertices without isolated vertices, every local multiplicity is at most $\frac{n-1}{n}$, and every diagonal entry of the Cesaro average mixing matrix is at most $1-\frac{2}{n}+\frac{2}{n^2}$.

arxiv:2610.27510.title: The achromatic number of Paley graphs, Peisert graphs, and related Cayley graphs
arxiv:2610.27510.summary: The achromatic number of a graph $G$, denoted $\chi_a (G)$, is the maximum number of colors in a proper vertex coloring of $G$. Generalizing a result of Maistrelli and Penman, we prove that for sufficiently large $q$, the achromatic number of the $k$-th power Paley graph is at least $\frac{q-1}{k} + 1$. This lower bound gives the correct order of magnitude in $q$, but determining the correct dependence on $k$ remains open for all $k \geq 3$.

arxiv:2610.27517.title: Hodge Theory of Novikov Type Landau--Ginzburg Models
arxiv:2610.27517.summary: We establish a strong Hodge decomposition theorem for Novikov type Landau--Ginzburg models, that is, triples $(M,g,\theta)$ consisting of a non-compact complete K\"ahler manifold $(M,g)$ and a non-trivial closed holomorphic one-form $\theta$ on $M$.Under the well-tameness condition and under the assumption that $M$ is Stein, we prove that the space of $L^{2}$-forms on $M$ admits an orthogonal decomposition into the space of harmonic forms of the twisted Laplacian $\Delta_{\theta}$ and the images of the twisted Dolbeault operators $\bar\partial+\theta\wedge$ and $\bar\partial^{\dagger}+\iota_{\bar\theta^{\sharp}}$; moreover, the harmonic space is concentrated in degree $n=\dim_{\C}M$ and is…

arxiv:2610.27527.title: Frozen colorings and recolorability of blowups
arxiv:2610.27527.summary: The $k$-reconfiguration graph $R_k(G)$ of the proper $k$-colorings of a graph $G$ is the graph whose vertices are the $k$-colorings of $G$, with an edge between two colorings if they differ on exactly one vertex. A graph $G$ is recolorable if $R_k(G)$ is connected for all $k \ge \chi(G) + 1$. In this paper, we study recolorability under blowups through frozen colorings, here blowup means replacing vertices with non-empty cliques.
arxiv:2610.27527.authors: Tianyu Huang, Yulai Ma, Jiaqi Zhang

arxiv:2610.27551.title: An Equivariant Main Conjecture for Branched $\mathbb Z_p$-Towers of Finite Graphs and Applications
arxiv:2610.27551.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $Y/X$ be a finite abelian branched cover of finite connected graphs. We consider a compatible branched $\mathbb Z_p$-tower above $Y$ whose total Galois group over $X$ is abelian. We construct an equivariant Picard Iwasawa module over the completed group ring of the total Galois group and give an explicit presentation of this module.

arxiv:2610.27553.title: A proof of Vince's conjecture on the average order of connected induced subgraphs
arxiv:2610.27553.summary: We prove that the average order of connected induced subgraphs of a connected simple graph of order $n$ and minimum degree at least $3$ is strictly greater than $n/2$, which settles a conjecture of Vince~[\emph{J. Graph Theory} 97 (2021), 82--103]. We go further and show that, for connected simple graphs of order $n$ and minimum degree exactly $k\ge3$, $K_k\vee(K_1\cup K_{n-k-1})$ uniquely minimizes this average under additional conditions.

arxiv:2610.27554.title: On Hankel Determinantal Matroids
arxiv:2610.27554.summary: We initiate a study of the algebraic matroid associated to the ideal generated by the $(r+1)$-minors of a Hankel matrix of variables.
