We prove that this matroid is uniform, that is, a coordinate projection from the corresponding Hankel determinantal variety is generically finite if and only if it preserves at least $2r$ anti-diagonals. For such projections, we establish bounds on the degree.

arxiv:2610.27557.title: Secondary Chow Invariants beyond Lawson--Massey Products
arxiv:2610.27557.summary: We construct secondary Chow invariants that cannot be recovered from Lawson--Massey realization. For every smooth complex projective curve $C$ of positive genus and every $n\ge2$, explicit cubical defining systems yield $n$ distinct Massey values in $\rm{CH}^{3}(C\times P^{2},1)$, with zero full indeterminacy, forming a cyclic group of order $n$. All corresponding triples have identical morphic classes and zero morphic, Lawson, and singular Massey brackets, despite nonzero target groups.

arxiv:2610.27625.title: Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veroneseans
arxiv:2610.27625.summary: The Terracini locus of a projective variety tells us the sets of points at which Terracini's lemma will fail to recover the dimension of the corresponding secant variety. We study the Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veronese varieties, classifying several cases, including a complete classification of the Terracini loci of tangential varieties to rational normal curves. We also show that many Terracini loci involve only sets with "intratangent pairs" that lie on the same tangent space to the underlying Veronese variety.

arxiv:2610.27640.title: A cut-and-project set which is not bi-Lipschitz equivalent to a lattice
arxiv:2610.27640.summary: We construct a cut-and-project set in a totally irrational plane in $\mathbb{R}^3$, with a compact window which is the closure of its interior and has countable boundary, which is not bi-Lipschitz equivalent to a lattice. This answers a question of Burago and Kleiner about cut-and-project sets, and shows in particular that the hypothesis of boundary measure zero is not enough to guarantee bi-Lipschitz equivalence to a lattice. Since our set has uniform density, it also shows that a non-rectifiable Delone set need not encode a non-realisable density, answering a question of Bhat and Dymond.

arxiv:2610.27646.title: U torsion structure in Heegaard Floer homology
arxiv:2610.27646.summary: We construct infinite families of Brieskorn spheres with three singular fibers for which the difference between the largest and the second largest length of U-torsion in their Heegaard Floer homology $HF^-$ increases to infinity as the family parameter increases. In particular, these families give a negative answer to the strong geography restriction on rational homology spheres. As an application, these families give the examples of integer homology spheres that are neither surgery on a knot nor large surgery on links.

arxiv:2610.27660.title: A new class of smooth algebraic varieties with the density property and a counterexample to the T\'{o}th-Varolin Conjecture
arxiv:2610.27660.summary: We prove that the smooth affine hypersurfaces \[ X_{m,n}=\{\zeta^mz_0^n+ (1+z_1\zeta)z_2+\zeta z_3^2=1\}\subset\mathbb{C}^5,\;\; m,n\geq 2, \] have the density property. For every odd integer $d\geq 3$, we identify $X_{d-1,d}$ with a Kaliman modification along a Brieskorn variety of type $(d,2,2,2)$. We prove that the fourfolds $X_{d-1,d}$ are diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{C}^4$ but not biholomorphic to $\mathbb{C}^4$.

arxiv:2610.27676.title: Nef complexity of klt Fano varieties: the full spectrum and classification below two
arxiv:2610.27676.summary: Let $X$ be a complex klt Fano variety. We study the rational total index $\tau_X$ and the nef complexity $c_X=\dim X+\rho(X)-\tau_X$. Previous joint work of the author with Enwright, Filipazzi, Gongyo, Moraga, Svaldi, and Wang established the corresponding nonnegativity and zero-case characterization in the broader framework of a special class of generalized log Calabi--Yau pairs.

arxiv:2610.27685.title: Multiplicity of closed geodesics on odd-dimensional bumpy Finsler compact space form
arxiv:2610.27685.summary: Let $M = S^{2n+1}/\Gamma$ be a manifold diffeomorphic to a compact space form, endowed with a bumpy Finsler metric $F$. In this paper, we prove that there exist at least $n+3$ contractible minimal closed geodesics on $M$, assuming that all contractible minimal closed geodesics have non-zero Morse indices. Here, a contractible closed geodesic is called minimal if it is not an iteration of any other contractible closed geodesic.

arxiv:2610.27697.title: Ergodicity of the geodesic flow on surfaces of nonpositive curvature
arxiv:2610.27697.summary: We give a full proof that the geodesic flow of a closed surface of genus at least two with a \(C^{3+\mathrm{Lip}}\) metric of nonpositive curvature is ergodic with respect to Liouville measure. In a forthcoming paper, we will present the corresponding result for smooth rank-one manifolds in every dimension.
arxiv:2610.27697.authors: Federico Rodriguez Hertz, Jana Rodriguez Hertz, Weisheng Wu

arxiv:2610.27706.title: On minimum-size matroid counterexamples to the multiplicative Merino--Welsh inequality
arxiv:2610.27706.summary: Let $M$ be a matroid and let $\Tutte_M(x,y)$ be its Tutte polynomial. The multiplicative Merino--Welsh inequality \[ \Tutte_M(2,0)\Tutte_M(0,2)\geq \Tutte_M(1,1)^2 \] was proved to be false for matroids by Beke, Cs\'aji, Csikv\'ari, and Pituk (\emph{Adv. Math.} \textbf{446} (2024), 109674).
arxiv:2610.27706.authors: Jungang Chen, Xian'an Jin, Tianlong Ma

arxiv:2610.27716.title: Maximal ranks of free abelian subgroups of generalized cactus groups associated with finite Coxeter systems
arxiv:2610.27716.summary: We determine the maximum ranks of free abelian subgroups of generalized cactus groups associated with finite Coxeter systems. To obtain the upper bounds, we use the cubical flat torus theorem of Wise and Woodhouse. We then verify the sharpness of these upper bounds by constructing free abelian subgroups of the corresponding ranks.

arxiv:2610.27721.title: Classification of finite subgroups of generalized cactus groups
arxiv:2610.27721.summary: We classify the finite groups that embed into generalized cactus groups $C_W$ associated with arbitrary Coxeter systems $(W,S)$. Every finite subgroup is conjugate to a subgroup of $C_{W_T}$ for some spherical subset $T\subseteq S$. This reduces the classification to explicit lists of finite groups for the finite irreducible Coxeter systems.

arxiv:2610.27723.title: Lattice Moduli and Residual Atoms
arxiv:2610.27723.summary: We study prescribed holomorphic lattices for regular-singular connections and residual factors of quantum $F$-bundles. For an arbitrary ordered monodromy spectrum, we classify the fully framed local groupoid: each residue fibre is a discrete affine space of dimension $r(r-1)$, with a unique normal form and trivial stabilisers. We then analyse elementary changes of lattice.

arxiv:2610.27783.title: Size and spectral radius conditions for the existence of $k$-factor in graphs with given minimum degree
arxiv:2610.27783.summary: In recent years, characterizing the conditions for the existence of an $[a,b]$-factor in graphs has received significant academic attention. For integers $b\ge a\ge 1$, an $[a, b]$-factor of a graph $G$ is defined as a spanning subgraph $H$ such that $a\le d_{H}(v)\le b$ for every $v\in V(G)$. If $a=b=k$, a $[k, k]$-factor is called a $k$-factor of $G$.
arxiv:2610.27783.authors: Zengzhao Xu, Bo Deng, Ligong Wang

arxiv:2610.27796.title: Absolute winning properties of exceptional sets for rational maps
arxiv:2610.27796.summary: We study Schmidt's game on the Julia set $J(f)$ of weak hyperbolic rational maps $f:\CC\to\CC$. For each $y\in J(f)$, let $E(f,y)$ be the set of points in $J(f)$ whose forward orbits stay a positive distance from $y$. We prove that $E(f,y)$ is absolute winning on $J(f)$ for each $y \in J(f)$.

arxiv:2610.27819.title: Ehrhart positivity of smooth polytopes with few facets
arxiv:2610.27819.summary: For each dimension $d$, we determine the minimum number of facets of a smooth $d$-dimensional lattice polytope whose Ehrhart polynomial has at least one negative coefficient. This minimum is six in dimension $d=3$, seven in dimension $d=4$, and $d+2$ in every dimension $d\ge 5$. The lower bounds follow from the classification of smooth lattice polytopes with at most $d+2$ facets, together with explicit formulas for Ehrhart polynomials in dimensions at most $4$.
arxiv:2610.27819.authors: Feihu Liu, Jinlong Tang, Sihao Tao, Zihao Zhang

arxiv:2610.27842.title: Payoff Polarization and Garbage Concentration in a Stochastic Garbage Disposal Game
arxiv:2610.27842.summary: We study a stochastic garbage disposal game on a finite graph in which agents transfer garbage through pairwise interactions governed by payoff-dependent Fermi probabilities. We investigate the long-term behavior of both payoffs and garbage distributions. We prove that payoff dispersion grows at least linearly in time almost surely, leading to payoff polarization, with the maximum and minimum payoffs diverging to positive and negative infinity, respectively.

arxiv:2610.27844.title: Beta-expansions induced by general Parry polynomials and sharp iteration asymptotics of their transfer operators
arxiv:2610.27844.summary: This paper generalizes previous results to any Parry polynomials $p_n(z)$ \cite{Pa} of finite degree $n\geq 2$. Let $\beta>1$ be the unique positive root of $p_n$ and consider the transfer operator $\mathscr{P}$ induced by the map $[0,1]\ni x\mapsto \beta x-\lfloor \beta x\rfloor \in [0,1)$. Suppose all other roots of $p_n$ have magnitude less than one.
arxiv:2610.27844.authors: Horia D. Cornean, Ira W. Herbst, Kasper S. S{\o}rensen

arxiv:2610.27845.title: Almgren minimality of products of simplex-skeleton cones
arxiv:2610.27845.summary: In this paper, we prove that for every $m,n\geq 2$, the orthogonal product $S_m\times S_n\subset\R^m\times\R^n$ is an Almgren minimal cone of dimension $m+n-2$, where $S_k\subset\R^k$ is the cone over the $(k-2)$-skeleton of a regular $k$-simplex. Lawlor and Morgan \cite{LM94} proved the minimality of each $S_k$ by paired calibrations, while Guy David \cite{DJT, GD13} later raised the general question whether products of Almgren minimal sets remain minimal. Our theorem gives a affirmative answer to this product question within the entire Lawlor-Morgan regular-simplex family.
arxiv:2610.27845.authors: Songsong Huang, Xiangyu Liang, Zaoyi Zhang

arxiv:2610.27853.title: Free-field realizations of $\mathcal{N} = 1$ supersymmetric $\mathcal{W}$-algebras associated with Lie superalgebras $B (n - 1 , n)$ and $B (n , n)$
arxiv:2610.27853.summary: We extend the recursive construction of free-field realizations proposed by Ide, Ito, and Miyazaki to the $\mathcal{N} = 1$ supersymmetric $\mathcal{W}$-algebras $\mathcal{SW} B (n - 1 , n)$ and $\mathcal{SW} B (n , n)$, associated with the Lie superalgebras $B (n - 1 , n)$ and $B (n , n)$, respectively. We obtain explicit free-field realizations of $\mathcal{SW} B (0 , 1)$, $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 1)$, $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 2)$, and $\mathcal{SW} B (2 , 2)$. In particular, the realizations of $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 2)$ and $\mathcal{SW} B (2 , 2)$ are new.

arxiv:2610.27866.title: Median spaces with the strict separation property and superrigidity of actions
arxiv:2610.27866.summary: We introduce strictly separated median spaces, prove structural results and establish superrigidity for actions of higher rank lattices on the latter. We consider two different approach, the first one relies on the construction of a boundary map and the second one is self-contained and relies on the median geometry of the space of sections taking values in a median space.

arxiv:2610.27892.title: Almost entropic matroids and $(k,L)$-systems
arxiv:2610.27892.summary: For an integer $k$ and a set of integers $L$, a $(k,L)$-system is a family of $k$-element sets such that the size of the intersection of any two distinct members belongs to $L$. Let $m(n,k,L)$ denote the maximum size of a $(k,L)$-system on a ground set of $n$ elements. In this work, we establish a close connection between the asymptotic growth of $m(n,k,L)$ and almost entropic matroids.

arxiv:2610.27893.title: Stability and instability for particle dynamics in magnetic fields
arxiv:2610.27893.summary: We study zero-speed equilibria of the Newton-Lorentz equation $\ddot x=\dot x\times B(x)$ in $\mathbf{R}^3$, which describes the motion of a charged particle in a magnetic field $B$. We prove Lyapunov instability wherever the field $B$ does not vanish (under $C^1$ regularity), and at every isolated zero of $B$ provided it is real-analytic. These results do not assume that the field is divergence-free.

arxiv:2610.27903.title: The $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry
arxiv:2610.27903.summary: Amplituhedra are semi-algebraic sets of fundamental importance in particle physics. Their discovery initiated the field of Positive Geometry. We settle a central conjecture in this field: we show that the $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry.
arxiv:2610.27903.authors: Joris Koefler, Dmitrii Pavlov, Rainer Sinn

arxiv:2610.27918.title: Rational analytic prismatization
arxiv:2610.27918.summary: We develop a general theory of analytic prismatization with $\mathbb{Q}_p$-coefficients in rigid analytic geometry over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We prove an equivalence of perfect complexes on the perfect analytic prismatization modulo Frobenius with perfect complexes on the relative Fargues--Fontaine curve for any smooth partially proper rigid analytic variety. In particular, we explain how this equivalence conceptualizes the decompletion techniques by passing to locally analytic vectors which appear in (geometric) Sen theory
arxiv:2610.27918.authors: Johannes Ansch\"utz, Arthur-C\'esar Le Bras, Juan Esteban Rodr\'iguez Camargo, Peter Scholze

arxiv:2610.27934.title: Mass Deformations and Sheets in Logahoric Higgs Moduli
arxiv:2610.27934.summary: We use the framework of the logahoric Hitchin integrable system introduced in our earlier work and the sheets of the Lie algebra in order to describe the tame defects in a six dimensional $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ superconformal theory under mass deformations. We show that varying leaves of fixed dimension in the Hitchin system amounts to varying residue orbits of fixed dimension. Moreover, we verify the period and dimension conditions in mass-like deformations, as proposed by Balasubramanian--Distler, thus realizing the sheets of the Lie algebra on the Poisson moduli space of logahoric Higgs torsors.

arxiv:2610.27961.title: Classification of SNC $(p,k)$-planes with Hodge structures of K3 type
arxiv:2610.27961.summary: A SNC $(p,k)$-plane is a $(\mathbb Z/p)^k$-Galois cover $\pi\colon X \to \mathbb P^2$ with a simple normal crossing branch locus. In this setting, there exist several intermediate quotients $Y_1, Y_2,\dots, Y_{\phi_{p,k}}$ corresponding to subgroups of $(\mathbb Z/p)^k$ of index $p$. We focus on the case where each $Y_i$ is either a surface with geometric genus $0$ or $1$, with at least one with geometric genus $1$.
arxiv:2610.27961.authors: Federico Fallucca, Matteo Penegini, Anna Ulivi

arxiv:2610.27978.title: Error-correction Decoding for 2D Convolutional Codes with a Generalized Viterbi Algorithm
arxiv:2610.27978.summary: Two-dimensional (2D) convolutional codes are a generalization of one-dimensional (1D) convolutional codes and are naturally suitable for encoding two-dimensional data. Although their theoretical properties are well established, practical applications are limited due to the lack of error-correction decoding algorithms. While the Viterbi algorithm provides an efficient decoding method for 1D convolutional codes, no analogous approach exists for the 2D case.
arxiv:2610.27978.authors: Zita Abreu, Elisa Junghans, Julia Lieb, Raquel Pinto

arxiv:2610.27992.title: Mean-field limit and Vlasov equation for a Gaussian-thermostatted Lorentz gas
arxiv:2610.27992.summary: We study N particles moving in a dispersing billiard under an electric field and coupled through a Gaussian thermostat. The corresponding mean-field equation is a Vlasov-type equation with specular reflection. We reformulate the equation as a fixed point problem for the time-integrated thermostat coefficient.

arxiv:2610.28002.title: Functions determining few direction: the final missing case
arxiv:2610.28002.summary: By results of Blokhuis, Ball, Brouwer, Storme and Sz\H{o}nyi, and of Ball, if a function $f: {\mathbb F}_q\to{\mathbb F}_q$ determines fewer than $(q+3)/2$ directions, then $f-f(0)$ is linear over a subfield of ${\mathbb F}_q$, except possibly when $q$ is even and $f$ determines exactly $q/2+1$ directions. We settle this case: $f-f(0)$ is then additive. Hence every small minimal blocking set of R\'edei type in PG(2,$q$) is linear.

arxiv:2610.28026.title: Half-delocalization for semiclassical measures of split higher-dimensional quantum cat maps
arxiv:2610.28026.summary: We study quantum cat maps on multidimensional tori and prove an optimal lower bound for the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of their semiclassical measures under the hypothesis that the dynamics splits over the rationals. This is the first instance of such a bound for a dynamical system with multiple positive Lyapunov exponents. The proof is based on a new notion of conditional quantum dynamical entropy and a careful study of the multiple Ehrenfest time adapted to the dynamics.

arxiv:2610.28028.title: Harder-Narasimhan Filtrations of Hyperquiver Representations
arxiv:2610.28028.summary: Hyperquiver representations are generalisations of quiver representations. They are directed hypergraphs with vector spaces assigned to vertices, and for every directed hyperedge, an assignment of a linear map from the tensor product of the source vector spaces to the tensor product of the target vector spaces. We study the moduli of hyperquiver representations, where we use affine GIT to describe the (in)stability of such objects under the action of a product of general linear groups.

arxiv:2610.28029.title: Intersecting families with large covering number - On a conjecture of Frankl, Ota, and Tokushige
arxiv:2610.28029.summary: Stability theorems on intersecting families are often formulated via the covering number of set families. Let $M(n,k,t)$ denote the maximum size of a $k$-uniform intersecting family $\mathcal F\subseteq \binom{[n]}{k}$ with covering number $t$. It is known that for any fixed $t$ and fixed $k$ sufficiently large relative to $t$, one has $M(n,k,t)=(p_{t-1}(k)+o(1))(k)\binom{n}{k}$ as $n$ tends to infinity, where $p_{t-1}(k)$ is the maximum number of covers of size $t-1$ that a $k$-uniform intersecting family can have provided its covering number is $t-1$.

arxiv:2610.28030.title: Logarithmic edge-length ratios for planar drawings of 2-trees
arxiv:2610.28030.summary: For a planar graph $G$ with at least one edge, let $\rho(G)$ be the infimum of the ratio of the longest to the shortest edge length over all planar straight-line drawings of $G$. We prove that every $n$-vertex $2$-tree $G$ satisfies $\rho(G)\le4+5\lfloor\log_2(2n-3)\rfloor$. This improves the known $O(\sqrt n)$ upper bound and, together with the lower bound of Bla\v{z}ej, Fiala and Liotta, shows that the maximum of $\rho(G)$ over $n$-vertex $2$-trees is $\Theta(\log n)$.
arxiv:2610.28030.authors: Zahra Sabaei, Yasmin Tousinejad, Fatemeh Emami

arxiv:2610.28039.title: Complex Projective Spaces in Rational $SO(2)$-Equivariant Stable Homotopy Theory
arxiv:2610.28039.summary: We show that for almost every finite dimensional complex representation $W$ of $SO(2)$ the associated complex projective space $\mathbb{C}P(W)_+$ does not have the rational stable homotopy type of a specific wedge of representation spheres constructed from a chosen filtration of $\mathbb{C}P(W)_+$. This contrasts with the case for representations of finite Abelian groups where such an equivalence does hold. In the finite group case, the splitting result provides us with a classification result for projective spaces up to rational stable equivalence.

arxiv:2610.28084.title: Solid-angle formulas for simplicial cones and random shifted sections of polytopes
arxiv:2610.28084.summary: We consider simplicial cones $C = \operatorname{pos}(v_1, \ldots, v_n) \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ whose generators have a Gram matrix of the form $(\langle v_i, v_j \rangle)_{i,j=1}^n = \operatorname{Id}_n+\sum_{j=1}^p \lambda_j u_j u_j^T$, where $p\in \{0,\ldots, n\}$, $\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_p > -1$ and $u_1,\ldots, u_p \in \mathbb{R}^n$ are orthogonal unit vectors. We derive an explicit $p$-dimensional integral formula for the solid angle of $C$ involving the analytic continuation of the standard normal distribution function. As an application, explicit formulas are obtained for the expected face numbers of sections of acute orthocentric simplices and crosspolytopes with uniformly…

arxiv:2610.28088.title: Berry--Esseen Bounds for Faces in Unimodular Triangulations of Random Polytopes
arxiv:2610.28088.summary: Consider the number of faces arising from unimodular triangulations of random polytopes associated with Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graphs. Focusing on two-dimensional faces of regular unimodular triangulations of random symmetric edge polytopes, we derive precise asymptotic expansions for the expectation and variance and then establish a quantitative central limit theorem with an explicit Berry--Esseen bound. The proof combines an algebraically derived characterization of faces in terms of local graph configurations with a detailed combinatorial--geometric study of the relevant configurations.

arxiv:2610.28113.title: Real Nullstellensatz for nilpotent Lie algebras
arxiv:2610.28113.summary: We prove a real Nullstellensatz for the universal enveloping algebra U(g) of a nilpotent finite-dimensional real Lie algebra g: An ideal of U(g) is real if and only if it is the intersection of kernels of irreducible integrable *-representations of U(g) by (in general unbounded) operators on a Hilbert space. For this, we build upon some classical results about the complexification of U(g) that lead to a complex Nullstellensatz (every semiprime ideal is the intersection of primitive ideals), but focus only on the ``real points'', i.e., the *-representations on Hilbert spaces. On the technical side, this requires to take into account an involution of U(g), namely, the antipode of its Hopf…

arxiv:2610.28114.title: Divisors on regular Hessenberg varieties for h=(2,3,4,...,n,n) associated to lower subsets
arxiv:2610.28114.summary: For a regular Hessenberg variety associated to the Hessenberg function $h=(2,3,4,\ldots,n,n)$, we construct Cartier divisors $D_A$ associated to lower subsets $\emptyset\subsetneq A\subsetneq[n]$. We show that their first Chern classes satisfy the quadratic relations suggested by the combination of the works of B$\breve{\text{a}}$libanu-Crooks and Horiguchi-Masuda-Shareshian-Song. We also give a characterization of these divisors in terms of the centralizer action.

arxiv:2610.28119.title: Simultaneous visibility in cut-and-project sets
arxiv:2610.28119.summary: Visibility from the origin in integer lattices is a well-studied problem. More recently, the corresponding question for cut-and-project sets has attracted attention. We consider simultaneous visibility, which asks what points in a set are visible from every point of another set.

arxiv:2610.28124.title: Balanced subgraph counts and quasirandomness: a proof of the Janson--S\'os conjecture
arxiv:2610.28124.summary: For $0<p\leq1$, a graph sequence is $p$-quasirandom if every fixed finite simple graph $H$ has limiting labelled subgraph density $p^{|E(H)|}$. Janson and S\'os [\emph{European J. Combin.} (2015)] conjectured that, for every finite simple graph $F$ with at least two edges, $p$-quasirandomness is characterized by the random-graph asymptotics of the symmetrized counts of copies of $F$ across every balanced partition into $|V(F)|$ classes.
arxiv:2610.28124.authors: Guoqing Wang, Linlin Wang, Jun Yue

arxiv:2610.28135.title: There are no Miyaoka--Kobayashi octics
arxiv:2610.28135.summary: Let $C$ be a reduced plane curve of degree $n$ with only ADE singularities. Using K\"ahler-Einstein metrics, Kobayashi proved an upper bound, in terms of $n$, for a sum of local invariants of the singular points of $C$. For even $n$ this bound had been obtained earlier by Hirzebruch and Ivinskis.

arxiv:2610.28138.title: Dold--Kan Correspondences via Morita Normalization
arxiv:2610.28138.summary: The classical Dold--Kan correspondence identifies simplicial modules with connective chain complexes. Using Morita theory, we construct a Dold--Kan-type correspondence for every linear category carrying a suitable action of the maximum-preserving simplicial operators. The construction functorially assigns a Morita-equivalent normalized category to every such linear category.

arxiv:2610.28149.title: The stacky approach to de Rham-Witt cohomology
arxiv:2610.28149.summary: Let $k$ be a perfect field of characteristic $p>0$. Ekedahl proved an equivalence of triangulated categories between bounded coherent complexes over the Raynaud ring and complexes of $F$-gauges. We give a geometric proof, independent of his proof, that the de Rham-Witt realization is a symmetric monoidal equivalence of stable $\infty$-categories between perfect $F$-gauges and bounded coherent complexes over the Raynaud ring with Ekedahl's completed star product, as expected by Illusie.

arxiv:2610.28156.title: A Twisted bidifferential, second fundamental form of Prym map and projective structures
arxiv:2610.28156.summary: Given a point $[(\widetilde{C},C)]$ of the moduli space ${\mathcal R}_g$, where $\widetilde{C}$ is an \'etale double cover of a smooth curve $C$ of genus $g \,\geq\, 7$, we construct a twisted meromorphic bidifferential $\widehat{\eta}_P$ on $C\times C$ with a pole on the diagonal. It is shown that the second fundamental form $\rho_P$ of the Prym map from ${\mathcal R}_g$ to ${\mathcal A}_{g-1}$ at $[(\widetilde{C},C)]$ is given by this $\widehat{\eta}_P$. This allows us to compare $\rho_P$ with the second fundamental forms of the two Torelli maps, to ${\mathcal A}_{2g-1}$ and ${\mathcal A}_{g}$, at the points $[\widetilde{C}]$ and $[C]$ respectively.
arxiv:2610.28156.authors: Indranil Biswas, Elisabetta Colombo, Paola Frediani, Alessandro Ghigi

arxiv:2610.28165.title: Surface defects on lens space and transfer matrices
arxiv:2610.28165.summary: We study surface defects in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ theories of class $\mathcal{S}$ and $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories of class $\mathcal{S}_k$ placed on $L(r,1)\times S^1$. The lens space index depends on the fugacities $p$ and $q$, and the effect of the defects on it is captured by difference operators acting on the fugacities and holonomies of flavor symmetries. For theories of type $A_1$ we determine in closed form the difference operators for the basic defects, labeled by $p^r$, $q^r$ and $pq$, and show that for odd $r$ there exist additional elementary defects, whose operators shift the holonomy by one half modulo $r$.
arxiv:2610.28165.authors: Kazunobu Maruyoshi, Toshihiro Ota, Masahito Yamazaki

arxiv:2610.28168.title: Finiteness of planar central configurations of five bodies with positive masses
arxiv:2610.28168.summary: We prove that, for every choice of positive masses, the planar Newtonian five-body problem has finitely many central configurations up to similarity. After normalization and removal of the translation and rotation freedoms, every physical configuration is isolated in the complex solution variety. The proof combines the classification of singular sequences by Albouy and Kaloshin with a lower bound for the potential, asymptotic estimates, and local analytic reductions.

arxiv:2610.28174.title: An exact coexistence criterion for stochastic Lotka--Volterra systems with Volterra--Lyapunov stable interactions
arxiv:2610.28174.summary: We consider stochastic Lotka-Volterra systems $dX=\mathrm{Diag}(X)(\alpha+AX)dt+\mathrm{Diag}(X)\Gamma dB$ with nondegenerate noise and a Volterra-Lyapunov stable interaction matrix $A$, that is, $DA+A^\top D\prec 0$ for some positive diagonal matrix $D$. This class covers every self-limited predator-prey food web that is conservative in the sense of Volterra, in particular every such web whose interaction graph is a forest. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for invariant coexistence: the process has an invariant probability measure on $(0,\infty)^n$, that is, a stationary distribution under which all species have positive densities, if and only if $m=-A^{-1}\beta$ is positive,…

arxiv:2610.28177.title: Fourier Decomposition and E-Eigenvalues of Hypergraph Polynomials over Finite Abelian Groups
arxiv:2610.28177.summary: Let $H=(V,E)$ be a $k$-uniform hypergraph with polynomial $f_H(\bm{x})=\sum_{e\in E}\prod_{v\in e}x_v$. For a finite abelian group $G$ and a subgroup $S$ of $G$, the $k$-partite Cayley hypergraph $K$ has $k$ disjoint vertex parts, each indexed by $G$, and $\{(1,g_1),\ldots,(k,g_k)\}$ is an edge if and only if $g_1+\cdots+g_k\in S$. For $k=2$, $K$ is isomorphic to the Bi-Cayley graph associated with $G$ and $S$.
arxiv:2610.28177.authors: Yan-Hong Bao, Yi-Zheng Fan, Lili Liao

arxiv:2610.28186.title: Sharp Euler-factor positivity for the BG-rank-refined five-core crank
arxiv:2610.28186.summary: In this paper, we complete the resolution of Stanton's problem OPAC--005 by proving its fixed-BG-rank assertion. We further establish a sharp nine-factor positivity theorem for the joint generating function. Let $K_{n,j}(z)$ enumerate partitions of $5n+4$ with BG-rank $j$ by the integer five-core crank prescribed in OPAC--005, and put $[5]_z=1+z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.

arxiv:2610.28208.title: On the MDS conjecture in even characteristic
arxiv:2610.28208.summary: We prove that every nontrivial linear $[n,k]$ maximum distance separable (MDS) code over a finite field $\F_q$ of characteristic two satisfies $n\le q+1$, except in dimensions $k=3$ and $k=q-1$, where $n\le q+2$. This resolves the linear MDS conjecture in even characteristic.

arxiv:2610.28222.title: Secure Domination in Odd-order Sierpinski Graphs
arxiv:2610.28222.summary: A nonempty vertex set D of a graph is secure if and only if, for every nonempty subset X of D, the closed neighborhood of X contains at least as many vertices of D as vertices outside D. A secure dominating set is a set that is both secure and dominating, and the secure domination number is the minimum cardinality of such a set. Previous work determined the secure domination number of Sierpinski graphs S_n k for even k and for odd k when n = 2.
arxiv:2610.28222.authors: Qingcheng Zeng, Yumei Xue, Cheng Zeng, Dehui Wang

arxiv:2610.28225.title: Extremal graphs without cycles of length 0 modulo 4
arxiv:2610.28225.summary: In a remarkable recent result, Gy\H{o}ri, Li, Salia, Tompkins, Varga and Zhu determined the maximum size in a graph of given order and containing no cycle of length divisible by 4. In this paper, we give a complete characterization of all graphs attaining this maximum. This answers a question posed by Li, Pan and Shi.

arxiv:2610.28226.title: Simultaneous popular differences for polynomial and linear progressions in finite fields
arxiv:2610.28226.summary: We study simultaneous popular differences for polynomial progressions and linear progressions over finite fields $\mathbb F_p$. For certain families of polynomial progressions of algebraic complexity $1$, such as $(x, x+y, x+2y)$ and $(x, x+y^3, x+2y^3)$, we prove the existence of $y \neq 0$ which is popular simultaneously for both progressions. This extends previous results by Conlon, Dong and Hong who considered complexity $0$ progressions.

arxiv:2610.28247.title: Strictly convex ergodic billiards
arxiv:2610.28247.summary: We produce the first known strictly convex ergodic billiards: sufficiently asymmetric lemon billiards. These billiard tables are the intersection of two circles of which one contains the centers of both. We previously proved that they have \emph{uniformly} hyperbolic returns to a suitable section, and we here control singularity curves, with an approach that seems new.

arxiv:2610.28249.title: Oscillator representations of quantum affine orthosymplectic superalgebras II
arxiv:2610.28249.summary: As a continuation of our study on quantum affine spin-oscillator correspondence, we introduce a category of $q$-oscillator representations of quantum affine superalgebras of type $XB$ ($X=B,D$) and construct irreducible objects in a uniform way. Under the truncation functor inspired by the theory of super duality, they are related to finite-dimensional irreducible representations of $U_q(D^{(2)}_{n+1})$ ($X=B$) or $U_q(B^{(1)}_{n})$ ($X=D$). We also considerably streamline our previous arguments, which clarifies how our construction can be understood as a quantum affinization of classical super duality.
arxiv:2610.28249.authors: Jae-Hoon Kwon, Sin-Myung Lee, Masato Okado

arxiv:2610.28253.title: Proliferation Transitions for Quantum Doubles of Groups
arxiv:2610.28253.summary: Proliferation transitions are phase transitions between a 2+1d topological order $\mathcal{T}$ and another $\mathcal{T}/\mathcal{A}$, obtained by condensing anyons in an algebra $\mathcal{A}\subset \mathcal{T}$. We consider such transitions in quantum doubles of groups, $\mathcal{T}=D(G, \omega)$, for finite groups $G$ possibly with three-cocycle $\omega$, for which condensable algebras are fully classified. Given a condensable algebra $\mathcal{A}$, we represent $\mathcal{T}$ in terms of a Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT), that is tailored to the $\mathcal{A}$ proliferation transition.

arxiv:2610.28271.title: A Complete Dichotomy for $L_\infty$ Permutation Removal
arxiv:2610.28271.summary: We study the removal problem for permutation patterns under the normalized $L_\infty$ earth mover's distance. We prove a complete dichotomy. Let \[ \mathcal E =\{(12),(21),(132),(213),(231),(312)\}.
arxiv:2610.28271.authors: Viet Hung Le, Ruilin Shi, Fan Wei

arxiv:2610.28297.title: Twisted group codes of dimension 2 and 3
arxiv:2610.28297.summary: It is known that all group codes of dimension at most $3$ are permutation equivalent to abelian group codes. We prove that twisted group codes of dimension at most $3$ are monomially equivalent either to an abelian group code or to an irreducible constacyclic code, and in the second case we describe the code explicitly by means of a trace map. Monomial equivalence cannot be replaced by permutation equivalence, and the second case cannot be avoided: the ternary tetracode is an ideal of $\mathbb F_3[x]/(x^4+1)$ but it is not monomially equivalent to any group code.

arxiv:2610.28299.title: Ordered Trees with Linear Off-Diagonal Ramsey Numbers
arxiv:2610.28299.summary: We characterize the following three classes of ordered trees: $\qquad$ (1) trees $T$ satisfying $R_<(T,K_n)=O(n)$; $\qquad$ (2) $\chi$-bounding trees; $\qquad$ (3) Ramsey-good trees. In particular, we show that the first two classes coincide. The second characterization answers a question of Axenovich, Rollin and Ueckerdt, and the third resolves a problem of Balko and Poljak.
arxiv:2610.28299.authors: Lior Gishboliner, Artur Kravtsov, Xiangyu Li

arxiv:2610.28305.title: An Erd\H{o}s-Szekeres-Type Result on Permutation Patterns
arxiv:2610.28305.summary: We construct an infinite set of patterns $(p,q)$ where $p$ is an almost increasing permutation and $q$ is an almost decreasing permutation, such that the exponential growth rate of permutations avoiding $(p,q)$ is 2. This extends a classical result of Erd\H{o}s and Szekeres.

arxiv:2610.28328.title: A Joint Local Limit Theorem for Prime Divisor Counting Functions
arxiv:2610.28328.summary: We establish a uniform two-dimensional local limit theorem for the joint distribution of $\Omega(n)$ and $\Omega(n+1)$. More precisely, along a set of scales of logarithmic density one, the normalized joint counts are uniformly approximated by the density of two independent Gaussian random variables, each with mean and variance $\log\log x$, up to a power-saving error. The proof builds upon a recent circle-method framework of Tao and Ter\"av\"ainen.

arxiv:2610.28338.title: Unconditional Subexponential Arithmetic Circuits\ for Positive Factorial Multiples
arxiv:2610.28338.summary: Let $\tau(n)$ be the least number of binary additions, subtractions and multiplications required to construct $n$ from $1$ and $2$, with reuse of intermediate values. We show that, for every sufficiently large integer $k$, some positive integer $m$ satisfies \[ \tau(mk!)\leq \exp\!\left(O\!\left((\log k)^{2/3}(\log\log k)^{1/3}\right)\right). \] The proof combines unconditional results of Lenstra, Pila and Pomerance on smooth numbers in short intervals and on orders of genus-two Jacobians with a five-parameter family carrying a rational divisor class of infinite order.

arxiv:2610.28370.title: A General Construction of Strict Models in HoTT
arxiv:2610.28370.summary: Homotopy type theory (HoTT) provides a natural setting for studying the metatheory of type theory, as it comes with additional extensionality principles compared to ordinary Martin-L\"of type theory. In particular, it is especially suitable for developing semantics of type theory, where one distinguishes two kinds of models: strict models, which give us sound interpretations, and pseudomodels. Pseudomodels are useful as they occur prevalently and can be turned into strict models by constructions called strictifications.
arxiv:2610.28370.authors: Niyousha Najmaei, Niels van der Weide

arxiv:2610.28376.title: Avoiding abelian squares with three colours in the continuous setting
arxiv:2610.28376.summary: An $n$-colouring of the real line is a Lebesgue measurable function $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to A$, where $A$ is a set of $n$ colours. An abelian square for $f$ is a finite interval $U\subseteq \mathbb{R}$ where every colour shows up in the left and in the right half of $U$ with exactly the same Lebesgue measure. It is known that every $2$-colouring contains an abelian square.
arxiv:2610.28376.authors: Ville Salo, Ingrid Vukusic, Charlie Wilson

arxiv:2610.28394.title: On complete morphisms of Butson Hadamard matrices
arxiv:2610.28394.summary: A complete morphism of Butson classes replaces each entry of a matrix in $\mathrm{BH}(n,k)$ by an $m \times m$ block, uniformly, to produce a matrix in $\mathrm{BH}(mn,t)$. We show that every complete morphism is described by a pair $(U,Z)$, where $Z \in \mathrm{BH}(m,t)$ and $U$ is a unitary matrix annihilated by the $k^{\textrm{th}}$ cyclotomic polynomial. We deduce from a theorem of Lam and Leung that complete morphisms onto real Hadamard matrices exist precisely when $k$ is a power of $2$.

arxiv:2610.28395.title: Sprinkling for random regular graphs and Kim-Vu's sandwich conjecture
arxiv:2610.28395.summary: We show that the uniform random $d$-regular graph model on $n$ vertices is, in total variation distance, asymptotically close to the union of $d$ uniformly random edge-disjoint perfect matchings, provided that $n$ is even and $\omega(1) = d \leq n^{1/10}$. This confirms a conjecture by Hollom, Lichev, Mond, Portier, and Wang for this range of parameters. This result has a couple of interesting consequences.

arxiv:2610.28413.title: Forbidden graded posets in middle levels: supersaturation, enumeration and randomness
arxiv:2610.28413.summary: Let $P$ be a fixed finite poset whose maximal chains all have $h$ elements, and let $\mathcal W_{n,h}$ be the union of $h$ consecutive middle levels of $2^{[n]}$. We prove that the maximum size of a $P$-free subfamily of $\mathcal W_{n,h}$ is $(\pi(P)+o(1))M_n$ for a constant $\pi(P)$, where $M_n=\binom n{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$, and that the number of $P$-free subfamilies is $2^{(\pi(P)+o(1))M_n}$. For connected $P$ we prove supersaturation above $(\pi(P)+\epsilon)M_n$ and determine, in terms of the coordinate patterns of the copies of $P$ in the window, a range of $p$ in which the largest $P$-free subfamily of the random family $\mathcal W_{n,h}(p)$ has size $(\pi(P)+o(1))pM_n$ and a range…
arxiv:2610.28413.authors: Jiangdong Ai, Mingyu Liu, Zhiyu Song

arxiv:2610.28418.title: Convergence and semisimplicity of big quantum cohomology of flag varieties
arxiv:2610.28418.summary: We prove the folklore conjecture that the big quantum cohomology of a flag variety $G/P$ of general Lie type is convergent near the large-radius limit and is generically semisimple. The convergence relies on a slightly modified version of Iritani's reconstruction theorem, together with Cauchy's formula that avoids directly taking the non-equivariant limit at the origin. Generic semisimplicity follows from a surprising application of the big quantum $D$-module mirror symmetry for $G/P$ established by the first, third and fourth authors jointly with Hinault and Zhang.
arxiv:2610.28418.authors: Changzheng Li, Zhaoyang Liu, Tony Yue Yu, Chi Zhang

arxiv:2610.28433.title: Transversality at Virtual Centers
arxiv:2610.28433.summary: We consider the family of transcendental meromorphic functions with finitely many singular values, none of whose asymptotic values is infinity. We prove that transversality holds at any boundary point of a shell component in a dynamically natural slice of the parameter space at which an asymptotic value is a prepole.
arxiv:2610.28433.authors: Tao Chen, Yunping Jiang, Linda Keen

arxiv:2610.28439.title: Do Neural Models Prefer Their Submodels?
arxiv:2610.28439.summary: A neural model is the set of functions that can be expressed by a given neural network architecture. Neural models contain natural submodels, such as those obtained by setting some neurons to be inactive. We study the geometry of neural models and ask whether they prefer their submodels.
arxiv:2610.28439.authors: Alvaro Ribot, Yulia Alexandr, Anna Seigal

arxiv:2610.28446.title: Geometric chains of orbifolds with corners and singular homology
arxiv:2610.28446.summary: We study a geometric homology theory (GHT for short). Its chains are generated by smooth maps from compact oriented orbifolds with corners to a smooth space, and two kinds of chains are set to zero: those admitting an orientation reversing automorphism, and degenerate ones, which, together with their boundaries, factor through smooth maps to orbifolds of lower dimension. Bisecting the source of a geometric chain along a hypersurface transverse to its corners changes the chain only by the boundary of an explicit prism and by prisms over its faces; cutting a geometric cycle along a regular level set of a smooth function on the target does not change its homology class.

arxiv:2610.28447.title: Homotopy Groups of Special Orthogonal Groups in Degrees 23 to 29
arxiv:2610.28447.summary: This book presents calculations of the $2$-primary components of the homotopy groups $\pi_i(\mathit{SO}(n))$ for all $23\leq i\leq 28$ and all $n$, as well as some $\pi_{29}(\mathit{SO}(n))$, with explicit generators.
arxiv:2610.28447.authors: Yoshihiro Hirato, Jin-ho Lee, Toshiyuki Miyauchi, Juno Mukai, Mariko Ohara, Juxin Yang

arxiv:2610.28449.title: Real-analytic standard families and rotational invariant curves
arxiv:2610.28449.summary: In this paper we study one-parameter families of exact standard maps of the form $$\widehat{f}_{k,g}(\widehat{x},\widehat{y}) =\bigl(\widehat{x}+\widehat{y}+kg(\widehat{x}) \bmod 1,\widehat{y}+kg(\widehat{x})\bigr),$$ where $k$ is a real parameter and $g:\mathbb{T} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is real-analytic, 1-periodic and has zero mean. The most famous example is when $g(\widehat{x})=\frac{\sin(2\pi\widehat{x})}{2\pi}$. In this case, the closed subset $A_{\sin(2\pi\cdot)/(2\pi)}\subset \mathbb{R}$ of values of $k$ for which $\widehat{f}_{k,\sin(2\pi\cdot)/(2\pi)}$ has rotational invariant curves is conjectured to be a closed interval.

arxiv:2610.28456.title: Existence of Ulrich bundles on polarized surfaces and weakly Ulrich bundles on polarized varieties in positive characteristic
arxiv:2610.28456.summary: In their seminal paper \cite{eisenbud2003resultants}, Eisenbud and Schreyer asked whether every smooth projective variety admits an Ulrich bundle with respect to each very ample polarization. This question has stimulated extensive research for more than two decades. Recently, Anghel \cite{anghel2026smooth} constructed counterexamples over $\mathbb C$ in dimension two, and Lopez \cite{lopez2026existence} extended this nonexistence result to higher dimensions.

arxiv:2610.28464.title: ACM, almost Ulrich, and Ulrich vector bundles arising from Frobenius
arxiv:2610.28464.summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective variety of dimension $n$ over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic. We investigate ACM, almost Ulrich (both ACM and weakly Ulrich), and Ulrich properties of the sheaves of locally exact and closed $i$-forms $B_X^i$, $Z_X^i$. These cohomological properties are closely related to the fundamental concepts of Frobenius splitting and ordinarity.

arxiv:2610.28468.title: Independent transversals in hypergraphs with low codegrees
arxiv:2610.28468.summary: We prove that for every fixed $r\geq3$, $k>0$ and $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, there is $\gamma>0$ such that the following holds for all sufficiently large $b$. An $r$-uniform hypergraph $\mathcal H$ whose vertex set is partitioned into parts of size at least $b$ contains at least $\lceil(1-\varepsilon)b\rceil$ pairwise vertex-disjoint independent transversals, provided that the average degree in each part is at most $kb^{r-1}$ and maximum $j$-codegree $\Delta_j(\mathcal H)\leq\gamma b^{r-j}$ for $2\leq j<r$. Under the same average degree, if $q$ is the minimum part size and $\Delta_j(\mathcal H)=o(q^{r-j})$ for $2\leq j<r$, the maximum number of pairwise vertex-disjoint independent transversals…

arxiv:2610.28497.title: Matrix divisors, Christoffel transformations and symmetric $d$-connections
arxiv:2610.28497.summary: The Christoffel transformation $w(x)\mapsto x^2w(x)$ relates elementary bundle modifications to gap probability recurrences. The moment matrix determines normalization and the splitting type. We define the source and target moduli problems by their local data.

arxiv:2610.28499.title: Quadratic hulls of osculating varieties of rational normal curves
arxiv:2610.28499.summary: Let $T^p c_r$ be the $p$-osculating variety of the rational normal curve $c_r\subset\mathbb{P}S^r(\mathbb{C}^2)$. We study its quadratic hull, the scheme defined by the quadratic equations vanishing on $T^p c_r$. For $r\ge2p+3$, we prove that this scheme is a complete intersection of $\binom{r-2p}{2}$ quadrics whenever \[ p\ge\binom{r-2p-1}{2}.

arxiv:2610.28504.title: An exact formula for optimal axis-parallel packing of eight squares
arxiv:2610.28504.summary: We determine the smallest square container for eight axis-parallel squares of prescribed side lengths. The optimal side length is the minimum of the costs of 23 explicit packing strategies, and each cost is a maximum of sums of side lengths. No minimum of fewer convex functions represents it.

arxiv:2610.28531.title: Towards differential expansion for generic representations
arxiv:2610.28531.summary: We report the first results of phenomenological analysis, based on extended set of explicitly calculated colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials in \cite{knotebook}. They concern differential expansion (DE), which separates the dependencies on the knot ${\cal K}$ and the representation $R$. %of colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials. DE is well understood for symmetric and rectangular representations, while for non-rectangular $R$ even the knot-independent basis $Z_R^X$ of DE is not known.

arxiv:2610.28534.title: 2-representation theory of the Taft algebra
arxiv:2610.28534.summary: We study the $2$-representation theory of the Taft category, the tensor category of finite-dimensional modules over the Taft algebra. This category has two left cells. We first classify suitable transitive modules over its based representation ring.

arxiv:2610.28536.title: A sharp bound on the binding number of $K_k$-free graphs and the Brandt conjecture
arxiv:2610.28536.summary: The binding number of a graph is the smallest ratio $|N(S)|/|S|$ among all nonempty vertex sets $S$ whose neighborhood $N(S)$ is not the whole vertex set. We prove that every finite nonempty $K_k$-free graph has binding number at most $k-2$ for every $k\ge6$, confirming Brandt's conjecture; the bound is sharp for complete $(k-1)$-partite graphs with equal nonempty parts. We first prove the case $k=6$ and then extend it to all $k\ge6$ by induction.

arxiv:2610.28541.title: Extremal secant size distributions in projective planes
arxiv:2610.28541.summary: Given a point set $S$ in a projective plane of order $q$, each line $\ell$ determines a secant of size $|S\cap \ell|$. We study how concentrated this secant-size distribution can be. We develop a general framework for estimating and, in several cases, determining the extremal number.

arxiv:2610.28544.title: New Newton-type inequality and a unified perspective on Maclaurin's inequality via the inclusion relations of cones
arxiv:2610.28544.summary: The classical Newton-Maclaurin's inequalities for the elementary symmetric means are well known. In this paper, we derive a new class of Newton-type inequalities and generalize Maclaurin's inequality by connecting the elementary symmetric functions with their counterparts. Our idea is mainly motivated by the inclusion relations of G$\mathring{\text{a}}$rding's cones and $k$-convex cones.
arxiv:2610.28544.authors: Ning Cao, Xuanxuan Hu, Feida Jiang

arxiv:2610.28558.title: Higher-order tangent lines to smooth hypersurfaces
arxiv:2610.28558.summary: We prove that for every smooth hypersurface $X\subset\mathbb{P}^n$ of degree $d\geq n \geq 5$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, the space of pointed lines $(\ell,p)$ having intersection multiplicity at least six with $X$ at $p$ has the expected dimension $2n-7$. The proof uses deformations of ruled surfaces preserving prescribed contact with $X$. As an application, we show that a smooth hypersurface of degree $d\geq 6$ in $\mathbb{P}^5$ contains at most $225d^3-1370d^2+1800d$ planes.

arxiv:2610.28565.title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
arxiv:2610.28565.summary: Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers.

arxiv:2610.28574.title: Vanishing Uniform Tur\'an Densities: Characterization and Jumps
arxiv:2610.28574.summary: Uniform Tur\'an density problems ask for the minimum density threshold that guarantees a copy of a fixed 3-uniform hypergraph $F$ in every sufficiently large 3-uniform hypergraph whose edges are uniformly distributed. This line of research was initiated by Erd\H{o}s and S\'os in the 1980s, who introduced the notion of \emph{vertex-set Tur\'an density} $\pi_{vvv}(F)$. Reiher, R\"odl and Schacht later defined two related concepts, namely, the \emph{vertex-pair Tur\'an density} $\pi_{ve}(F)$ and the \emph{cherry Tur\'an density} $\pi_{ee}(F)$, which satisfy the chain of inequalities $\pi_{vvv}(F)\ge\pi_{ve}(F)\ge\pi_{ee}(F)$.
arxiv:2610.28574.authors: Hao Lin, Jie Ma, Wenling Zhou

arxiv:2610.28588.title: Generic finiteness of solutions to parametrized systems of generalized polynomial inequalities
arxiv:2610.28588.summary: We study parametrized systems of $\mathit{generalized}$ polynomial inequalities, $(c \circ x^B) \in C$, for a positive variable vector $x \in \mathbb{R}^n_>$, a $\mathit{real}$ exponent matrix $B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$, a positive parameter vector $c \in \mathbb{R}^m_>$, and a positive, blunt coefficient cone $C \subset \mathbb{R}^m_>$. This setting includes (i) generalized polynomial equations, $A \, (c \circ x^B) = 0$, arising e.g. from power-law dynamical systems with real exponents (and involving a real coefficient matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n' \times m}$), and (ii) generalized semi-algebraic sets. Our main result guarantees the generic finiteness of solutions modulo unavoidable…

arxiv:2610.28617.title: Measures of maximal entropy for meromorphic maps on compact K\"ahler manifolds
arxiv:2610.28617.summary: Let $f$ be a dominant meromorphic self-map of a compact K\"ahler manifold. Assume that $f$ has a strictly dominant intermediate dynamical degree $\lambda$ and that the number of isolated $n$-periodic points, counted with multiplicity, is at most $\lambda^n+o(\lambda^n)$. Then $f$ admits at most one adapted invariant probability measure of entropy $\log\lambda$.

arxiv:2610.28635.title: Model-based computational study of reactive fluid systems using transfer operator methods
arxiv:2610.28635.summary: In many industrial applications one aims for the design of efficient chemical reactions. This is often done using experimental analysis of the reactors in combination with numerical twins. However, the simultaneous modeling of flow, mixing and chemical reaction remains a complicated task because the computational costs are still significant and oftentimes prohibitive.
arxiv:2610.28635.authors: Anja G\"obel, Anna Kl\"unker, Alexandra von Kameke, Kathrin Padberg-Gehle

arxiv:2610.28657.title: Ideal balanced pairs in n-exangulated categories
arxiv:2610.28657.summary: This paper is devoted to ideal approximation theory in $n$-exangulated categories. We define ideal balanced pairs and explore their properties and equivalent characterizations. We prove that any complete ideal cotorsion triple $(\mathcal{I},\mathcal{K},\mathcal{J})$ satisfying suitable assumptions yields an ideal balanced pair $(\mathcal{I}, \mathcal{J})$, and the converse holds under additional hypotheses.
arxiv:2610.28657.authors: Peiyu Zhang, Zhuolin Zheng, Li Wang, Dajun Liu

arxiv:2610.28672.title: Triangulation, Volume, and Symmetries of the Dihedral Group Analogue of the Permutohedron
arxiv:2610.28672.summary: We study the analogue of the permutohedron for the dihedral group, which we call the dihedral permutohedron. We determine the facet structure of the dihedral permutohedron, use the facet structure to construct a triangulation, and determine a nice combinatorial formula for the volume of the dihedral permutohedron. Lastly, we find a family of interesting unimodular affine symmetries of the odd dihedral permutohedron.

arxiv:2610.28691.title: Two q-Deformations of Narayana Polynomials: Rogers Moments, Hankel Positivity, and q-Narayana Kernels
arxiv:2610.28691.summary: We study two $q$-deformations of the continuous interpolation between type $B$ and shifted type $A$ Narayana polynomials, both constructed from the continuous $q$-ultraspherical (Rogers) functional. The first consists of affine moments of ordinary powers. For fixed $0<q<1$ and $-1<\beta<1$, we prove coefficientwise Hankel total positivity in the polynomial variable by a continuant comparison criterion.

arxiv:2610.28715.title: Low-Dimensional Reduction of Mean-Field Coupled Dynamical Systems with Units Described by Two Real Variables: Classification and Applications
arxiv:2610.28715.summary: Low-dimensional reduction is crucial for understanding network systems with many units. In a recent advance, Martens and Dharmavaram developed a theory of exact low-dimensional reduction for a general class of mean-field coupled dynamical systems characterized by a mean-field Lie-Scheffers structure. In this paper, we classify mean-field coupled dynamical systems with a mean-field Lie-Scheffers structure, where each unit is described by two real variables.

arxiv:2610.28780.title: Low-degree filtrations in ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology
arxiv:2610.28780.summary: We prove the Hilbert-series formulas conjectured by Reiner--Tudose and by the Polymath Jr. Grassmannian group for the subalgebras of ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology generated in bounded degree. We determine the finite coefficient images underlying the proofs, together with the kernels of the coefficient and cancellation maps.

arxiv:2610.28792.title: Closedness of bounded strength and partition rank loci
arxiv:2610.28792.summary: We show the existence of a quartic form of strength $3$ in the closure of the strength at most $2$ locus, answering a question of Ballico--Bik--Oneto--Ventura in the negative. In the analogous setting of partition rank as introduced by Naslund, we further show that the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $2$ is closed, but the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $3$ is not. Together with a suspension lemma, this answers for all $r$ whether the locus of forms/tensors of strength/partition rank at most $r$ is Zariski-closed.

arxiv:2610.28809.title: The moduli space of maps from hypersurfaces and its Goodwillie tower
arxiv:2610.28809.summary: We define a moduli space of continuous maps from smooth hypersurfaces varying in an ample linear system. To study its topology, we construct a scanning map to an appropriate section space and investigate its effect on homology. Our main innovation is a general argument based on Goodwillie calculus and applicable to various moduli spaces of maps.

arxiv:2610.28813.title: Embeddings of Relative Dimension Groups for Zero-Dimensional Dynamical Systems
arxiv:2610.28813.summary: Let $\pi:(X,T)\rightarrow(Y,S)$ be a factor map between zero-dimensional dynamical systems, and let $X_0$ and $Y_0$ be quasi-sections with $\pi(X_0)=Y_0$. We study the homomorphism $\pi^*:K^0(Y|Y_0,S)\rightarrow K^0(X|X_0,T)$, $[f]\mapsto[f\circ\pi]$, between the corresponding relative dimension groups, and identify it with the homomorphism induced by the premorphism between Bratteli--Vershik realizations associated with $\pi$. Generalizing a result of Glasner and Weiss for minimal Cantor systems, we show that if $Y_0$ is quasi-simple, then $\pi^*$ is an injective unital order-preserving homomorphism, and that if $X_0=\pi^{-1}(Y_0)$, then $\pi^*$ is a unital order embedding; the latter…

arxiv:2610.28820.title: A Matroidal Framework for Random Access in Linear Codes
arxiv:2610.28820.summary: We study random access in linear codes when codeword symbols are sampled independently and uniformly with replacement. A code is recovery balanced if the expected number of samples required to recover a codeword coordinate is the same for every coordinate. We express the recovery expectations in terms of the associated matroid and derive a coordinatewise identity relating these values for a code and its dual.
arxiv:2610.28820.authors: Daniella Bar-Lev, Hiram H. L\'opez, Gretchen L. Matthews, Flavio Salizzoni

arxiv:2610.28828.title: A counterexample to Gale's conjecture in $\mathbb{R}^3$
arxiv:2610.28828.summary: It is known that for every partition of the sphere $S^2$ of unit diameter into four parts, the largest diameter of a part is at least $\sqrt{(3+\sqrt{3})/6} = 0.88807\dots$, and this bound is attained. The conjecture of D.~Gale (1953) asserts that no set in $\mathbb{R}^3$ has a larger ratio. In this paper, we construct a $101$-point set $V\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ such that every partition of $V$ into four parts contains a part of diameter greater than $0.88928 \, \operatorname{diam} V$.

arxiv:2610.28839.title: On a conjecture of Velani
arxiv:2610.28839.summary: We investigate the approximation of elements of the middle-third Cantor set by dyadic rationals, and natural extensions. We prove a conjecture of Velani, completing the metric theory for the Cantor measure. Our key method enables a quantitative study of the incommensurability of binary and ternary expansions of integers, initiated by Furstenberg.

arxiv:2610.28861.title: From Wheel to Jahangir graphs: spectra and energy under structured edge deletion
arxiv:2610.28861.summary: The energy of a graph, introduced by Gutman, is defined as the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix. In this work we study how the energy of the Wheel graph $W_n$ changes when a specific set of spokes is removed. The resulting graphs are precisely the Jahangir graphs $J_{m,n}$, where m divides n, and which may also be viewed as the Cycle graph $C_n$ together with an additional vertex adjacent to certain vertices of $C_n$ in a cyclic pattern.
arxiv:2610.28861.authors: Diego Bravo, Florencia Cubr\'ia, Annabella Zapattini

arxiv:2610.28865.title: Tree-independence number VIII. 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number
arxiv:2610.28865.summary: A three-path-configuration is a graph consisting of three pairwise internally vertex-disjoint paths, the union of every two of which is an induced cycle of length at least four. A graph is 3PC-free if no induced subgraph of it is a three-path-configuration. We show that 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number, which is asymptotically best possible.
arxiv:2610.28865.authors: Maria Chudnovsky, Julien Codsi, Ajaykrishnan E S, Daniel Lokshtanov, Ilya Maier

arxiv:2610.28874.title: A sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines
arxiv:2610.28874.summary: We construct a sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines in the real projective plane. It is obtained from the icosahedral arrangement $\mathcal{A}(21,2)$ by adjoining the $30$ images of the line $y+\sqrt{\varphi}\,z=0$ under the rotation group of the icosahedron, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt5)/2$. Its intersection multiplicities are $t_2=120$, $t_3=190$, $t_5=36$, and $t_6=15$, with all other $t_r$ zero.

arxiv:2610.28936.title: The domination number of the $k$-token graph of the complete bipartite graph $K_{m,n}$
arxiv:2610.28936.summary: This paper is about token graphs and domination number. Let $G=(X,E)$ denote an undirected graph that is connected, with no loops or multiple edges, vertex set $X$, and edge set $E$. Pick a positive integer $k\leq \vert X\vert$.
arxiv:2610.28936.authors: Nathaniel Chinman, Antonio Cortijo, Beatrice Pedroni, Ian Seong, Lucy Stenger

arxiv:2610.28959.title: Polynomial Invariants of Pseudo-Anosov Maps (Addendum)
arxiv:2610.28959.summary: We show that homology, puncture, and symplectic polynomials of a pseudo-Anosov map arXiv:1001.5094 are invariants of the mapping class, as well as of the conjugacy class.

arxiv:2610.28960.title: Same Gaps, Different Sets: A Survey on Complimentary sets and their Dimensions
arxiv:2610.28960.summary: Let a=\{a_n\} be a non-increasing sequence of positive real numbers adding up to $1$. Cutting out of the unit interval disjoint open gaps of lengths $a_1,a_2,\dots$, one for each term, leaves a compact set of Lebesgue measure zero, and since the gaps can be placed in infinitely many ways, there are infinitely many such sets. We call them the \emph{complementary sets} of $a$ and write $\mathfrak{C}_a$ for the family of all of them.
arxiv:2610.28960.authors: Nicol\'as Angelini, Carlos Cabrelli, Ursula Molter

arxiv:2610.28963.title: Asymptotics of Masur-Veech volume of strata of quadratic differentials with many simple poles
arxiv:2610.28963.summary: We provide large $n$ asymptotics of the Masur-Veech volumes for strata of quadratic differentials of the form $\mathcal{Q}_g(n,d_1,\dots,d_k,-1^{n+D-4g+4})$, where all positive integers $d_i$ are fixed and $D=d_1+\dots+d_k$. Our formulae are particularly explicit in genus $1$. For the two series of non-varying strata $\mathcal{Q}_1(n,-1^n)$ and $\mathcal{Q}_1(n,1,-1^{n+1})$ we give simple closed formulae for the volumes for any $n$.

arxiv:2610.28986.title: The geometric combinatorics of $k$-shuffle braid groups
arxiv:2610.28986.summary: This paper is the first in a series of two which aims at introducing a new family of groups called $k$-shuffle braid groups, denoted $\mathcal{B}_{n}(k)$. These groups have two intrinsically related stories. They were first observed by Calegari in arXiv:2105.11265 by looking at spaces of complex monic polynomials of degree $n$ whose critical values lie in $\mathbb{C} \setminus \{1, e^{\frac{2\pi i}{k}}, \dots, e^{\frac{2\pi (k-1)}{k}}\}$.

arxiv:2610.29011.title: Affine $G$-multibiquandle modules for colored links I: representability of coloring functors and color-profile polynomials
arxiv:2610.29011.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity, let $G$ be an abelian group, and fix $u\in R[G]^\times$. For each component-labeled oriented link diagram $(D,\sigma)$, we construct a finitely presented $R[G]$-module $M_u(D,\sigma;R[G])$ with a universal affine coloring $U_{D,\sigma}$. Every affine coloring with values in an $R[G]$-module factors uniquely through $U_{D,\sigma}$ by a module homomorphism.

arxiv:2610.29015.title: On the Number of Iterations in a Kruskal-Type Process
arxiv:2610.29015.summary: Motivated by the Kruskal counting procedure, this paper investigates a combinatorial elimination process defined on a deck consisting of $m$ copies of each value $1,2,\ldots,n$. Starting from an arbitrary arrangement of the $mn$ cards, the process repeatedly removes a number of consecutive cards equal to the value of the first remaining card. This generates a sequence of elimination steps whose length determines $T$, representing the total number of iterations required to exhaust the deck.

arxiv:2610.29039.title: Neural Vector Field Transformations: Learning the Flow of Autonomous Systems by Conjugation to Explicitly Integrable Reference Flows
arxiv:2610.29039.summary: We represent the flow map of an autonomous ODE $\dot x=f(x)$ as a conjugate $\Phi_t=F_\theta^{-1}\circ\Psi_t\circ F_\theta$ of an explicitly integrable reference flow $\Psi_t$ by an invertible neural network $F_\theta$, the neural vector field transformation. The representation is an exact flow for every parameter value and inherits the phase portrait of the reference. A $C^1$ conjugacy preserves the eigenvalues of equilibria, the periods and Floquet multipliers of periodic orbits and the frequency-amplitude relation of centers, so these invariants must be learnable parameters of $\Psi$.

arxiv:2610.29043.title: Every tournament of dichromatic number $10 k^2$ has a vertex whose out-neighborhood has dichromatic number more than $k$
arxiv:2610.29043.summary: The dichromatic number of a tournament is the minimum number of colors needed to color the vertices so that no directed cycle is monochromatic. Nguyen, Scott, and Seymour (2025) asked whether every tournament with dichromatic number $2k$ has a vertex whose out-neighborhood induces a subtournament of dichromatic number at least $k$. We answer their question negatively by finding an example with dichromatic number $\Omega(k^2)$.

arxiv:2610.29044.title: Non-trivial intersecting families for direct products
arxiv:2610.29044.summary: A family of sets is intersecting if any two of its sets intersect, and non-trivial intersecting if there is not any element which appears in every set of the family. The study of intersection problems (or Erd\H{o}s-Ko-Rado problems) on families of sets is one of the most important topics in extremal combinatorics. A natural extension of the Erd\H{o}s-Ko-Rado problem in direct products setting was introduced by Frankl, and developed by Alon and Katona et al.
arxiv:2610.29044.authors: Jian Wang, Biao Wu, Huajun Zhang

arxiv:2610.29048.title: Proofs of Li, Wang and Guo's conjectures on (signless) Laplacian spectral radius
arxiv:2610.29048.summary: Let $\mu(G)$ and $q(G)$ be the Laplacian and signless Laplacian spectral radii of a graph $G$. Li, Wang and Guo (2026) conjectured that, if $H$ with $|V(H)|\geq 1$ is an induced subgraph of a graph $G$, then $\mu(G)\le\max\limits_{v\in V(H)}\mu(H_v^t)$ and $q(G)\le\max\limits_{v\in V(H)}q(H_v^t)$, where $t=e(G)-e(H)$ and $H_v^t$ is the graph obtained from $H$ by adding $t$ pendant edges to $v\in V(H)$. We prove this conjecture by establishing a spectral comparison theorem for a broader family of positive semidefinite graph matrices which includes the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices.
arxiv:2610.29048.authors: Hongzhang Chen, Jianxi Li, Xiaoyun Lv

arxiv:2610.29056.title: General Criterion for a Poset to Admit a Partition Into $\omega$-Chains
arxiv:2610.29056.summary: Given a poset $P$ with no maximal element the question naturally arises of when $P$ can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. In this paper we give general criterion for when this can be done. We show that in the case when a poset with no maximal element is countable or a well-founded forest, then it can always be partitioned into $\omega$-chains.

arxiv:2610.29065.title: Pontryagin-Thom, $\pi_0$ of the motivic sphere, and principal quadratic divisors
arxiv:2610.29065.summary: Segal computed $\pi_0$ of the equivariant sphere spectrum as the Burnside ring by a Pontryagin-Thom construction, transversality, and marks. We carry out the same argument in the motivic setting over a field $k$: the Burnside ring is replaced by the Grothendieck ring $A^u(\Gamma_k)$ of finite \'etale $k$-schemes decorated with a unit, the marks by the Dress map $d(L,u)=\mathrm{tr}_{L/k}\langle u\rangle$ into $\mathrm{GW}(k)$, and a Pontryagin-Thom map $A^u(\Gamma_k)\to\pi_0(\mathbb{S}_k)(k)$ is shown to be surjective with kernel $\ker(d)$. This gives $\pi_0(\mathbb{S}_k)(k)\cong\mathrm{GW}(k)$ for infinite perfect fields of characteristic $\ne 2$ without Morel's computation.

arxiv:2610.29080.title: Pappus configurations in the Hall plane
arxiv:2610.29080.summary: In this paper, we investigate Pappus configurations in the finite affine Hall plane. In particular, we show that for any two lines $\ell_1,\ell_2$ and for any triple of points on $\ell_1$ there is a triple of points on $\ell_2$ that are contained in a Pappus configuration, thus improving on the results of [F. Lazebnik and L.
arxiv:2610.29080.authors: Stefano Lia, John Sheekey, Geertrui Van de Voorde

arxiv:2610.29115.title: On a conjecture concerning two-stack sortable permutations
arxiv:2610.29115.summary: The two-stack sortable permutations of length $n$ are known to be equinumerous with permutations of length $n$ avoiding the dashed patterns $3\text{-}1\text{-}4\text{-}2$ and $2\text{-}41\text{-}3$. In this paper, we confirm an intriguing conjecture posed by Claesson, Kitaev, and Steingr\'imsson, which asserts that the quadruple $(\comp,\asc,\ldr,\rmax)$ is equidistributed on these two permutation classes. Here $\comp$ and $\asc$ count the number of components and ascents, respectively, $\ldr$ denotes the length of the initial decreasing run, and $\rmax$ denotes the number of right-to-left maxima.
arxiv:2610.29115.authors: Yongzhou Wen, Sherry H. F. Yan

arxiv:2610.29125.title: Integer Flows on Cyclic Covers of Graphs
arxiv:2610.29125.summary: Graph covers preserve the local structure of a graph while allowing its global structure to change substantially. In this paper, we study how such changes in cyclic covers affect nowhere-zero flow properties. For a fixed integer $\ell \ge 2$, we show that for every bridgeless graph $G$, there exists an $\ell$-fold cyclic cover of $G$ that admits a nowhere-zero $3$-flow if $\ell$ is even and a nowhere-zero $4$-flow if $\ell$ is odd.
arxiv:2610.29125.authors: Rong Luo, Yuying Ma, D. Christopher Stephens, Dong Ye

arxiv:2610.29130.title: $G$-crossed braided tensor categories of twisted modules
arxiv:2610.29130.summary: Let $V$ be a strongly rational vertex operator algebra and $G\leq\operatorname{Aut}(V)$ a finite group. We prove Huang's conjecture that the categories of $g$-twisted $V$-modules, for $g\in G$, form a $G$-crossed braided fusion category. This category is faithfully $G$-graded, with tensor products representing the complete twisted intertwining operators of Du-Huang, the canonical pullback $G$-action, and crossed braiding.

arxiv:2610.29131.title: Small covers and the Four Color Theorem
arxiv:2610.29131.summary: We give a combinatorial proof that every simple convex $3$-polytope admits a small cover without using the Four Color Theorem. We also prove that the assertion that every simple plane triangulation admits a mod~$2$ characteristic function with at most five values is equivalent to the Four Color Theorem.

arxiv:2610.29197.title: The Local Dyadic Conjecture
arxiv:2610.29197.summary: A rational with denominator a power of two is said to be dyadic. A long standing conjecture of Paul Seymour predicts that for an ideal clutter, the dual of the set covering problem always admits an optimal solution where all variables take dyadic values. We present a local version of this conjecture, and motivate it by proving an important special case.
arxiv:2610.29197.authors: Mahtab Alghasi, Bertrand Guenin, Levent Tun\c{c}el

arxiv:2610.29204.title: The Logarithmic A-Discriminant
arxiv:2610.29204.summary: We extend the GKZ theory of discriminants to the setting of Euler integrals where both coefficients and exponents are variables. The integrand is the likelihood function of a toric model in algebraic statistics, whose number of critical points is the volume of the Newton polytope. Our logarithmic A-discriminant vanishes when two critical points come together.
arxiv:2610.29204.authors: Madeleine Goertz, Bernd Sturmfels, Simon Telen

arxiv:2610.29211.title: On the gradient conjecture at infinity: Finite spherical length for gradient trajectories of definable potentials
arxiv:2610.29211.summary: We prove that for every open $ U \subseteq \mathbb R^n $ the spherical projection of every gradient trajectory $\theta(t)$, $t \geq 0$, of a definable $C^1$-potential $F \colon U \to \mathbb R$ has finite length and, in particular, converges (directional convergence). In other words, every gradient trajectory of a definable $C^1$-potential has finite total angular motion. Here, definable means definable in an arbitrary o-minimal structure expanding the real field.
arxiv:2610.29211.authors: Thang Do, Arnulf Jentzen, Benno Kuckuck

arxiv:2610.29215.title: Third and Fourth Moment Phenomena for Monochromatic Edges and Applications to Graph-Based Two-Sample Tests
arxiv:2610.29215.summary: Given a graph sequence $\{G_n\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$, denote by $T_n$ the number of monochromatic edges when the vertices of $G_n$ are independently colored red or blue with probabilities $p$ and $1-p$, respectively. We characterize the asymptotic normality of $T_n$, after centering and scaling to unit variance, in terms of subgraph (motif) counts and standardized moments. One of the highlights of our results is a {\it third moment phenomenon}: for every fixed $p\in(0,1)\backslash\{\frac12\}$, asymptotic normality holds if and only if the standardized third moment converges to zero.
arxiv:2610.29215.authors: Siva Athreya, Bhaswar B. Bhattacharya, Yogesh Dahiya, Karambir Das, Spandan Ghoshal, Sourish Maniyar, Elizabeth Sara Roy

arxiv:2610.29233.title: Bistable Dynamics and Complete Classifications of A Seasonal Competition Model Between Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus
arxiv:2610.29233.summary: The bistable dynamics and a complete classification of global dynamics are established for a competition model between Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus subject to favorable-unfavorable seasonal shifts, originally proposed by Zheng et al. (2025). More precisely, by employing Floquet theory, we prove that the unique positive periodic solution must be unstable.
arxiv:2610.29233.authors: Lei Niu, Yi Wang, Xizhuang Xie, Bo Zheng

arxiv:2610.29239.title: Day Convolution and Homotopy Groups on the Pointed Homotopy Category of CW Complexes
arxiv:2610.29239.summary: We freely enrich the pointed homotopy category of CW complexes over abelian groups and equip the resulting functor category with the enriched Day convolution induced by the smash product. After identifying the convolution unit and recording the coherence maps, we compute the convolution of the homotopy-group functors. For integers $n,m\geq 2$ we construct a natural isomorphism $\pi_n\star\pi_m\cong\pi_{n+m}$ induced by the external smash product; equivalently, the external smash product is the universal natural pairing of homotopy groups.

arxiv:2610.29263.title: Ramification and Finiteness of Equivariant Minimal Surfaces
arxiv:2610.29263.summary: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g$, with $g\ \geq \ 2$, and let $\mathcal X_0^{\mathrm{good}}$ be the good locus of $\operatorname{PU}(2,\,1)$ representations with Toledo invariant zero. For $1\ \leq \ b\ \leq\ 2g-3$, we show that representations admitting an equivariant minimal map of total ramification at least $b$, for some marked complex structure, form a countable union of compact null sets of Hausdorff dimension at most $16g-16-2b$. For larger $b$, this locus is empty.
arxiv:2610.29263.authors: Indranil Biswas, Satyajit Guin, Pradip Kumar

arxiv:2610.29274.title: Nielsen coincidence theory for $(n,m)$-valued pairs
arxiv:2610.29274.summary: We define a Nielsen coincidence number for pairs of maps $(f,g)$ where $f$ is $n$-valued and $g$ is $m$-valued. The classical definition of the Nielsen number does not work in this setting, but we propose a theory where coincidence classes are allowed to overlap. We invoke a notion of multiplicity of a coincidence point, which indicates to how many classes it can belong, and we show that our Nielsen number is a homotopy-invariant lower bound for the number of coincidence points with multiplicity.

arxiv:2610.29275.title: A proof of Ward's conjecture on Griesmer codes
arxiv:2610.29275.summary: Let $C$ be an $[n,k,d]_q$ Griesmer code, where $q=p^f$ with $p$ prime, and write $e=\nu_p(d)$. Ward conjectured that $C$ is $p^{\max\{0,e-f+1\}}$-divisible. In this paper, we prove this conjecture.

arxiv:2610.29291.title: Counting and constructing Latin tableaux
arxiv:2610.29291.summary: Latin tableaux generalize Latin squares to Young diagrams and have interesting connections to linear algebra and Rota's basis conjecture. Conjecturally, a partition admits Latin tableaux if and only if it belongs to a special class called wide partitions. We prove that various classes of wide partitions admit Latin tableaux.
arxiv:2610.29291.authors: Spencer Daugherty, Michaela Fahnesock, Shawn Huxtable, Michael Larson, Nourah Al Munayes, Storey Peacock

arxiv:2610.29307.title: Effective stability and sharp logarithmic time scales for Hamiltonian PDEs on the circle
arxiv:2610.29307.summary: We prove effective stability and matching logarithmic upper bounds for small solutions of Hamiltonian PDEs on the one-dimensional torus. An analytic coefficient-majorant calculus and an explicit normal-form iteration yield stability times with logarithms of order $L^{1+1/p}/(\log L)^{1/p}$ for Gevrey weights and $L^{1+(q-1)/(pq+1)}$ for logarithmic ultra-differentiable weights, where $L=\log(1/\varepsilon)$ and $p\geq1$ measures the order dependence of the small divisors. Even frequencies are organized into the exact blocks $\{n,-n\}$; elementary frequency gaps and constant weights on these blocks close the energy estimate.

arxiv:2610.29360.title: Curvature, second variation and Jacobi fields in elastic diffeology
arxiv:2610.29360.summary: We develop curvature theory on Blohmann's elastic diffeological spaces.
